attributes.description: Reference to the community or settlement unit that is the subject of this assessment when assessment_level is 'community'. Nullable when assessment_level is 'individual' or 'household'.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets — Settlement/Community Registry

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.corrective_action_plan. Business justification: When internal reviews or audits identify needs assessment quality issues (sampling bias, incomplete data, targeting errors), corrective action plans document remediation measures. Essential for qualit

attributes.name: data_collection_tool_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the data collection instrument used to conduct this assessment. For KoboToolbox, this is the form UID (e.g., 'aXmK3p9QrT'). For CommCare, this is the module ID. Enables traceability back to the specific questionnaire version and supports data quality audits.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Form Management — Form UID; CommCare Application Builder — Module ID

attributes.name: enumerator_volunteer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to volunteer.volunteer. Business justification: Volunteers conduct needs assessments in many NGO operations (household surveys, vulnerability assessments, rapid assessments). Standard practice for community-based data collection. Required for track

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household unit that is the subject of this assessment when assessment_level is 'household'. Nullable when assessment_level is 'individual' or 'community'.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Household-Level Assessment Standards; KoboToolbox Household Survey Module

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the humanitarian or development program under which this needs assessment was commissioned. Links the assessment to the program's Theory of Change (ToC) and LogFrame targeting criteria.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Program Management Module; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.partner_org. Business justification: Partners conduct needs assessments in their operational areas under consortium or sub-award arrangements. Tracking the assessing partner is required for data quality oversight, capacity assessment val

attributes.name: primary_beneficiary_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member or volunteer who conducted the field assessment. Used for quality assurance, inter-rater reliability checks, and enumerator performance monitoring.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Accountability to Affected Populations; CommCare Field Worker Module

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual beneficiary (IDP, PoC, GBV survivor, or other target population member) who is the subject of this assessment when assessment_level is 'individual'. Nullable when assessment_level is 'household' or 'community'.
attributes.references: CommCare Case Management — Beneficiary Case ID; UNHCR PoC Registration Standards

attributes.name: admin1_name
attributes.description: Name of the first-level administrative division (e.g., province, state, region) where the assessment was conducted. Sourced from OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) administrative boundary reference. Used for geographic aggregation in SitReps and donor reports.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) — Administrative Boundaries; IATI Country/Region Codes

attributes.name: admin2_name
attributes.description: Name of the second-level administrative division (e.g., district, county, department) where the assessment was conducted. Sourced from OCHA CODs. Enables sub-national geographic disaggregation for targeting and cluster coordination reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) — Administrative Boundaries

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the needs assessment was physically conducted in the field. This is the principal real-world event date, distinct from the record submission or validation timestamps. Used for temporal targeting analysis and periodic reassessment scheduling.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Needs Assessment Timing; OCHA Assessment Registry Standards

attributes.name: assessment_level
attributes.description: The unit of analysis at which this needs assessment was conducted. 'individual' targets a single beneficiary (e.g., GBV survivor, SAM case); 'household' targets a family unit; 'community' targets a settlement or geographic cluster. Determines which of beneficiary_id, household_id, or community_id is populated.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook Chapter 1 — Needs Assessment Methodology; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this needs assessment, used in field reports, SitReps, and donor communications. Format: NA-{COUNTRY}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Sourced from KoboToolbox or CommCare submission ID.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03 — Activity Identifier; KoboToolbox Form Submission Reference

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the needs assessment record. 'draft' indicates field data entry in progress; 'submitted' indicates enumerator submission pending review; 'validated' indicates supervisor-approved and usable for targeting; 'rejected' indicates data quality failure requiring re-assessment.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Data Quality Standards; KoboToolbox Submission Workflow

attributes.name: assessment_tool_version
attributes.description: Version number or deployment date of the assessment tool/form used. Critical for longitudinal comparability — when a KoboToolbox form or CommCare module is updated, findings from different versions may not be directly comparable without version-aware analysis.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Form Versioning; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Comparability Standards

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment's purpose and methodology. 'initial_registration' is conducted at first beneficiary contact; 'periodic_reassessment' is a scheduled follow-up to update vulnerability status; 'post_crisis_rapid' is an emergency rapid assessment following a shock event; 'sector_specific_deep' is an in-depth assessment for a single sector (e.g., nutrition MUAC screening, WASH facility survey).
attributes.references: IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Assessment Types Taxonomy; OCHA Assessment Registry

attributes.name: children_under5_count
attributes.description: Number of children under 5 years of age in the assessed household. Key vulnerability indicator for nutrition (SAM/GAM screening), WASH (diarrhoea risk), and child protection programming. Required for UNICEF and WFP programme targeting.
attributes.references: UNICEF Child Vulnerability Standards; SPHERE Handbook — Nutrition (Under-5 Focus); WFP Targeting Criteria

attributes.name: consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether informed consent was obtained from the beneficiary or household head prior to conducting the assessment. Mandatory per CHS Commitment 4 (Accountability to Affected Populations) and GDPR Article 6 for data processing lawfulness. Must be TRUE for the record to be validated.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Commitment 4 Accountability; GDPR Article 6 Lawful Basis; HAP Standard

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The form of informed consent obtained. 'verbal' is spoken consent recorded by enumerator; 'written' is signed consent form; 'proxy' is consent given by a guardian or community leader on behalf of a vulnerable individual (e.g., child, person with disability). Relevant for legal compliance and data protection audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 — Conditions for Consent; CHS Alliance Data Protection Guidelines; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the assessment was conducted (e.g., 'SOM', 'SSD', 'HTI'). Used for IATI reporting, donor country-level aggregation, and cross-country comparative analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI Standard v2.03 — Country Code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this needs assessment record was first created in the data platform (Silver layer ingestion timestamp). Distinct from assessment_date (field event date). Used for data pipeline monitoring and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 — Record Keeping; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: The primary method used to gather assessment data. 'face_to_face' is direct in-person interview; 'remote_phone' is telephone-based; 'fgd' is a Focus Group Discussion (FGD); 'kii' is a Key Informant Interview (KII); 'observation' is direct field observation without interview; 'secondary_data' is derived from existing records. Affects data quality weighting in vulnerability scoring.
attributes.references: IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Data Collection Methodology; SPHERE Handbook

attributes.name: displacement_status
attributes.description: The displacement classification of the assessed individual or household at the time of assessment. 'idp' = Internally Displaced Person (IDP); 'refugee' = person with international protection status; 'returnee' = person returning to place of origin; 'host_community' = non-displaced community member hosting displaced persons. Critical for UNHCR/OCHA population movement tracking.
attributes.references: UNHCR Refugee Definition (1951 Convention); OCHA IDP Tracking Matrix (DTM); Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement

attributes.name: education_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the education sector assessment findings. Null if education was not included in sectors_assessed. Covers school access, enrollment barriers, learning environment safety, and teacher availability against SPHERE/INEE minimum standards.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Education; INEE Minimum Standards for Education in Emergencies; IASC Education Cluster

attributes.name: enumerator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text qualitative observations recorded by the field enumerator during the assessment. Captures contextual information not covered by structured questions (e.g., security constraints, access limitations, observed conditions). Used by supervisors during validation review.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox — Note Question Type; CommCare — Case Note Field; CHS Alliance Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: female_headed_household
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessed household is headed by a female. Female-headed households are a standard vulnerability marker in humanitarian targeting criteria and are required for gender disaggregation in donor reports (USAID, DFID/FCDO, UN Women standards).
attributes.references: USAID Gender Equality and Female Empowerment Policy; UN Women Humanitarian Action; IASC Gender Marker

attributes.name: gbv_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment identified elevated Gender-Based Violence (GBV) risk for the assessed individual or household. When TRUE, triggers referral to GBV case management pathway and PSS services. Classified as restricted PHI due to extreme sensitivity of GBV disclosure data.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Guidelines; UNHCR GBVIMS Data Protection Protocol; SPHERE Handbook — Protection Principles

attributes.name: gps_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Estimated GPS accuracy in meters at the time of coordinate capture, as reported by the mobile device. KoboToolbox and CommCare record this automatically. Values above 30 meters may indicate unreliable location data and trigger data quality flags.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox GPS Question Type — Accuracy Field; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the assessment location captured by the field enumerator's device via KoboToolbox or CommCare GPS capture. Used for GIS mapping, cluster analysis, and geographic targeting in humanitarian response planning.
attributes.references: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap — WGS84 Coordinate Standard; OCHA GIS Standards

attributes.name: livelihoods_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the livelihoods sector assessment findings. Null if livelihoods was not included in sectors_assessed. Covers income sources, asset ownership, market access, and economic vulnerability indicators.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Livelihoods; IASC Livelihoods Cluster Assessment Framework; USAID BHA Livelihoods Assessment Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the assessment location captured by the field enumerator's device. Used alongside latitude for GIS mapping, spatial clustering, and geographic targeting in humanitarian response planning.
attributes.references: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap — WGS84 Coordinate Standard; OCHA GIS Standards

attributes.name: muac_mm
attributes.description: Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) measurement in millimetres for children under 5 or pregnant/lactating women, used to screen for acute malnutrition. MUAC < 115mm indicates SAM; 115–125mm indicates MAM. Classified as PHI as it is a direct health measurement linked to an individual. Null if not applicable to assessment subject.
attributes.references: WHO MUAC Screening Protocol; SPHERE Handbook — Nutrition; UNICEF MUAC Standards

attributes.name: nutrition_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the nutrition sector assessment findings. Null if nutrition was not included in sectors_assessed. Incorporates Global Acute Malnutrition (GAM) and Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) indicators where applicable. Feeds into DHIS2 nutrition indicator tracking.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Nutrition Chapter; WHO/UNICEF GAM/SAM Thresholds; DHIS2 Nutrition Indicators

attributes.name: overall_vulnerability_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score representing the assessed subject's overall vulnerability level, calculated from sector-specific findings using the program's scoring methodology (e.g., 0–100 scale). Feeds into vulnerability_profile updates when the score materially changes vulnerability classification. This is a raw assessment output, not a derived KPI.
attributes.references: IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Vulnerability Scoring; UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework

attributes.name: persons_with_disability_count
attributes.description: Number of household members with a physical, sensory, intellectual, or psychosocial disability. Required for disability-inclusive programming per IASC Guidelines on Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities in Humanitarian Action and CRPD compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IASC Guidelines on Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities; UN CRPD; Washington Group Short Set on Disability

attributes.name: protection_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the protection sector assessment findings. Null if protection was not included in sectors_assessed. Covers GBV risk, child protection, housing land and property rights, and documentation status. Sensitive findings are handled per GBV information management protocols.
attributes.references: IASC Protection Cluster — Assessment Standards; UNHCR GBV Information Management System (GBVIMS); SPHERE Handbook — Protection Principles

attributes.name: referral_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment findings recommend referral of the beneficiary or household to one or more service providers or program interventions. When TRUE, a referral pathway is initiated in CommCare case management. Drives downstream case management workflow.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Commitment 3 (Referral Pathways); CommCare Case Management Referral Module

attributes.name: referral_sectors
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of sectors to which the beneficiary or household is being referred based on assessment findings (e.g., 'nutrition|PSS|WASH'). Populated only when referral_recommended is TRUE. Drives service pathway activation in CommCare and Microsoft Dynamics 365 case management.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Commitment 3 (Referral Pathways); IASC Cluster Referral Protocols; CommCare Referral Module

attributes.name: sectors_assessed
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of humanitarian/development sectors covered in this assessment (e.g., 'WASH|nutrition|shelter|protection|livelihoods|education'). Sectors align with IASC cluster system. Determines which sector-specific scored findings fields are populated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WASH|nutrition|shelter|protection|livelihoods|education|health|food_security|NFI|PSS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IASC Cluster System — Sector Taxonomy; SPHERE Handbook — Sector Chapters; OCHA Cluster Coordination

attributes.name: shelter_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the shelter sector assessment findings. Null if shelter was not included in sectors_assessed. Assessed against SPHERE minimum standards for covered living space, structural safety, and thermal comfort.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Shelter and Settlement Chapter; IASC Shelter Cluster Assessment Standards

attributes.name: source_submission_reference
attributes.description: The native submission or case ID from the originating source system (KoboToolbox submission UUID or CommCare case ID). Enables exact record traceability back to the source system for data reconciliation, duplicate detection, and audit purposes.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox API — Submission UUID; CommCare API — Case ID; Databricks Silver Layer Lineage

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this assessment record originated. Enables data lineage tracking and source-specific quality rules in the Silver layer. 'KoboToolbox' for field survey submissions; 'CommCare' for mobile case management assessments; 'manual_entry' for paper-based data entry.
attributes.references: IATI Standard — Data Provenance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer — Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: supervisor_validation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the supervising data manager or MEL officer during the assessment review and validation process. Documents reasons for rejection, data quality concerns, or approval rationale. Populated when assessment_status transitions to 'validated' or 'rejected'.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Data Quality and Accountability Standards; MEAL Framework — Data Verification Protocols

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this needs assessment record was most recently modified in the data platform. Tracks post-ingestion corrections, validation status changes, and supervisor note additions. Required for Silver layer change data capture (CDC) processing.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer — CDC Standards; CHS Alliance Data Management Principles

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the assessment record was validated or rejected by the supervising staff member. Distinct from assessment_date (field event) and created_timestamp (record creation). Used for SLA monitoring of data quality review turnaround.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Data Quality Standards; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: vulnerability_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the assessed subject's vulnerability level derived from the overall_vulnerability_score and program-specific thresholds. Used for beneficiary targeting, prioritization, and service referral decisions. 'critical' triggers immediate case management escalation.
attributes.references: UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Vulnerability Classification

attributes.name: wash_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) Sector Score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) sector assessment findings. Null if WASH was not included in sectors_assessed. Scored against SPHERE minimum standards for water access, sanitation facilities, and hygiene promotion.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — WASH Chapter; IASC WASH Cluster Assessment Standards

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Formal consent management record capturing a beneficiary's informed consent for data collection, storage, sharing, and program participation. Stores consent type (data processing, photography, case referral, biometric enrollment), consent status (given, withdrawn, pending), consent date, consent method (verbal, written, digital), language of consent, witness details, and CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard) accountability compliance flags.
products.reference: CHS Commitment 4 / GDPR / HAP Accountability Standards

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each consent record. Primary key for the consent_record data product within the beneficiary domain.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — CHS Commitment 4 (Accountability to Affected Populations)

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Reference to the humanitarian or development program for which consent is being obtained. Enables program-level consent tracking and MEL reporting.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Program Management Module; IATI Standard

attributes.name: donor_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.donor_requirement. Business justification: Specific donor agreements mandate consent collection standards (GDPR for EU donors, safeguarding protocols, data sharing permissions). Consent records demonstrate fulfillment of these contractual comp

attributes.name: primary_consent_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member or field worker who witnessed the consent process. Links to the workforce staff_member record for accountability and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the beneficiary (individual, household head, or community representative) whose consent is being recorded. Links to the beneficiary master record in CommCare or KoboToolbox.
attributes.references: CommCare Beneficiary Registration Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4

attributes.name: biometric_enrollment_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has consented to biometric data enrollment (fingerprint, iris scan, facial recognition) for identity verification and deduplication purposes. True = biometric enrollment permitted; False = not permitted.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9 (Special Categories of Personal Data); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; UNHCR Biometric Data Policy

attributes.name: chs_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record meets all requirements of the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4 on accountability to affected populations. True = CHS compliant; False = non-compliant or pending review. Used in CHS certification audits.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — CHS Commitment 4; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: collection_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country where consent was collected (e.g., 'SOM' for Somalia, 'SSD' for South Sudan). Supports multi-country program reporting and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; IATI Standard; OCHA (Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs) Reporting Standards

attributes.name: collection_location
attributes.description: Name or description of the physical location where consent was collected (e.g., registration site name, health facility, IDP camp name, community center). Supports geographic analysis and field operations reporting.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; OCHA (Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs) Reporting Standards

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the beneficiary provided, withdrew, or refused consent. This is the principal real-world event date for the consent transaction, distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: consent_form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent form template used at the time of consent collection (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Enables tracking of which version of the consent language and terms the beneficiary agreed to, critical for compliance audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: consent_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-3 language code representing the language in which consent was communicated and obtained. Ensures accountability that consent was given in the beneficiary's understood language (e.g., 'ar' for Arabic, 'fr' for French, 'so' for Somali). Critical for CHS accountability compliance.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; ISO 639-1 Language Codes; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The method by which consent was obtained from the beneficiary. 'verbal' for spoken agreement (audio-recorded or witnessed); 'written' for signed paper form; 'digital' for electronic signature or mobile app confirmation; 'thumbprint' for biometric ink impression; 'proxy' for consent given by a guardian or authorized representative on behalf of a minor or incapacitated individual.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; GDPR Article 7; KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards

attributes.name: consent_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference code assigned to this consent record, used in field operations, case referrals, and compliance reporting. Format: CNS-[COUNTRY]-[YEAR]-[SEQUENCE].
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; IATI Transparency Standard

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent record. 'given' indicates active informed consent; 'withdrawn' indicates the beneficiary has revoked consent; 'pending' indicates consent is awaited; 'expired' indicates the consent period has lapsed; 'refused' indicates explicit refusal.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specific type of consent being recorded. Covers data processing consent (GDPR/privacy), photography and media use, inter-agency case referral, biometric enrollment, program participation, and research/survey participation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: data_processing|photography_media|case_referral|biometric_enrollment|program_participation|research_survey — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; GDPR Article 6; IATI Standard; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting data lineage, compliance reporting, and GDPR accountability obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) (Accountability Principle); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: data_retention_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days for which the beneficiary's data may be retained under this consent, as agreed at the time of consent collection. Drives automated data retention and deletion workflows. Aligned with GDPR storage limitation principle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) (Storage Limitation); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: data_scope
attributes.description: Description of the specific data elements, activities, or purposes covered by this consent record (e.g., 'collection and storage of household survey data', 'sharing of case data with UNHCR for referral'). Defines the boundaries of what the beneficiary has consented to.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(b) (Purpose Limitation); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; IATI Standard

attributes.name: digital_signature_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or hash of the digital signature captured when consent_method is 'digital'. Links to the secure digital signature storage system. Not the signature itself — a reference token for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; eIDAS Regulation (EU Electronic Signatures); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the consent becomes legally and operationally binding. May differ from consent_date if there is a processing delay or a future-dated consent arrangement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent expires and must be renewed. Nullable for open-ended consents. Supports automated consent renewal workflows and compliance with data retention policies.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) (Storage Limitation); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; IATI Standard

attributes.name: form_attachment_reference
attributes.description: File path, URL, or document management system reference to the scanned or digital copy of the signed consent form. Enables retrieval of the original consent document for audit and legal purposes.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies to this consent record based on the beneficiary's location, the organization's jurisdiction, or the data controller's domicile. True = GDPR applies; False = GDPR does not apply.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 (Territorial Scope); GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing)

attributes.name: informed_consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether a supervisor or quality assurance officer has verified that the consent was truly informed (i.e., the beneficiary understood the purpose, scope, and their rights before consenting). True = verified; False = pending verification.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: is_proxy_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether consent was given by a proxy (guardian, parent, or authorized representative) on behalf of a minor, elderly, or incapacitated beneficiary. True = proxy consent; False = direct consent from the beneficiary.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; GDPR Article 8 (Conditions for Child Consent)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional contextual notes about the consent process, any special circumstances, beneficiary concerns raised, or follow-up actions required. Used by field staff and MEL officers for qualitative documentation.

attributes.name: photography_permitted

attributes.name: proxy_name
attributes.description: Full name of the proxy individual (guardian, parent, or authorized representative) who provided consent on behalf of the beneficiary. Populated only when is_proxy_consent is True.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: proxy_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the proxy consent giver to the beneficiary (e.g., parent, guardian, legal representative). Populated only when is_proxy_consent is True. attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; GDPR Article 8

attributes.name: sharing_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has consented to their data being shared with third-party organizations (e.g., partner NGOs, UN agencies, government bodies). True = sharing permitted; False = sharing not permitted. Critical for inter-agency data sharing compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: sharing_restrictions
attributes.description: Free-text description of any specific restrictions or conditions placed by the beneficiary on data sharing (e.g., 'not to be shared with government authorities', 'only for health program purposes'). Populated when sharing_permitted is True but with conditions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this consent record in the originating operational system (CommCare case ID, KoboToolbox submission UUID, Dynamics 365 record ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and source systems.
attributes.references: IATI Standard; Internal Data Lineage and Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this consent record was captured or ingested (e.g., CommCare for mobile case management, KoboToolbox for field surveys, Dynamics 365 for case management, Salesforce for constituent tracking, or manual for paper-based entry).
attributes.references: IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was most recently modified. Tracks consent status changes, withdrawals, and verification updates for audit trail and data governance purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) (Accountability Principle); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: verification_date

attributes.name: withdrawal_date

attributes.name: witness_name

products.description: Transactional record of a beneficiary registration or re-registration event capturing the specific registration session details. Stores registration date, registration location, registration modality (in-person, mobile, remote), registration tool (KoboToolbox, CommCare, paper), registering staff, verification documents presented, registration completeness score, and any deduplication checks performed. Provides full audit trail of how and when a beneficiary entered the system.
products.reference: UNHCR Registration Guidelines / KoboToolbox Registration Form

attributes.name: registration_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the beneficiary registration event. Primary key for the registration event record.

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the humanitarian or development program under which this registration was conducted.

attributes.name: project_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.project_site. Business justification: Registration events are held at specific field sites. Direct business relationship for event management, site capacity planning, and registration campaign tracking. Replaces denormalized location name

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the beneficiary who was registered or re-registered in this event.

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member or field worker who conducted the registration session.

attributes.name: biometric_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether biometric data (fingerprint, iris scan, facial recognition) was captured during this registration event.
attributes.references: UNHCR Biometric Identity Management System (BIMS) Standards

attributes.name: biometric_type
attributes.description: Type of biometric data captured during registration: fingerprint, iris scan, facial recognition, or none.
attributes.references: UNHCR Biometric Identity Management System (BIMS) Standards

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which informed consent was obtained from the beneficiary.

attributes.name: consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether informed consent for data collection and processing was obtained from the beneficiary during registration.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Type of consent obtained: verbal, written, digital signature, or guardian consent (for minors or vulnerable individuals).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7, UNHCR Data Protection Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration event record was first created in the data system.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Assessment of the overall data quality for this registration event: high, medium, low, or needs review.
attributes.references: Monitoring Evaluation Accountability and Learning (MEAL) Framework

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application from which this registration event data was extracted (e.g., CommCare, KoboToolbox, UNHCR PRIMES).

attributes.name: deduplication_check_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a deduplication check was performed during registration to prevent duplicate beneficiary records.

attributes.name: deduplication_method
attributes.description: Method used for deduplication check: biometric matching, demographic matching, document number verification, manual review, or none.

attributes.name: duplicate_found
attributes.description: Indicates whether a potential duplicate beneficiary record was identified during the deduplication check.

attributes.name: duplicate_resolution_status
attributes.description: Status of duplicate resolution: no duplicate found, duplicate confirmed and merged, duplicate resolved, or pending manual review.

attributes.name: household_head
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registered beneficiary is designated as the head of household for program purposes.

attributes.name: household_registration
attributes.description: Indicates whether this registration event was part of a household-level registration (true) or individual-only registration (false).

attributes.name: interpreter_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether an interpreter was used during the registration session due to language barriers.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration event record was last updated or modified in the data system.

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary requires referral to specialized services (protection, health, psychosocial support) based on registration screening.

attributes.name: referral_type
attributes.description: Type of referral service required: protection, health, psychosocial support (PSS), legal aid, livelihood, education, or other specialized services. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: protection|health|pss|legal_aid|livelihood|education|nutrition|wash|shelter|none — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: registering_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization (INGO, CBO, CSO) that conducted the registration, relevant for consortium or partnership programs.

attributes.name: registering_staff_name
attributes.description: Full name of the staff member or field worker who conducted the registration for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: registration_completeness_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0-100) indicating the completeness of data captured during registration based on required and optional fields.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the beneficiary registration or re-registration event occurred.

attributes.name: registration_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-3 three-letter language code indicating the language used during the registration interview or data collection.

attributes.name: registration_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the registration location in decimal degrees format.

attributes.name: registration_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the registration location in decimal degrees format.

attributes.name: registration_modality
attributes.description: The modality or method through which the registration was conducted: in-person at center, mobile outreach, remote digital, phone interview, or community-based registration.

attributes.name: registration_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for registering staff to capture additional observations, special circumstances, or contextual information about the registration event.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique registration number assigned to the beneficiary during this event. Format: Country-Year-Sequence (e.g., SYR-2024-000123).

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current status of the registration event in the workflow: draft, pending verification, verified, approved, rejected, or incomplete.

attributes.name: registration_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the registration session was initiated, including time zone information.

attributes.name: registration_tool
attributes.description: The data collection tool or system used to capture registration information: KoboToolbox, CommCare, paper form, UNHCR PRIMES, custom application, or other.
attributes.references: ICT4D (Information and Communication Technology for Development) Standards

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Type of registration event: initial registration, re-registration, profile update, verification visit, or biometric enrollment.

attributes.name: verification_document_number
attributes.description: The document number or identifier from the verification document presented during registration.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, UNHCR Data Protection Policy

attributes.name: verification_document_type
attributes.description: Type of identity or verification document presented during registration (e.g., national ID, passport, birth certificate, ration card, IDP card). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: national_id|passport|birth_certificate|ration_card|idp_card|refugee_certificate|voter_id|driver_license|none — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vulnerability_assessment_conducted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a vulnerability or needs assessment was conducted as part of this registration event.

products.name: displacement_history
products.description: Longitudinal record tracking the displacement journey of an IDP, refugee, or asylum-seeker beneficiary over time. Each record represents a displacement episode with origin location, displacement trigger (armed conflict, generalized violence, natural disaster, climate event, development project), displacement date, transit locations, current settlement/camp/host community, displacement status per IASC framework (newly displaced, protracted displaced, returned, resettled, locally integrated), and duration. Multiple records per registrant enable full journey mapping. Supports durable solutions planning, return and reintegration programming, OCHA displacement tracking, UNHCR population statistics reporting, and IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) data exchange. Interoperable with UNHCR proGres displacement records and OCHA HDX displacement datasets.
products.reference: IDMC Displacement Tracking / UNHCR Durable Solutions Framework / DTM (Displacement Tracking Matrix)

attributes.name: displacement_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each displacement episode record. Primary key for the displacement history tracking system.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres Data Model, IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) Standards

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the beneficiary registrant who experienced this displacement episode. Links to the master beneficiary registry.

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the field staff member or enumerator who collected this displacement history record. Used for data quality audits and enumerator performance tracking.
attributes.references: Field Data Collection Quality Assurance Standards

attributes.name: current_admin1_code
attributes.description: First-level administrative division code of current displacement location. Supports sub-national operational planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs), Humanitarian OpenStreetMap P-codes

attributes.name: current_admin2_code
attributes.description: Second-level administrative division code of current displacement location. Enables district-level service delivery planning.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs), Humanitarian OpenStreetMap P-codes

attributes.name: current_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the current displacement location. Used for asylum country statistics and cross-border displacement tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, UNHCR Population Statistics Standards

attributes.name: current_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the current displacement location. Enables real-time displacement mapping and proximity analysis to services.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate System, Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Standards

attributes.name: current_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the current displacement location. Enables real-time displacement mapping and proximity analysis to services.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate System, Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Standards

attributes.name: current_settlement_name
attributes.description: Name of the camp, collective center, or settlement where the beneficiary currently resides. Links to site-level service provision and infrastructure data.
attributes.references: UNHCR Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM) Standards

attributes.name: current_settlement_type
attributes.description: Type of settlement where the displaced person currently resides. Determines applicable assistance modalities and service delivery approaches.
attributes.references: UNHCR Settlement Classification Standards, Sphere Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: data_collection_date
attributes.description: Date when this displacement history record was collected in the field. Distinct from displacement date; used for data currency assessment.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Data Collection Standards, CommCare Field Data Guidelines

attributes.name: data_collection_tool
attributes.description: Digital or manual tool used to collect this displacement history record. Supports data quality assessment and system interoperability.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox, CommCare, UNHCR proGres, IOM DTM Standards

attributes.name: displacement_date
attributes.description: Date when the beneficiary was displaced from their origin location. Key timestamp for calculating displacement duration and eligibility for time-bound assistance programs.

attributes.name: displacement_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days since the displacement date. Calculated field used to classify protracted vs. acute displacement and determine eligibility for durable solutions programs.

attributes.name: displacement_episode_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this displacement episode for the registrant. Enables tracking of multiple displacement events over time (1st displacement, 2nd displacement, etc.).

attributes.name: displacement_status
attributes.description: Current displacement status of the beneficiary per IASC (Inter-Agency Standing Committee) framework. Tracks the stage in the displacement journey and informs durable solutions planning.
attributes.references: IASC Framework on Durable Solutions for Internally Displaced Persons, UNHCR Durable Solutions Framework

attributes.name: displacement_trigger
attributes.description: Primary cause or trigger event that forced the displacement. Critical for root cause analysis, advocacy, and targeted intervention design.
attributes.references: IDMC (Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre) Global Report Categories, Sphere Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: displacement_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of field verification of the displacement claim. Verified status is required for eligibility determination in most assistance programs.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration and Identity Management Standards

attributes.name: hdx_dataset_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the OCHA HDX dataset from which this displacement record was sourced or to which it was contributed. Supports open data sharing and interoperability.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the current active displacement episode for the registrant. False for historical/closed episodes. Supports temporal queries.

attributes.name: is_cross_border
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the displacement crossed an international border (refugee) or remained within the country of origin (IDP). Determines applicable legal frameworks and assistance mandates.
attributes.references: 1951 Refugee Convention, UNHCR Mandate, Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement

attributes.name: is_protracted
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the displacement has lasted 5 or more years, meeting UNHCR definition of protracted displacement. Triggers eligibility for long-term development programming.

attributes.name: local_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of local integration as a durable solution. Tracks progress toward legal, economic, and social integration in the host community.
attributes.references: UNHCR Local Integration Framework, IASC Durable Solutions Indicators

attributes.name: origin_admin1_code
attributes.description: First-level administrative division code (state/province/region) of origin location. Enables sub-national displacement pattern analysis.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs), Humanitarian OpenStreetMap P-codes

attributes.name: origin_admin2_code
attributes.description: Second-level administrative division code (district/county) of origin location. Provides granular displacement origin tracking for targeted return programming.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs), Humanitarian OpenStreetMap P-codes

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country from which the beneficiary was displaced. Used for population statistics and country-of-origin analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, UNHCR Population Statistics Standards

attributes.name: origin_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the origin location. Enables GIS mapping of displacement flows and spatial analysis.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate System, Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Standards

attributes.name: origin_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the origin location. Enables GIS mapping of displacement flows and spatial analysis.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate System, Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Standards

attributes.name: origin_settlement_name
attributes.description: Name of the village, town, or settlement from which the beneficiary was displaced. Supports community-level return and reintegration planning.
attributes.references: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) Location Standards

attributes.name: poc_category
attributes.description: UNHCR Person of Concern category classification. Determines eligibility for specific protection and assistance programs.
attributes.references: UNHCR Population Statistics Reference Guide, UNHCR proGres PoC Categories

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this displacement history record was first created in the lakehouse. System audit field for data lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this displacement history record was last updated in the lakehouse. System audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: resettlement_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the third country to which the beneficiary was resettled, if applicable. Null for non-resettlement cases.

attributes.name: resettlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the beneficiary was resettled to a third country. Null for non-resettlement cases. Marks the end of the displacement episode.

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Date when the beneficiary returned to their origin location, if applicable. Null for ongoing displacement. Used to calculate return rates and monitor return sustainability.
attributes.references: UNHCR Voluntary Repatriation Standards, IOM Return Monitoring Guidelines

attributes.name: return_intention
attributes.description: Beneficiary stated intention regarding return to origin location. Informs durable solutions planning and return program design.
attributes.references: UNHCR Durable Solutions Framework, IOM Return and Reintegration Standards

attributes.name: return_type
attributes.description: Classification of the return modality. Voluntary return is the preferred durable solution per international humanitarian standards.
attributes.references: UNHCR Voluntary Repatriation Handbook, Sphere Protection Principles

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this record in the originating operational system (proGres, DTM, KoboToolbox). Enables traceability and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: transit_locations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of intermediate locations or waypoints during the displacement journey. Documents the full displacement route for protection risk analysis.
attributes.references: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) Flow Monitoring

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the displacement episode was verified through field assessment or documentation review. Null for unverified cases.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration and Identity Management Standards

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the displacement episode. Field visit and document review are considered most reliable.
attributes.references: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) Verification Standards

products.name: exit_record
products.description: Transactional record documenting a beneficiary's formal deactivation from the beneficiary registry. Captures exit date, exit reason (program graduation, voluntary withdrawal, relocation out of service area, death, loss of contact, loss of eligibility, duplicate record merge), exit assessment outcome, data retention classification per CHS and GDPR data minimization requirements, post-exit follow-up plan, and responsible staff. Distinct from program-level graduation — this records the beneficiary ceasing to be an active registrant in the system.
products.reference: UNHCR Durable Solutions / CHS Data Minimization / Program Graduation Framework

attributes.name: exit_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the beneficiary exit record. Primary key for the exit_record product.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household unit to which the exiting beneficiary belonged at time of exit. Used for household-level impact analysis and to track whether entire household exited or only individual members.

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary program from which the beneficiary is exiting. Links to the program product in the program domain. Note that this represents registry-level exit, distinct from program-specific graduation.

attributes.name: primary_exit_registrant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the beneficiary who is exiting the registry. Links to the registrant product in the beneficiary domain.

attributes.name: primary_exit_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who processed and approved the beneficiary exit. Links to the staff_member product in the workforce domain for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this exit record was first created in the data lakehouse. Part of standard audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: data_deletion_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Calculated date when beneficiary data is scheduled for deletion or anonymization based on exit date and retention period. Used by data governance processes to enforce retention policies.

attributes.name: data_retention_classification
attributes.description: Classification determining how beneficiary data should be handled post-exit per data minimization and privacy requirements. Retain full means keep all data for ongoing monitoring; retain anonymized means remove PII but keep aggregated data; archive means move to long-term storage; delete means purge per right to be forgotten.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 5, Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: data_retention_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months that beneficiary data will be retained post-exit before archival or deletion. Determined by donor requirements, legal obligations, and organizational data retention policies.
attributes.references: Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: death_certificate_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a death certificate or official mortality documentation was verified for exits due to death. Required for audit and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: Vital Statistics and Civil Registration Standards

attributes.name: death_date
attributes.description: Date of death as documented in official records or reported by family members. Populated only for exits with exit_reason_category of death.
attributes.references: Vital Statistics and Civil Registration Standards

attributes.name: exit_assessment_conducted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a formal exit assessment or interview was conducted with the beneficiary prior to exit. Required for program graduation and voluntary withdrawal cases per Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) accountability requirements.

attributes.name: exit_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the exit assessment or final interview was conducted with the beneficiary. Used for Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL) tracking and accountability reporting.

attributes.name: exit_assessment_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes and observations from the exit assessment interview. Captures beneficiary feedback, lessons learned, and recommendations for program improvement per Monitoring Evaluation Accountability and Learning (MEAL) requirements.
attributes.references: Monitoring Evaluation Accountability and Learning (MEAL) Framework

attributes.name: exit_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Overall outcome classification from the exit assessment. Positive indicates beneficiary achieved program objectives; neutral indicates partial achievement; negative indicates unmet objectives; not applicable for exits without assessment (death, loss of contact).

attributes.name: exit_consent_date
attributes.description: Date when beneficiary consent for exit was obtained. Used for legal compliance and audit trail of consent management.

attributes.name: exit_consent_method
attributes.description: Method by which exit consent was obtained from the beneficiary. Verbal for in-person oral consent; written for signed paper forms; digital for electronic signature; proxy for consent obtained through authorized representative.

attributes.name: exit_consent_obtained
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether explicit consent was obtained from the beneficiary for the exit and associated data handling. Required for voluntary withdrawals and data deletion per GDPR and CHS standards.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 7, Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: exit_date
attributes.description: The date on which the beneficiary formally exited the beneficiary registry. Represents the effective date of deactivation from active registrant status.

attributes.name: exit_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the field office, distribution center, or facility where the exit was processed. Used for operational tracking and geographic analysis of exit patterns.

attributes.name: exit_location_code
attributes.description: Three-letter code representing the geographic location where the exit was processed. Follows ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code standard or internal location coding scheme.

attributes.name: exit_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the exit record, formatted as EXT- followed by 8 digits. Used for tracking and reference in case management systems.

attributes.name: exit_reason_category
attributes.description: Primary category describing why the beneficiary is exiting the registry. Program graduation indicates successful completion of assistance; voluntary withdrawal is beneficiary-initiated; relocation means moved out of service area; death is confirmed mortality; loss of contact means unable to reach beneficiary; loss of eligibility means no longer meets program criteria.

attributes.name: exit_reason_detail
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the specific circumstances surrounding the beneficiary exit. Provides context beyond the category for case management and Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL) purposes.

attributes.name: exit_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the exit record. Pending indicates awaiting supervisor approval; approved means exit authorized but not yet finalized; completed means exit fully processed and beneficiary deactivated; reversed means exit was cancelled and beneficiary reactivated.

attributes.name: exit_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the exit record was created in the system, capturing the exact moment of registry deactivation.

attributes.name: is_duplicate_merge
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this exit was triggered by a duplicate record merge operation. True means this record was identified as a duplicate and merged into another master record; false means exit was for other reasons.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this exit record was last modified in the data lakehouse. Updated whenever any attribute value changes. Part of standard audit trail.

attributes.name: post_exit_followup_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next post-exit follow-up contact or assessment. Used to track ongoing monitoring obligations for graduated beneficiaries.

attributes.name: post_exit_followup_plan
attributes.description: Detailed plan for post-exit monitoring activities including timeline, methods, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to be tracked. Used for Post-Distribution Monitoring (PDM) and impact assessment.

attributes.name: post_exit_followup_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether post-exit follow-up monitoring is required for this beneficiary. Typically true for program graduation cases to assess sustainability of outcomes per Results-Based Management (RBM) frameworks.

attributes.name: reactivation_conditions
attributes.description: Description of the conditions or criteria under which the beneficiary could be reactivated in the registry. Used for case management decision-making if beneficiary returns to service area.

attributes.name: reactivation_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the beneficiary is eligible for reactivation in the registry if circumstances change. True for voluntary withdrawals and relocations; false for deaths and duplicate merges.

attributes.name: referral_organization_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization or service provider to which the beneficiary was referred at exit. Supports coordination and continuity of care in the humanitarian ecosystem.

attributes.name: referral_provided
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the beneficiary was provided with referrals to other services or organizations at exit. Part of responsible exit protocol per Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) commitment to do no harm.

attributes.name: referral_service_type
attributes.description: Type of service or assistance the beneficiary was referred to (e.g., health, education, livelihood, protection, legal aid). Enables tracking of referral pathways and inter-agency collaboration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health|education|livelihood|protection|legal_aid|psychosocial_support|shelter|wash|nutrition — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: relocation_destination_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country to which the beneficiary relocated. Populated for exits due to relocation out of service area.

attributes.name: relocation_destination_location
attributes.description: Detailed location information (city, district, camp name) where the beneficiary relocated. Used for potential referrals and inter-agency coordination.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system where the exit record was originally created (e.g., CommCare, KoboToolbox, Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud). Used for data lineage and integration tracking.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this exit record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation between lakehouse and operational systems.

products.name: document_record
products.description: Master record of identity and legal documents associated with a beneficiary, including UNHCR registration certificates, national ID cards, birth certificates, marriage certificates, asylum seeker cards, and travel documents. Captures document type, document number, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, verification status, and document image reference. Supports identity verification, legal status determination, and protection documentation.
products.reference: UNHCR Registration Documentation Standards / Legal Identity Agenda

attributes.name: document_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the document record. Primary key for the document_record product.

attributes.name: donor_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.donor_requirement. Business justification: Donor requirements mandate specific document verification standards (identity verification, legal status, eligibility documentation). Links document records to the compliance requirements they fulfill

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the humanitarian or development program under which this document was collected or verified.

attributes.name: primary_document_user_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or staff member who created this document record in the system. Supports accountability and audit trail.
attributes.references: Workforce Domain Master Data Standard; Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the beneficiary who owns or is associated with this document.

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who performed the document verification.

attributes.name: capture_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the mobile device, scanner, or workstation used to capture the document. Supports audit trail and data quality tracking.
attributes.references: Mobile Data Collection Standards; Information and Communication Technology for Development (ICT4D) Standards

attributes.name: capture_method
attributes.description: The method used to capture the document information into the system (e.g., mobile scan via KoboToolbox, flatbed scanner, photograph, manual data entry).
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Data Collection Standards; CommCare Mobile Data Standards

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level indicating the sensitivity of the document and the access controls required. Aligns with organizational data governance policies.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework; GDPR Article 32 (Security of Processing); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the beneficiary provided consent for document collection and processing. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Standard; GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent)

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The method by which consent was obtained from the beneficiary (e.g., written signature, verbal consent recorded, digital signature, biometric confirmation).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: consent_obtained
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the beneficiary provided informed consent for the collection, storage, and use of this document. True if consent was obtained.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); Humanitarian Accountability Partnership (HAP)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this document record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the beneficiary consented to sharing this document with partner organizations or coordination bodies. True if sharing consent was obtained.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing); Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC) Data Responsibility Guidelines

attributes.name: document_condition
attributes.description: Physical condition of the document at the time of registration or verification. Impacts reliability for identity verification.

attributes.name: document_image_reference
attributes.description: File path, URL, or storage reference to the scanned or photographed image of the document. Used for audit and verification purposes.
attributes.references: Data Protection and Privacy Standards; GDPR Article 32 (Security of Processing)

attributes.name: document_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-2 language code indicating the primary language in which the document is written.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric identifier printed on the document by the issuing authority. Used for identity verification and legal status determination.
attributes.references: UNHCR Protection Standards; International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Document Standards

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the identity or legal document. Common types include UNHCR registration certificates, national ID cards, birth certificates, marriage certificates, asylum seeker cards, and travel documents.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration Standards; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document expires and is no longer valid for legal or identification purposes. Nullable for documents without expiration (e.g., birth certificates). Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Standard; UNHCR Protection Standards

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier used by external systems, partner organizations, or coordination platforms (e.g., UNHCR proGres ID, OCHA reference number) to cross-reference this document.
attributes.references: Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC) Data Standards; UNHCR proGres Integration Standards

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this document record is currently active and valid for use in program operations. False if the record has been superseded, invalidated, or archived.

attributes.name: is_primary_identity_document
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this document is the primary identity document for the beneficiary. True if this is the main document used for identity verification.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document was officially issued by the authority. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The government agency, international organization, or official body that issued the document (e.g., Ministry of Interior, UNHCR, National Registration Bureau).
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration Standards; National Civil Registration Standards

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country or territory where the document was issued.

attributes.name: legal_status_indicator
attributes.description: The legal status of the beneficiary as evidenced by this document. Supports protection case management and eligibility determination for humanitarian assistance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: refugee|asylum_seeker|idp|stateless|citizen|resident|undocumented — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this document record was last modified or updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, comments, or context about the document that do not fit into structured fields. Used by case workers and protection officers.
attributes.references: Case Management Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: registration_location_code
attributes.description: Code or identifier of the field location, camp, or registration center where the document was recorded into the system.
attributes.references: Field Operations Domain Standard; Geographic Information System (GIS) Standards

attributes.name: retention_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days for which this document record must be retained according to organizational policy, donor requirements, or legal obligations. After this period, the record may be archived or deleted.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.333 (Retention Requirements for Records)

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this document record in the source operational system. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Master Data Management (MDM) Standards; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operational system from which this document record originated (e.g., CommCare, KoboToolbox, Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud).
attributes.references: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Integration Standards; Master Data Management (MDM) Standards

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document was last verified by authorized staff. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Standard; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method or process used to verify the authenticity of the document (e.g., visual inspection, biometric matching, confirmation with issuing authority).
attributes.references: UNHCR Protection Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current verification state of the document. Indicates whether the document has been authenticated by program staff or partner organizations.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); UNHCR Protection Standards

products.name: community
products.description: Master record for a community, settlement, camp, or geographic area registered as a collective beneficiary unit for area-based humanitarian programming. Captures community name, geographic coordinates, administrative boundaries (admin1-admin4), settlement type (formal camp, informal settlement, host community, collective center, transit site), estimated population, community leadership contacts, community-level vulnerability indicators (access to water, sanitation coverage, health facility proximity), registration date, and active program associations. Enables community-based targeting for WASH, shelter, food security, and livelihoods interventions where the unit of assistance is the community rather than individual or household. Supports OCHA Common Operational Dataset (COD) alignment and 3W (Who does What Where) reporting.

attributes.name: community_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the community, settlement, camp, or geographic area registered as a collective beneficiary unit. Primary key for the community entity.

attributes.name: partner_org_id
