Captures assessment date, project site, methodology, target population, sample size, assessment team, KoboToolbox or CommCare form ID, data collection tool, key findings summary, recommendations, and assessment status (planned, in-progress, completed, validated). For PDM assessments: captures linked distribution event, sample methodology, utilization rate, adequacy score, beneficiary satisfaction, complaints received, and protection concerns noted. Links to assessment_response for individual submissions. Supports MEL indicator tracking, SitRep generation, CHS compliance, accountability to affected populations (AAP), and donor reporting on program quality.

products.name: assessment_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between field assessments and volunteers who serve as enumerators or team members. It captures the operational reality that assessments are conducted by multi-person teams, and volunteers participate in multiple assessments over time. Each record links one assessment to one volunteer with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific participation: the volunteer's role in that assessment, their performance metrics, and training completion status for that particular assessment methodology.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit field operations, assessments (FGDs, KIIs, household surveys, PDM, MUAC screening) are conducted by multi-person enumerator teams, and volunteers participate in multiple assessments over time across different projects and methodologies. The business actively manages assessment participation as an operational entity: field coordinators recruit volunteers for specific assessments, assign roles (lead vs. enumerator), track data quality scores per volunteer per assessment, verify methodology-specific training completion, and use this data for volunteer performance management and future assignment decisions.

attributes.name: assessment_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this assessment participation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the field assessment in which this volunteer participated

attributes.name: volunteer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the volunteer who participated in this assessment

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this volunteer was assigned to this assessment team. Supports audit trail and recruitment timeline tracking.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this volunteer completed their participation in this assessment. Used for timesheet validation and operational reporting.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score (0-100) assigned to this volunteer's data collection work on this specific assessment, based on completeness, consistency, skip logic adherence, and validation checks. Used for MEL quality assurance, volunteer performance management, and determining eligibility for future assessments. This is participation-specific—the same volunteer may have different quality scores across different assessments.

attributes.name: enumerator_role
attributes.description: The specific role this volunteer performed in this assessment. Values include lead (team lead), enumerator (data collector), facilitator (for FGDs), translator (language support), supervisor (quality oversight). This attribute exists only in the context of a specific assessment participation—the same volunteer may be lead on one assessment and enumerator on another.

attributes.name: participation_date
attributes.description: The date this volunteer participated in the assessment fieldwork. May differ from assessment_date if the assessment spanned multiple days and this volunteer only participated on specific days. Supports attendance tracking and per-diem calculation.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of this volunteer's participation in this assessment. Tracks lifecycle from recruitment through completion. Values: confirmed (volunteer committed), completed (fieldwork done), cancelled (volunteer withdrew), no_show (volunteer did not appear). Supports operational coordination and volunteer reliability tracking.

attributes.name: surveys_completed_count
attributes.description: Number of individual survey submissions, interviews, or FGD sessions this volunteer completed during this assessment. Used for productivity tracking, workload balancing, and incentive calculation. This is assessment-specific—cannot be stored on volunteer (varies by assessment) or assessment (varies by volunteer).

attributes.name: training_completion_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether this volunteer completed the methodology-specific training required for this assessment (e.g., MUAC screening training, PDM interview protocol, KoboToolbox form training). Values: completed (training done), not_required (volunteer already certified), pending (scheduled), incomplete (did not complete). products.name: distribution_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation of volunteers in distribution events. It captures the operational assignment of volunteers to specific distribution events, including their role, shift timing, hours worked, beneficiaries served, and performance assessment. Each record links one distribution_event to one volunteer with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific participation instance.. Existence Justification: Distribution events in humanitarian operations require multiple volunteers working in different functional roles (registration, verification, commodity handling, crowd management, translation), and volunteers participate in multiple distribution events over time. The organization actively manages volunteer assignments to distribution events, tracking role-specific performance, hours worked, beneficiaries served, and attendance for each participation instance. This is an operational business process, not an analytical correlation.

products.description: Logical Framework (LogFrame) master records defining the results chain hierarchy for each program or grant. Each logframe captures the full intervention logic: goal (impact), purpose (outcome), outputs, activities, assumptions, risks, and objectively verifiable indicators (OVIs) at each level. Includes Theory of Change (ToC) components as embedded rows within the hierarchy. Aligns with DAC evaluation criteria, RBM standards, and donor-specific logframe templates (DFID/FCDO, USAID, EU, ECHO). Links to indicator targets for performance tracking and supports results framework reporting.

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Transactional record of all procurement purchase orders issued to vendors for humanitarian commodities and services, including embedded line-item detail (commodity, quantity, unit price, delivery schedule per line). Captures RFQ number, issuing office, commodity/service specifications, quantity, submission deadline, evaluation criteria, list of invited vendors, vendor responses with offered unit prices and delivery terms, bid evaluation scores, award decision, and RFQ status (open/closed/awarded/cancelled). Supports transparent competitive bidding per 2 CFR 200 procurement standards, organizational procurement policy thresholds, and value-for-money documentation for donor audits.
products.reference: Request for Quotation (RFQ) / Invitation to Bid (ITB)

products.name: bid
products.description: This association product represents the Bid or Quotation submitted by a vendor in response to a Request for Quotation (RFQ). It captures the complete bid submission including pricing, technical proposal, evaluation scores, and award decision. Each record links one RFQ to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific bid submission. Essential for procurement audit trails, competitive bidding transparency, and donor compliance reporting per 2 CFR 200 procurement standards.. Existence Justification: In humanitarian procurement operations, RFQs are issued to multiple vendors during competitive bidding processes, and each vendor submits a formal bid with pricing, technical proposals, and delivery terms. The business actively manages each bid submission through evaluation scoring, ranking, and award decisions. This is not a simple reference but an operational business entity that procurement officers create, evaluate, and audit for donor compliance per 2 CFR 200 standards.

attributes.name: bid_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this bid submission record. Primary key.

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the Request for Quotation for which this bid was submitted.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vendor organization that submitted this bid.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the vendors bid or quotation for the goods/services specified in the RFQ.

attributes.name: awarded_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) showing whether this bid was awarded the contract. Only one bid per RFQ should have awarded_flag = True.

attributes.name: bid_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bid: submitted (received), under_evaluation (being scored), responsive (meets requirements), non_responsive (disqualified), awarded (won contract), not_awarded (lost), withdrawn (vendor withdrew).

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the bid amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: financial_score
attributes.description: Score assigned during financial evaluation of the bid based on pricing competitiveness and value for money.

attributes.name: rank
attributes.description: Ranking position of this bid among all responsive bids for the RFQ, based on total_score (1 = highest ranked).

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the bid was rejected or deemed non-responsive (e.g., late submission, missing documents, failed technical requirements, price exceeds budget).

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the vendor submitted their bid or quotation, must be before the RFQ submission deadline.

attributes.name: technical_score
attributes.description: Score assigned during technical evaluation of the bid based on quality, specifications compliance, and vendor capability.

attributes.name: total_score
attributes.description: Combined weighted score from technical and financial evaluation, used for final bid ranking and award decision.

attributes.name: validity_days
attributes.description: Number of days from submission date during which the vendor commits to honor the quoted price and terms.

products.name: supply_distribution_line
products.description: This association product represents the line-level detail of commodities included in a distribution order. Each record links one distribution order to one commodity with line-specific attributes including quantities dispatched and received, batch tracking, expiry dates, unit values, and discrepancy reconciliation. This is the operational record that enables multi-commodity distribution orders and tracks the actual movement of each commodity type from warehouse to distribution point.. Existence Justification: Distribution orders are multi-line documents where each order dispatches multiple different commodities to field distribution points, and each commodity type appears on many different distribution orders over time. The distribution_order table explicitly contains total_commodity_lines (INT) confirming it is a multi-line document structure. The business actively manages distribution line items as operational records, tracking line-specific quantities, batch numbers, expiry dates, unit values, and delivery confirmation for each commodity on each order.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes specific to this line item, such as special handling instructions, quality observations, or discrepancy explanations.

attributes.name: quantity_discrepancy
attributes.description: Difference between quantity_dispatched and quantity_received (dispatched minus received). Positive values indicate shortages, negative values indicate overages. Triggers investigation and reconciliation. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: quantity_dispatched
attributes.description: Quantity of this commodity dispatched from the warehouse on this line, measured in the commodity's standard unit of measure. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: Actual quantity of this commodity received at the destination distribution point, as confirmed by receiving personnel. Used to identify losses, damages, or discrepancies during transport. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: unit_value

products.name: purchase_order_line
products.description: This association product represents the line-item detail of procurement purchase orders, capturing the specific commodities ordered on each PO. Each record links one purchase order to one commodity with line-specific quantities, pricing, delivery schedules, and receipt tracking. This is the operational record that procurement officers create when building multi-line purchase orders and that warehouse staff update when receiving shipments.. Existence Justification: In humanitarian procurement operations, purchase orders routinely contain multiple commodity line items (medical supplies, shelter materials, WASH items on a single PO), and each commodity appears across many purchase orders over time as programs continuously procure relief items. Procurement officers actively manage line-item details including per-line quantities, vendor pricing, delivery schedules, and receipt tracking—this is the operational record that drives three-way matching and inventory management.

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount for this line (quantity_ordered × unit_price). Contributes to purchase_order.subtotal_amount.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered

products.name: supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual supply relationship between a commodity and a vendor. It captures vendor-specific pricing, lead times, quality certifications, and performance metrics for each commodity-vendor pairing. Each record links one commodity to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this supply relationship, enabling multi-vendor sourcing strategies essential to humanitarian procurement resilience.. Existence Justification: In humanitarian procurement operations, commodities are routinely sourced from multiple vendors to ensure supply chain resilience, competitive pricing, and geographic coverage. Each vendor offers different pricing, lead times, and quality certifications for the same commodity. Conversely, vendors supply multiple commodities across different categories. The business actively manages these supply agreements as operational entities with vendor-specific terms, performance tracking, and lifecycle management.

products.name: distribution_plan_line
products.description: This association product represents the line-item relationship between distribution plans and commodities in humanitarian supply chain operations. It captures the bill of materials for each distribution event, specifying which commodities are included in each distribution plan with planned quantities, priorities, and allocation details. Each record links one distribution plan to one commodity with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific plan-commodity pairing.. Existence Justification: In humanitarian supply chain operations, distribution plans specify a bill of materials (list of commodities with quantities) for each distribution event. A single distribution plan includes multiple commodities (e.g., shelter kits, water purification tablets, blankets, food rations), and each commodity appears in multiple distribution plans across different programs, locations, and time periods. The business actively manages these plan-commodity pairings with specific quantities, priorities, allocation statuses, and cost estimates.

products.name: commodity_supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the prequalification and supply agreement between a humanitarian commodity and a partner organization. It captures the partner's capacity and terms to supply specific commodities, including agreed pricing, lead times, quality certifications, and historical performance. Each record links one commodity to one partner organization with attributes that exist only in the context of this supply relationship. Used for sourcing decisions, RFQ targeting, and localization strategy in humanitarian procurement.. Existence Justification: In humanitarian supply chain operations, partner organizations are prequalified to supply specific commodities based on capacity assessments, certifications, and past performance. A single commodity (e.g., water purification tablets) can be sourced from multiple prequalified partners at different unit costs and lead times, and a single partner organization can supply multiple different commodities (e.g., WASH items, shelter materials, medical supplies). The business actively manages these supply agreements as operational records with partner-specific pricing, lead times, quality certifications, and performance ratings.

products.name: hour_log
products.description: Authoritative transactional record of volunteer hours contributed per activity, deployment, or event — the timesheet equivalent for unpaid contributors. Captures log date, volunteer (FK to volunteer), deployment or program context (FK to volunteer_deployment), activity type, location, hours claimed, hours verified, verification method (supervisor sign-off, digital check-in/GPS, self-reported), approval status, approving supervisor, and notes. Supports audit trail requirements for institutional donor compliance.

products.name: certification
products.description: Unified competency and credential product — the single source of truth for all skills taxonomy and individual volunteer credentials within the volunteer domain. As REFERENCE CATALOG: defines skill categories (medical, logistics, language, psychosocial, WASH, ICT4D, community mobilization), proficiency levels, role-to-skill requirements, and mandatory vs. preferred designations for volunteer_role entries. products.name: volunteer_deployment2
products.description: This association product represents the deployment assignment between a volunteer and a partner organization. It captures the operational assignment of volunteers to partner organizations for specific roles, time periods, and performance tracking. Each record links one volunteer to one partner organization with attributes that exist only in the context of this deployment relationship, including role, dates, hours contributed, and performance assessment.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit operations, volunteers are deployed to multiple partner organizations over time for different projects, field placements, and programs, and each partner organization works with multiple volunteers simultaneously. The deployment relationship is an operational business entity that program coordinators actively create, manage, and track with specific attributes including role assignments, time periods, hours contributed, and performance assessments. This is not a simple reference but a managed assignment process central to volunteer coordination.

products.name: volunteer_training_completion
products.description: This association product represents the completion record between volunteer and training_program. It captures the enrollment, completion, and certification lifecycle for each volunteer's participation in a safeguarding training program. Each record links one volunteer to one training_program with attributes that track compliance status, certification validity, and completion evidence.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit operations, volunteers complete multiple safeguarding training programs over their tenure (PSEA awareness, child protection, code of conduct, investigation procedures), and each training program is completed by hundreds or thousands of volunteers across the organization. The business actively manages training completion records as a compliance obligation, tracking enrollment dates, completion status, certificate numbers, expiry dates, and renewal requirements for each volunteer-training combination. This is a recognized operational entity called 'training completion' or 'training record' that safeguarding officers query, update, and monitor for compliance reporting.

Each record links one data_collection_tool to one volunteer with attributes that track training completion, certification status, authorization validity periods, and proficiency levels - essential for quality control, compliance, and volunteer deployment planning.. attributes.name: last_refresher_training_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent refresher training session completed by the volunteer for this tool, used to track ongoing competency maintenance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding special conditions, restrictions, or observations related to this volunteers authorization for this tool.

attributes.name: proficiency_level
attributes.description: Assessed proficiency level of the volunteer in administering this specific data collection tool. Used for deployment planning and quality assurance. Trainer level indicates ability to train other volunteers. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the volunteer completed training on this specific data collection tool. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this authorization record was last updated.

domains.name: partnership
domains.description: Owns all inter-organizational relationship data including MoUs (Memoranda of Understanding), LoAs (Letters of Agreement), SoWs (Scope of Work), and sub-award agreements with CSOs, CBOs, INGOs, government bodies, UN agencies, and consortia. Manages partner capacity assessments, due diligence records, sub-grant management, and coordination with OCHA cluster leads and IASC working groups.

products.name: partner_org
products.description: Master record and SSOT for all inter-organizational partners including CSOs (Civil Society Organizations), CBOs (Community-Based Organizations), INGOs (International Non-Governmental Organizations), government bodies, UN agencies, and consortia. Captures organizational identity, registration details (registration number, country of registration, registration date), legal status, countries of operation, organizational type classification, accreditation status, and operational capacity summary. Includes embedded contact records for key personnel: focal points, authorized representatives, technical leads, financial officers, and program coordinators with name, title, role type, communication channels (email, phone, messaging), language preference, and active status. This is the SSOT for partner identity, classification, and contact information in the partnership domain.

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a partner organization record. This is the primary key and Single Source of Truth (SSOT) identifier for all inter-organizational partner entities in the partnership domain.

attributes.name: relationship_manager_staff_member_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Relationship Manager Staff Member Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.staff_member. Business justification: Partnership management best practice assigns NGO staff as relationship owner for each partner organization. Critical for due diligence oversight, capacity assessment coordination, performance monitori

attributes.name: statutory_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.statutory_registration. Business justification: Partner organizations must maintain valid statutory registrations (NGO registration, tax-exempt status) for due diligence and partnership eligibility. Links partner vetting to legal compliance status.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status of the partner organization against recognized humanitarian or development standards such as the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS), HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership), or equivalent national accreditation bodies.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; Humanitarian Accountability Partnership (HAP); Sphere Association

attributes.name: annual_budget_usd
attributes.description: Most recently reported annual organizational budget of the partner in US Dollars. Used for financial capacity assessment, sub-award sizing decisions, and due diligence under OMB Uniform Guidance. Sourced from partner financial disclosures or audited accounts.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.332; FASB ASC 958; USAID Partner Capacity Assessment

attributes.name: authorized_rep_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual legally authorized to sign agreements (MoUs, LoAs, SoWs, sub-award agreements) on behalf of the partner organization. Required for agreement execution and legal compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.332; USAID Standard Provisions

attributes.name: authorized_rep_title
attributes.description: Official title of the authorized signatory at the partner organization (e.g., Executive Director, CEO, Country Representative). Validates signing authority for sub-award and partnership agreements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID Standard Provisions

attributes.name: bank_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the partner organization's primary bank account is held. Used for international wire transfer compliance and OFAC/sanctions screening.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; OFAC Sanctions Regulations; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.305

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary banking institution used by the partner organization for receiving sub-grant disbursements. Required for financial due diligence and sub-award payment processing in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.305; USAID Standard Provisions; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent formal partner capacity assessment was conducted. Used to determine whether a reassessment is due and to track the currency of due diligence records.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.332; USAID Partner Capacity Assessment Framework

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 0–100) resulting from the most recent formal partner capacity assessment covering governance, financial management, HR, and program delivery. Used to determine sub-award eligibility, required oversight level, and capacity-strengthening needs under OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.332; USAID Partner Capacity Assessment; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: chs_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner organization holds a valid Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) certification. CHS certification demonstrates commitment to accountability, quality, and improvement in humanitarian response.

attributes.name: cluster_memberships
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of OCHA humanitarian cluster(s) in which the partner organization holds active membership or co-lead roles (e.g., WASH, Health, Shelter, Food Security, Protection). Used for coordination mapping and IASC working group engagement tracking.
attributes.references: OCHA Cluster Coordination System; Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC)

attributes.name: countries_of_operation
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where the partner organization has active field operations. Distinct from country of registration. Used for geographic coverage analysis and OCHA 3W (Who does What Where) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; IATI Activity Standard v2.03; OCHA 3W Reporting

attributes.name: due_diligence_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current due diligence clearance expires and a new assessment must be completed before the partner can enter into new sub-award or partnership agreements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.332; USAID Partner Vetting System

attributes.name: due_diligence_status
attributes.description: Current status of the partner organization's due diligence vetting process. 'Expired' indicates that a previously completed assessment has passed its validity period and renewal is required before new agreements can be executed.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.332; USAID Partner Vetting System; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: finance_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the partner organization's designated financial officer or finance focal point. Used for Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting, financial documentation requests, and sub-grant financial management communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: founding_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the partner organization was founded or established. Used to assess organizational maturity, track record, and eligibility for capacity-strengthening programs.
attributes.references: IATI Organisation Standard v2.03; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: hq_address
attributes.description: Full mailing address of the partner organization's global headquarters including street, city, postal code, and country. Used for official correspondence, legal notices, and sub-award agreement documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: hq_city
attributes.description: City where the partner organization's global headquarters is located. Used for correspondence, coordination meetings, and geographic reporting.

attributes.name: hq_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the partner organization's global headquarters is located. Used for geographic analysis, donor reporting, and OCHA cluster coordination mapping.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; IATI Organisation Standard v2.03

attributes.name: iati_org_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Organization Identifier
attributes.description: Globally unique organization identifier assigned under the International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) standard (e.g., GB-CHC-1234567). Enables cross-organization data linkage and transparency reporting to IATI registry. Required for DFID and many EU donor compliance reports.
attributes.references: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Organisation Identifier Standard v2.03

attributes.name: mission_statement
attributes.description: Official mission statement of the partner organization describing its core purpose and mandate. Used for alignment assessment with Ngo's Theory of Change (ToC) and program design.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); IATI Organisation Standard v2.03

attributes.name: org_acronym
attributes.description: Commonly used acronym or short name for the partner organization (e.g., CARE, IRC, MSF). Widely used in SitReps, cluster coordination, and OCHA reporting to identify partners concisely.
attributes.references: IATI Organisation Standard v2.03; OCHA Partner Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered name of the partner organization as it appears on official registration documents. Used as the primary human-readable identity label for the partner across all systems including Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud.
attributes.references: IATI Organisation Standard v2.03; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: org_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the partner organization type. Distinguishes between International Non-Governmental Organizations (INGOs), Civil Society Organizations (CSOs), Community-Based Organizations (CBOs), UN agencies, government bodies, consortia, private sector entities, and academic institutions. Drives eligibility rules for sub-award agreements and due diligence requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: INGO|NGO|CSO|CBO|UN_AGENCY|GOVERNMENT|CONSORTIUM|PRIVATE_SECTOR|ACADEMIC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATI Organisation Type Codelist; OCHA Partner Registration Framework; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: org_website
attributes.description: Official public website URL of the partner organization. Used for due diligence verification, public profile validation, and IATI transparency reporting.

attributes.name: partnership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the partner organization relationship. Controls whether the partner is eligible for new agreements, sub-awards, or field collaboration. 'pending_vetting' indicates due diligence is in progress; 'blacklisted' indicates the partner is barred from engagement per donor or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.332; USAID Partner Vetting System

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-2 language code representing the partner organization's preferred language for official communications, reporting, and agreement documentation (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'ar', 'es').

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Official email address of the primary focal point at the partner organization. Used for formal communications, agreement notifications, and reporting requests.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary focal point or authorized representative at the partner organization. This is the principal contact for partnership coordination, agreement negotiations, and official communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number (including country code) for the primary focal point at the partner organization. Used for urgent field coordination and emergency communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title or designation of the primary focal point at the partner organization (e.g., Country Director, Partnership Manager, Executive Director). Used to assess seniority and authority level for agreement signing.

attributes.name: record_created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the partner organization record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker and supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: record_updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the partner organization record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental load processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: sanctions_screen_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent sanctions screening was completed for the partner organization. Used to determine whether re-screening is required before new agreements or disbursements.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Regulations; USAID Partner Vetting System; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: sanctions_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner organization has been screened against applicable sanctions lists (e.g., OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Sanctions List) as part of the due diligence process. Required for USAID and US Government-funded programs.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Regulations; UN Security Council Sanctions; USAID Partner Vetting System; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: sdg_alignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UN Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) numbers that the partner organization's mandate aligns with (e.g., '1,2,3,6'). Used for strategic alignment reporting and donor narrative reporting.
attributes.references: UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Framework; IATI Activity Standard v2.03

attributes.name: staff_count
attributes.description: Total number of paid staff (national and international) employed by the partner organization at the time of last capacity assessment. Used as an indicator of organizational capacity for program delivery and sub-award management.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); USAID Partner Capacity Assessment Framework

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number (e.g., EIN in the US, VAT number in the EU) for the partner organization. Required for financial transactions, sub-award agreements, and compliance with NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement) reporting.
attributes.references: IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations (US); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.330; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: thematic_focus_areas
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of primary thematic areas in which the partner organization operates (e.g., WASH, GBV, PSS, Health, Education, Livelihoods, NFI Distribution). Used for partner matching in program design and cluster coordination with OCHA.
attributes.references: OCHA Cluster System; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; SDG Framework

attributes.name: volunteer_count
attributes.description: Total number of active volunteers engaged by the partner organization. Reflects community mobilization capacity and is used in operational capacity assessments for field program delivery.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); IATI Organisation Standard v2.03

products.name: partnership_agreement
products.description: Core master record for all formal inter-organizational agreements including MoUs (Memoranda of Understanding), LoAs (Letters of Agreement), SoWs (Scope of Work), sub-award agreements, and consortium agreements. Captures agreement type, effective dates, expiry dates, signatory parties, governing law, agreement scope, funding ceiling, current status, and amendment history references. Includes embedded obligation line-items tracking specific deliverables and commitments: obligation description, responsible party, due date, completion status, evidence of fulfillment, and escalation status. Serves as the SSOT for all partnership legal instruments, their tracked commitments, and obligation monitoring in the partnership domain.

attributes.name: partnership_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the partnership agreement record. Primary key for the partnership_agreement data product.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.award. Business justification: Partnership agreements in nonprofit operations typically implement specific grant awards. Tracking which donor award funds each partnership is essential for financial reporting, compliance monitoring,

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Partnership agreements create compliance obligations (donor reporting schedules, regulatory filings, IATI publication requirements). Each agreement generates specific obligations tracked in compliance

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_fund. Business justification: Partnership agreements in nonprofits are funded through specific restricted or unrestricted funds. Financial reporting, fund accounting, and donor compliance require tracking which fund finances each

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.intervention. Business justification: Partnership agreements are established to implement specific interventions. Linking agreement to intervention enables program-level financial consolidation, results aggregation, donor reporting, and i

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.partner_org. Business justification: CRITICAL missing link. Every partnership agreement must reference its partner organization. Currently stores partner_organization_name as denormalized text. Adding partner_org_id FK allows JOIN to par

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to communication.communication_plan. Business justification: Major partnership agreements require structured communication plans for launch announcements, milestone updates, and donor visibility requirements. Essential for tracking communication deliverables ti

attributes.name: program_manager_staff_member_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Program Manager Staff Member Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.staff_member. Business justification: Partnership agreements require designated NGO program manager for oversight, amendment approvals, performance review sign-off, and donor reporting accountability. Distinct from partner_org relationshi

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safeguarding.risk_assessment. Business justification: Partnership agreements require safeguarding risk assessments before execution per donor compliance standards (CHS, Grand Bargain). Risk assessment informs partnership approval decisions and monitoring

attributes.name: system_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.system_platform. Business justification: Partnership agreements are managed in specific grants management systems (e.g., Salesforce, SAP Grants, custom portals). Tracking the source system is essential for data access control, audit trails,

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the partnership agreement. draft = under preparation; pending_signature = awaiting execution; active = fully executed and in force; suspended = temporarily halted; expired = past end date without renewal; terminated = ended before expiry; amended = superseded by an amendment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_signature|active|suspended|expired|terminated|amended — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formal inter-organizational legal instrument. MoU = Memorandum of Understanding; LoA = Letter of Agreement; SoW = Scope of Work; sub_award = sub-grant or sub-award agreement; consortium = multi-party consortium agreement; other = any other instrument type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MoU|LoA|SoW|sub_award|consortium|framework|other — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: OCHA Partnership Framework; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent amendment to the agreement was executed. Null for original agreements with no amendments.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: amendment_description
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the changes introduced by the most recent amendment (e.g., budget increase, no-cost extension, scope modification). Null for original agreements.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer indicating the amendment version of the agreement. Zero (0) indicates the original agreement; increments by 1 for each subsequent amendment. Supports amendment history tracking.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent partner capacity assessment or due diligence review was completed.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_status
attributes.description: Status of the partner due diligence and capacity assessment conducted prior to or during the agreement. not_required = exempt; pending = assessment initiated but not complete; completed = assessment passed; failed = partner did not meet threshold; waived = formally waived by authorized approver.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: cluster_lead_agency
attributes.description: Name of the OCHA cluster lead agency (e.g., UNICEF for WASH, WFP for Food Security) under whose coordination framework the agreement's activities are implemented. Relevant for humanitarian response agreements.
attributes.references: OCHA Cluster System; IASC Reference Module for Cluster Coordination

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the partnership agreement record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the funding ceiling and financial obligations under the agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Agreed mechanism for resolving disputes arising under the agreement. Captured from the legal instrument's dispute resolution clause.

attributes.name: due_diligence_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating assigned to the partner following due diligence review. Informs monitoring intensity, financial controls, and reporting requirements under the agreement.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Charity Commission (UK)

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agreement expires or obligations cease. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Corresponds to the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agreement becomes legally binding and operational obligations commence. Corresponds to the EFFECTIVE_FROM category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agreement was formally signed and executed by all required parties. May differ from the effective start date if the agreement is backdated or has a future commencement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: funding_ceiling_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total financial value authorized under the agreement in the agreement's stated currency. For sub-awards, this is the maximum sub-grant amount. Null for non-financial MoUs.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Free-text description of the geographic area covered by the agreement (e.g., 'Borno and Yobe States, Nigeria' or 'Kabul Province, Afghanistan'). Used for operational planning and GIS-based reporting.

attributes.name: governing_law_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of the agreement (e.g., GBR, USA, CHE).

attributes.name: iati_activity_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Activity Identifier
attributes.description: IATI-standard activity identifier for the agreement, enabling public disclosure and cross-organization traceability on the IATI Registry (e.g., 'GB-CHC-123456-WASH-NGA-2024').
attributes.references: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Standard v2.03

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.description: Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate (NICRA) or agreed Facilities and Administration (F&A) rate applied to direct costs under this agreement, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Relevant for US federal sub-awards under OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA; IRS 501(c)(3)

attributes.name: is_consortium_agreement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement governs a multi-party consortium arrangement (True) rather than a bilateral agreement (False). Consortium agreements may have additional members tracked separately.

attributes.name: is_sub_award
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement is a sub-award (True) or a prime/direct agreement (False). Drives compliance requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 for pass-through entities.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the partnership agreement record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: lead_organization_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the primary organization (typically the prime recipient or lead INGO) that is the principal party initiating or managing the agreement. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE anchor for the agreement.

attributes.name: operational_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary country where the agreement's activities are implemented (e.g., SSD, YEM, HTI).

attributes.name: parent_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Agreement reference number of the parent or prime agreement under which this sub-award or amendment was issued. Enables hierarchical agreement traceability. Null for top-level agreements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard

attributes.name: program_sector
attributes.description: Humanitarian or development sector under which the agreement's activities fall. WASH = Water Sanitation and Hygiene; GBV = Gender-Based Violence; PSS = Psychosocial Support. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WASH|health|education|food_security|protection|shelter|livelihoods|GBV|PSS|nutrition|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OCHA Cluster System; IASC Sector/Cluster Guidance; SDG Framework

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the agreement, used in correspondence, filing, and cross-system lookups (e.g., MOU-2024-0042, LOA-2023-WASH-007). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this agreement.
attributes.references: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Standard; OCHA Coordination Guidance

attributes.name: renewal_option
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains a renewal or extension option clause (True) that allows the parties to extend the agreement beyond the effective end date without a full renegotiation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Agreed frequency at which the partner must submit programmatic and/or financial reports under the agreement (e.g., monthly SitRep, quarterly narrative, annual audit).
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard; OCHA Coordination Guidance

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the agreed scope of work, activities, and deliverables covered by the agreement. Summarizes the SoW or program objectives as stated in the legal instrument.
attributes.references: OCHA Coordination Guidance; CHS Alliance; IATI Standard

attributes.name: sdg_alignment_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UN Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) goal numbers to which the agreement's activities contribute (e.g., '3,6,16'). Used for donor reporting and IATI disclosure.
attributes.references: UN SDG Framework; IATI Standard; OCHA Coordination Guidance

attributes.name: signatory_name_lead
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized signatory representing the lead organization on the agreement. Captured for legal validity and audit purposes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: signatory_name_partner
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized signatory representing the partner organization on the agreement. Captured for legal validity and audit purposes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the agreement was terminated, if terminated before the effective end date. Null for active or expired agreements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days' written notice required by either party to terminate the agreement without cause, as specified in the termination clause.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for early termination of the agreement. Null for agreements that expire naturally or remain active.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: theory_of_change_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or title of the Theory of Change (ToC) or LogFrame (Logical Framework) document that underpins the program activities governed by this agreement. Links the agreement to the MEL framework.
attributes.references: OECD DAC Evaluation Criteria; IATI Standard; RBM Framework

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the partnership agreement as it appears on the signed legal instrument (e.g., 'Memorandum of Understanding for WASH Program Delivery in Borno State').

products.name: capacity_assessment
products.description: Records formal partner capacity assessments conducted prior to or during partnership engagement. Captures assessment methodology (e.g., USAID OCA, DFID OCAT), assessment date, assessor identity, scores across functional areas (financial management, HR, procurement, governance, MEL), overall risk rating, and recommended capacity-building interventions. Essential for due diligence and risk management.

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each partner capacity assessment record. Primary key for the capacity_assessment data product.
attributes.references: USAID Organizational Capacity Assessment (OCA) Framework; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant or funding agreement that triggered or is associated with this capacity assessment. Links due diligence records to specific funding instruments.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303maa

attributes.name: chs_self_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.chs_self_assessment. Business justification: Capacity assessments routinely include CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard) self-assessment as a component for partner quality assurance. Direct operational link in partner vetting processes. CHS complian

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner organization (CSO, CBO, INGO, government body, UN agency, or consortium) being assessed. Links to the partner master record.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; IATI Standard

attributes.name: primary_capacity_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member or consultant who led the capacity assessment process. Used for accountability, quality assurance, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 8; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: prior_assessment_capacity_assessment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding capacity assessment record for the same partner, enabling longitudinal tracking of capacity development progress over time.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; DFID OCAT; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: system_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.system_platform. Business justification: Capacity assessments conducted via digital data collection platforms (KoBoToolbox, ODK, CommCare). Linking to system_platform enables data lineage tracking, API integration for automated scoring, comp

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The principal date on which the capacity assessment was conducted or the field data collection was completed. Used as the primary business event date for reporting and due diligence timelines.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331

attributes.name: assessment_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capacity assessment process was formally concluded and the final report was issued.

attributes.name: assessment_location_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the capacity assessment was physically conducted. Relevant for field-based assessments of local partners.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; IATI Standard v2.03; OCHA Geographic Reference

attributes.name: assessment_methodology
attributes.description: Standardized framework or tool used to conduct the capacity assessment. Common methodologies include USAID Organizational Capacity Assessment (OCA), DFID Organizational Capacity Assessment Tool (OCAT), ECHO Partner Assessment for Capacity Assessment (PACA), IRC Collaborative Capacity Assessment Tool (CCAT), and UNDP Capacity Scorecard. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USAID_OCA|DFID_OCAT|ECHO_PACA|IRC_CCAT|UNDP_CAPACITY_SCORECARD|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; DFID Smart Rules; UNDP Capacity Development Framework

attributes.name: assessment_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this capacity assessment, used in correspondence, donor reporting, and audit trails (e.g., NGO-CA-2024-000123).
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; DFID Organizational Capacity Assessment Tool (OCAT); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331

attributes.name: assessment_report_url
attributes.description: URL or document management system path to the full capacity assessment report. Classified as confidential due to sensitive organizational information about the partner.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; DFID Smart Rules; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: assessment_scope
attributes.description: Indicates the depth and modality of the assessment: FULL (comprehensive on-site assessment covering all functional areas), ABBREVIATED (targeted review of selected areas), DESK_REVIEW (document-based review without site visit), FIELD_VISIT (on-site verification component).
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; DFID Smart Rules; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331

attributes.name: assessment_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capacity assessment process formally commenced, including document review and stakeholder engagement initiation.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capacity assessment record: DRAFT (initiated but not submitted), IN_PROGRESS (assessment underway), COMPLETED (assessment finalized), VALIDATED (reviewed and approved by authorized staff), ARCHIVED (superseded or closed).
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: assessment_tool_version
attributes.description: Version number or edition of the assessment methodology tool used (e.g., 'USAID OCA v3.0', 'DFID OCAT 2019'). Ensures comparability of scores across assessments conducted using different tool versions.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of when and why the assessment was conducted: PRE_AWARD (due diligence before partnership), PERIODIC (scheduled review during partnership), TRIGGERED (event-driven reassessment due to risk flag), or CLOSE_OUT (end-of-partnership evaluation).
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303maa; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 8

attributes.name: capacity_building_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment results mandate the development of a formal capacity-building plan (True) or whether the partner's capacity is sufficient without a structured intervention plan (False).
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303maa; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 8; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the capacity assessment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting purposes.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 5(2); FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: enhanced_monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment outcome requires enhanced programmatic or financial monitoring of the partner (True), such as more frequent reporting, additional site visits, or pre-approval of expenditures, as mandated by donor regulations.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303maa

attributes.name: financial_mgmt_score
attributes.description: Numeric score assigned to the partner's financial management functional area, covering accounting systems, internal controls, audit compliance, and fund stewardship. Typically scored on a 0–100 or 1–5 scale per the assessment methodology.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; DFID OCAT; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.302

attributes.name: financial_risk_rating
attributes.description: Specific risk rating for the partner's financial management functional area, used to determine sub-award monitoring intensity, payment modality, and required financial controls.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: governance_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the partner's organizational governance functional area, including board oversight, legal registration, organizational policies, and leadership accountability.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; DFID OCAT; Charity Commission (UK) Governance Code; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations

attributes.name: hr_mgmt_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the partner's human resources management functional area, including HR policies, recruitment practices, staff development, and safeguarding compliance.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; DFID OCAT; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 8

attributes.name: it_systems_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the partner's ICT4D and information systems functional area, covering data management infrastructure, cybersecurity practices, and digital reporting capabilities.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; ICT4D Principles for Digital Development

attributes.name: key_findings_summary
attributes.description: Concise narrative summary of the principal findings from the capacity assessment, highlighting major strengths, critical gaps, and priority areas for improvement across all assessed functional areas.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; DFID OCAT; DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: kobo_submission_reference
attributes.description: Unique submission identifier from KoboToolbox or similar field data collection platform used to capture assessment data in the field. Enables traceability back to the source data collection record.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Data Collection Platform; ICT4D Principles for Digital Development

attributes.name: lead_assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who led the capacity assessment. Retained for reporting and audit purposes even when the staff record may change.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: lead_assessor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization to which the lead assessor belongs (e.g., the NGO's headquarters, an independent consulting firm, or a donor agency). Relevant when external assessors are engaged.

attributes.name: mel_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Capacity Score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the partner's Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) functional area, covering data collection systems, indicator tracking, reporting quality, and learning practices.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 201; DFID Smart Rules; IATI Standard v2.03; DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the next capacity assessment must be completed, based on risk rating, donor requirements, or organizational policy. Drives compliance monitoring and workflow triggers.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303maa

attributes.name: overall_risk_rating
attributes.description: Categorical risk classification assigned to the partner based on the capacity assessment results: LOW (strong capacity, minimal oversight needed), MEDIUM (adequate capacity with some gaps), HIGH (significant capacity gaps requiring intensive support), CRITICAL (fundamental weaknesses posing fiduciary or programmatic risk).
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303maa; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 8

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score representing the partner's overall organizational capacity across all assessed functional areas. Calculated per the assessment methodology's weighting scheme and recorded as the official assessment result.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; DFID OCAT; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331

attributes.name: partner_self_assessment_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner organization completed a self-assessment component prior to or alongside the external assessment (True). Many OCA methodologies include a parallel self-assessment to identify perception gaps.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; DFID OCAT; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: partner_self_assessment_score
attributes.description: Overall score submitted by the partner organization in their self-assessment component. Compared against the external assessor's score to identify perception gaps and inform capacity-building dialogue.

attributes.name: payment_modality_recommendation
attributes.description: Payment modality recommended for sub-award disbursements based on the partner's financial risk rating: ADVANCE (funds transferred before expenditure), REIMBURSEMENT (funds transferred after expenditure documentation), DIRECT_PAYMENT (NGO pays vendors directly on partner's behalf), MIXED (combination of modalities).
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.305; USAID ADS 303maa

attributes.name: procurement_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the partner's procurement and supply chain management functional area, covering procurement policies, competitive bidding, vendor management, and asset control.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; DFID OCAT; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.317–200.326

attributes.name: program_mgmt_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the partner's program design and management functional area, including project planning, implementation capacity, beneficiary targeting, and service delivery quality.
attributes.references: USAID OCA Framework; DFID OCAT; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitments 1–9

attributes.name: recommended_interventions
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific capacity-building interventions recommended based on assessment findings, such as financial management training, procurement system upgrades, MEL system strengthening, or governance policy development.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303maa; DFID Smart Rules; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 8

attributes.name: score_scale_max
attributes.description: The maximum possible score on the scoring scale used by the assessment methodology (e.g., 100 for percentage-based scales, 5 for Likert-based scales). Required to normalize scores across different methodologies for comparative analytics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the capacity assessment record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capacity assessment was formally reviewed and validated by the authorized staff member, marking the record as officially approved for use in partnership and sub-award decisions.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS 303

products.name: due_diligence_record
products.description: Formal due diligence and partner verification master record covering legal compliance checks, sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, UN), anti-terrorism certification, financial audit review, governance verification, and regulatory standing. Includes embedded accreditation/certification tracking for CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard), Sphere compliance, HAP membership, ISO certifications, and national NGO registration status with issuing body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, and verification status. Tracks due diligence type, completion date, outcome, risk level, next review date, and responsible staff. Required for compliance with 2 CFR 200, USAID ADS 303, and donor partner vetting regulations. This is the SSOT for all partner verification, screening, and accreditation data in the partnership domain.

attributes.name: due_diligence_record_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the due diligence and partner verification record. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — this record represents a formal compliance verification container with its own lifecycle, effective dates, and binding outcome.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.award. Business justification: Due diligence assessments are often triggered by specific award risk thresholds, donor requirements, and subaward value ceilings. Award context determines diligence scope, required certifications, and

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.capacity_assessment. Business justification: due_diligence_record stores capacity_assessment_score and capacity_assessment_date as denormalized attributes but has no FK to the actual capacity_assessment record. Due diligence incorporates capacit

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner organization (CSO, CBO, INGO, government body, UN agency, or consortium) that is the subject of this due diligence record.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanctions_screening. Business justification: Due diligence records must reference specific sanctions screening results for anti-terrorism compliance and donor requirements. Mandatory step in partner vetting. Links DD workflow to compliance evide

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (typically a Partnership Officer or Compliance Officer) responsible for conducting and owning this due diligence record.

attributes.name: aml_cft_check_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) Check Status
attributes.description: Result of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Financing of Terrorism (CFT) due diligence checks conducted on the partner organization and its key principals, per FATF Recommendations and donor requirements.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations 2012 (updated 2023); OFAC; EU AMLD; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: anti_terrorism_cert_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner's anti-terrorism certification was signed and received. Required for USAID and BHA-funded sub-awards.

attributes.name: anti_terrorism_certification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner has signed and submitted a valid anti-terrorism certification (e.g., USAID Standard Provision — Certification Regarding Terrorist Financing) as required for US Government-funded awards.

attributes.name: chs_cert_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Certificate Expiry Date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner's CHS certification expires. Triggers renewal alerts and may affect partner eligibility for humanitarian sub-awards.

attributes.name: chs_certificate_number
attributes.description: Official certificate number issued by the CHS Alliance upon successful third-party verification of the partner's compliance with the Core Humanitarian Standard.

attributes.name: chs_certification_status
attributes.description: Accreditation status of the partner against the Core Humanitarian Standard on Quality and Accountability (CHS). Certified status requires third-party verification by the CHS Alliance.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP International; SPHERE Association

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which all due diligence checks were completed and a final outcome was recorded. Null if the process is still in progress.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: conditions_of_approval
attributes.description: Free-text description of any conditions, restrictions, or corrective actions attached to an approved-with-conditions outcome. Documents required remediation steps and timelines before full approval is granted.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this due diligence record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker required for compliance and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.333; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance

attributes.name: debarment_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent debarment and suspension check was performed against SAM.gov and equivalent exclusion registries.

attributes.name: debarment_check_status
attributes.description: Result of verification against the US System for Award Management (SAM.gov) exclusions list and equivalent debarment/suspension registries to confirm the partner is not excluded from receiving federal awards.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 180; SAM.gov Exclusions; USAID ADS 303; FAR 9.4

attributes.name: diligence_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the due diligence record, tracking progress from initiation through completion or failure. Drives workflow routing and compliance dashboards.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303; OMB Uniform Guidance

attributes.name: diligence_type
attributes.description: Classification of the due diligence exercise by its trigger and scope. Pre-award is conducted before sub-award execution; periodic review is scheduled; triggered review is initiated by a risk event; close-out is conducted at agreement end; enhanced due diligence applies to high-risk partners.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303.3.6; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: financial_audit_opinion
attributes.description: Type of auditor's opinion issued in the partner's most recent external financial audit. An unqualified (clean) opinion is required for most donor sub-award eligibility. Adverse or disclaimer opinions trigger enhanced due diligence.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Subpart F; ISA 700; GAAP for Nonprofits; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: financial_audit_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner's most recent external financial audit report has been reviewed and assessed as part of this due diligence exercise.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Subpart F; FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: financial_audit_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year covered by the most recent external financial audit report reviewed during due diligence. Used to assess currency of financial information.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Subpart F; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance

attributes.name: governance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner's governance structure (board composition, conflict of interest policies, organizational chart, and decision-making authority) has been reviewed and verified.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.331; CHS Commitment 9; Charity Commission (UK) Governance Code

attributes.name: hap_membership_status
attributes.description: Indicates the partner's membership status with the Humanitarian Accountability Partnership (HAP), a predecessor accountability framework now integrated into the CHS Alliance.

attributes.name: initiation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the due diligence process was formally initiated for this partner. Marks the start of the MASTER_AGREEMENT effective period for compliance tracking purposes.

attributes.name: iso_cert_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner's ISO certification expires. Null if no ISO certification is held or if certification is not time-limited.

attributes.name: iso_certification_type
attributes.description: Type of ISO certification held by the partner organization (e.g., ISO 9001 Quality Management, ISO 27001 Information Security). Null if no ISO certification is held. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ISO_9001|ISO_27001|ISO_14001|ISO_45001|ISO_31000|none — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
