attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this due diligence record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.333; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance

attributes.name: legal_registration_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner's legal registration and incorporation status in its country of operation has been verified against official national NGO registration records or company registry.
attributes.references: Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations (US); IATI Standard; 2 CFR 200.331

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date for the next periodic due diligence review of this partner. Drives automated reminders and compliance calendar management. Effective-until equivalent for the current verification cycle.

attributes.name: ngo_registration_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the partner is legally registered as an NGO or nonprofit entity.

attributes.name: ngo_registration_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner's national NGO registration expires and must be renewed. Null if registration is perpetual. Triggers compliance alerts when approaching expiry.
attributes.references: Charity Commission (UK); National NGO Regulatory Frameworks

attributes.name: ngo_registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number issued by the national NGO regulatory authority or charity commission in the partner's country of primary operation. Key identifier for legal compliance verification.
attributes.references: Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations (US); National NGO Acts

attributes.name: overall_outcome
attributes.description: Final determination of the due diligence exercise indicating whether the partner is cleared for sub-award or partnership engagement. Approved with conditions requires a documented corrective action plan.

attributes.name: record_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference code assigned to this due diligence record, used in correspondence, audit trails, and donor reporting. Format: DDR-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Confidential narrative notes recorded by the responsible staff member summarizing key findings, concerns, and recommendations from the due diligence review. Restricted to compliance and partnership leadership.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Composite risk rating assigned to the partner following due diligence, reflecting financial, governance, compliance, and operational risk factors. Determines monitoring intensity and sub-award conditions.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303.3.6; FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric composite risk score (typically 0–100) calculated from weighted assessment criteria across financial, governance, legal, and operational dimensions. Supports quantitative risk ranking across the partner portfolio.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303; FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance

attributes.name: safeguarding_policy_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner has a documented and operational safeguarding policy covering protection from sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment (PSEAH), child protection, and GBV prevention, as required by IASC and donor standards.
attributes.references: IASC PSEA Framework; CHS Commitment 6; DFID Safeguarding Standards; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: sphere_compliance_status
attributes.description: Assessment of the partner's operational compliance with the Sphere Humanitarian Charter and Minimum Standards in Humanitarian Response, covering WASH, food security, shelter, and health sectors.
attributes.references: Sphere Association — Sphere Handbook 2018; IASC Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: supporting_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the document management system location where supporting due diligence evidence (audit reports, registration certificates, signed certifications) is stored.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.333; USAID ADS 303; IATI Standard v2.03

products.name: partner_contact
products.description: Master record for individual contacts within partner organizations including focal points, authorized representatives, technical leads, and financial officers. Captures name, title, role type, communication channels, language preference, and active status. Supports relationship management and coordination workflows across the partnership lifecycle.

attributes.name: partner_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the partner contact record. Primary key for the partner_contact data product within the partnership domain.

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner organization to which this contact belongs. Links the individual contact to their parent Civil Society Organization (CSO), Community-Based Organization (CBO), International Non-Governmental Organization (INGO), UN agency, government body, or consortium entity.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Partner/Account entity

attributes.name: user_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.user_account. Business justification: Partner contacts who have system access require linkage for core IAM processes: access provisioning when partnership starts, periodic access reviews, deprovisioning when contact leaves, security audit

attributes.name: cluster_membership
attributes.description: Name of the OCHA humanitarian cluster(s) or IASC working group(s) in which this contact participates as a representative or lead (e.g., WASH Cluster, Health Cluster, Protection Cluster, Food Security Cluster). Supports inter-agency coordination tracking.
attributes.references: OCHA Cluster Coordination Reference Module (CCRM); IASC Cluster Approach Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner contact provided or last renewed their data sharing consent. Used to track consent validity periods and trigger re-consent workflows in compliance with GDPR and organizational data protection policies.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 — Conditions for Consent; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the partner contact record. Indicates whether the contact is actively engaged in partnership coordination, temporarily unavailable, or no longer with the organization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud — Contact object (Status field); Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the partner contact is currently based or assigned. Used for geographic segmentation of partner networks and country-level coordination reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; IATI Standard v2.03 — Country codes

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the partner contact record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail entry point for the record's lifecycle in compliance with OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 record retention requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Record Retention; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner contact has provided explicit consent for their personal data to be shared with third parties, donor agencies, or inter-agency coordination bodies. Required for compliance with GDPR, data protection regulations, and the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) accountability principles.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 — Lawful Basis for Processing; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP Standard

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department or unit within the partner organization where the contact is based (e.g., Finance, Programs, Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL), Operations). Supports routing of communications to the correct functional area.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Contact entity

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates that the partner contact has requested to not be contacted, or has been flagged by the organization as ineligible for outreach. Overrides all communication workflows and must be respected in all outreach campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 — Right to Object; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud — Contact Preferences

attributes.name: duty_station
attributes.description: Specific city, town, or field location where the partner contact is stationed. Used in humanitarian operations to identify field presence, coordinate cluster meetings, and assign contacts to geographic response zones.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Coordination Guidelines; UN Common System — Duty Station classification

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner contact's engagement formally ended, such as upon departure from the organization or role change. Null for currently active contacts. Used to maintain historical records and audit trails.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Record Retention

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the partner contact individual. Used for personalized communication and formal correspondence across the partnership lifecycle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Data Protection Principles

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Self-identified gender of the partner contact. Used for gender disaggregation in partnership reporting, Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 5 compliance tracking, and gender-balanced stakeholder engagement analysis.
attributes.references: UN SDG 5 — Gender Equality; IASC Gender Handbook; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: is_authorized_signatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner contact is an authorized legal signatory for agreements such as Memoranda of Understanding (MoU), Letters of Agreement (LoA), sub-award agreements, and Scope of Work (SoW) documents. Critical for compliance with OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 and donor requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS Chapter 303; DFID Smart Rules

attributes.name: is_financial_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner contact holds financial authorization authority, such as approving sub-grant disbursements, signing financial reports, or authorizing Budget versus Actual (BvA) submissions. Supports financial stewardship and fund accounting controls.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; SAP S/4HANA for Nonprofits — Authorization Management

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this individual is the designated primary focal point for the partner organization. Only one contact per organization should be flagged as primary. Drives automated routing of official communications and partnership notifications.
attributes.references: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud — Contact object; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or designation of the partner contact within their organization (e.g., Country Director, Finance Manager, Program Coordinator). Used in formal correspondence and stakeholder mapping.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Contact entity; Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud — Contact object

attributes.name: last_interaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent recorded interaction or communication with the partner contact. Used to identify dormant relationships, prioritize re-engagement, and support relationship management workflows in the Constituent Relationship Management (CRM) system.
attributes.references: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud — Activity History; Raisers Edge NXT — Contact Management

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the partner contact individual. Combined with first_name to form the full display name for reporting and relationship management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Data Protection Principles

attributes.name: linkedin_profile
attributes.description: LinkedIn professional profile URL for the partner contact. Used for prospect research, due diligence verification, and professional background validation during partner capacity assessments.
attributes.references: Raisers Edge NXT — Prospect Research; Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud — Contact object

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or second given name of the partner contact, used in formal legal correspondence and official documentation such as Memoranda of Understanding (MoU) and Letters of Agreement (LoA).

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile or cellular phone number for the partner contact in E.164 international format. Critical for field operations communication, WhatsApp coordination, and emergency contact in humanitarian contexts.

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the nationality of the partner contact. Used for visa and travel coordination, national staff vs. international staff classification, and compliance with local labor regulations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, relationship history, or coordination notes about the partner contact. May include background on the contact's expertise, past collaboration history, or special communication instructions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud — Contact Notes; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits

attributes.name: office_address
attributes.description: Physical office address of the partner contact's workplace. Used for formal correspondence, field visit coordination, and partner mapping in Geographic Information System (GIS) tools.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: office_phone
attributes.description: Direct office or landline telephone number for the partner contact, including extension where applicable. Used for formal business communications and official coordination calls.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_channel
attributes.description: The partner contact's preferred communication channel for receiving outreach and coordination messages. Supports effective stakeholder engagement and respects communication preferences in diverse field contexts.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Accountability to Affected Populations; HAP Standard

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-3 language code representing the partner contact's preferred language for communications and documentation (e.g., 'en' for English, 'fr' for French, 'ar' for Arabic, 'es' for Spanish). Supports multilingual coordination in international humanitarian operations.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ISO 639-3; IATI Standard v2.03 — Language codes

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary professional email address for the partner contact. Used as the main digital communication channel for coordination, reporting, and official correspondence including Memoranda of Understanding (MoU) and Scope of Work (SoW) exchanges.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Data Protection

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the partner contact in E.164 international format. Used for urgent coordination, field communications, and stakeholder engagement across the partnership lifecycle.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; GDPR Article 4; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Functional role classification of the contact within the partnership relationship. Determines the contact's authority and responsibilities in coordination workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: focal_point|authorized_representative|technical_lead|financial_officer|program_manager|legal_signatory|cluster_coordinator|field_officer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OCHA Cluster Coordination Guidelines; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Honorific or title prefix used when addressing the partner contact in formal communications (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr., Prof.).
attributes.references: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud — Contact object (Salutation field)

attributes.name: secondary_email
attributes.description: Alternate or backup email address for the partner contact. Used when the primary email is unreachable or for personal/secondary organizational accounts.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud — Contact object

attributes.name: secondary_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-3 language code for the partner contact's secondary working language. Supports assignment of contacts to multilingual coordination meetings, cluster working groups, and OCHA-led inter-agency processes.

attributes.name: skype_handle
attributes.description: Skype username or identifier for the partner contact. Used for virtual coordination meetings, remote field communications, and inter-agency conference calls in areas with limited connectivity.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Contact entity

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this partner contact record originated (e.g., Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits, Raisers Edge NXT). Supports data lineage tracking and master data management reconciliation.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03 — Data Provenance; International Aid Transparency Initiative

attributes.name: source_system_contact_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to this contact record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Salesforce Contact ID, Dynamics 365 Contact GUID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing in the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 Metadata Registry; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner contact was first formally engaged or registered in the partnership management system. Marks the beginning of the contact's active role in the partnership lifecycle.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03 — Activity dates; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the partner contact record. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Record Retention; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner contact's identity and credentials were last verified as part of the partner due diligence process. Used to schedule re-verification cycles and maintain compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS 303; DFID Smart Rules

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the identity and credential verification process for the partner contact. Supports due diligence requirements for sub-award management and partner capacity assessments per USAID, DFID, and OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Subrecipient Monitoring; USAID ADS 303; DFID Smart Rules

products.name: agreement_amendment
products.description: Transactional record capturing formal modifications to existing partnership agreements including scope changes, budget realignments, no-cost extensions, period of performance adjustments, and signatory changes. Tracks amendment number, amendment type, effective date, justification, approval authority, and the specific clauses modified. Maintains the full amendment history of each agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each formal modification record to a partnership agreement. Serves as the primary key for the agreement_amendment entity.

attributes.name: partnership_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent partnership agreement (MoU, LoA, SoW, or sub-award) that this amendment modifies. Links the amendment to its originating agreement record.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Partnership Agreement Module

attributes.name: primary_agreement_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member record of the individual who formally approved this amendment. Links to the workforce domain for accountability and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Internal RACI Framework

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known sequential identifier for this amendment within the context of the parent agreement (e.g., AMD-2024-001). Used in official correspondence, donor reporting, and compliance filings. Supports full amendment history tracking per agreement.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the amendment record. Draft indicates preparation in progress; pending_approval indicates submission to approval authority; approved indicates fully executed; rejected indicates declined by approver; superseded indicates replaced by a subsequent amendment; withdrawn indicates retracted before approval.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Partnership Agreement Module; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: amendment_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title summarizing the purpose of the amendment (e.g., 'No-Cost Extension to December 2025', 'Budget Realignment Q3 2024'). Used in correspondence, dashboards, and partner communications.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Partnership Agreement Module

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formal modification being made to the agreement. Scope change alters deliverables or geographic coverage; budget realignment redistributes funds across cost categories; no-cost extension extends the period without additional funding; period of performance adjusts start/end dates; signatory change updates authorized representatives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scope_change|budget_realignment|no_cost_extension|period_of_performance|signatory_change|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; USAID ADS 303; DFID Smart Rules

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the individual, committee, or organizational body with delegated authority to approve this amendment (e.g., Country Director, Grants Manager, Donor Agreement Officer). Supports RACI accountability tracking.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; USAID ADS 303; Internal RACI Framework

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment was formally approved by the designated approval authority. Null if not yet approved or if rejected/withdrawn.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: beneficiary_target_change
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment modifies the target beneficiary numbers, population groups, or vulnerability criteria for the program. True = beneficiary targets modified; False = no change. Relevant for MEL/MEAL reporting and SDG indicator tracking.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; SPHERE Standards; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: budget_change_amount
attributes.description: The net monetary change to the agreement budget introduced by this amendment (revised_budget_amount minus original_budget_amount). Positive values indicate budget increases; negative values indicate reductions. Null for non-financial amendments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308

attributes.name: clauses_modified
attributes.description: Enumeration or description of the specific agreement clauses, articles, or sections that are modified by this amendment (e.g., 'Article 3 — Scope of Work, Article 7 — Budget'). Supports legal review and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this amendment record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with record-keeping requirements under 2 CFR 200 and FASB ASC 958.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts in this amendment record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency partnership portfolios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 958; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or URL pointing to the executed amendment document (signed PDF or equivalent). Supports audit trail and compliance evidence requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: donor_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference number, letter identifier, or correspondence tracking code for the donor's written prior approval of this amendment. Required for audit evidence when donor_prior_approval_required is True.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: donor_prior_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment requires prior written approval from the donor or prime recipient before implementation, as mandated under 2 CFR 200.308 or specific award terms. True = prior approval required; False = notification only or no approval needed.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment becomes legally binding and operationally effective. This is the real-world event date, distinct from the signature date or record creation timestamp. Critical for period-of-performance tracking and financial reporting.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all required signatories formally signed and executed the amendment document. May differ from the effective date when retroactive amendments are issued.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: extension_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the period of performance is extended by this amendment. Null for non-extension amendments. Used for program planning, resource allocation, and donor reporting on timeline changes.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: geographic_scope_change
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment modifies the geographic coverage or operational areas of the agreement (e.g., adding or removing districts, countries, or OCHA cluster areas). True = geographic scope modified; False = no geographic change.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; OCHA Coordination Framework

attributes.name: gms_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier for this amendment as recorded in the Grant Management System (GMS) or donor's award management platform (e.g., USAID ASIST, DFID ARIES). Enables cross-system reconciliation and donor audit support.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; DFID Smart Rules; Unit4 ERP — Grant Financial Management

attributes.name: iati_activity_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Activity ID
attributes.description: IATI-standard activity identifier associated with the parent agreement, used to publish amendment data to the IATI Registry for transparency and open data compliance. Format follows IATI hierarchical identifier standard.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; International Aid Transparency Initiative

attributes.name: is_no_cost_extension
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment constitutes a no-cost extension (NCE), extending the period of performance without additional funding. True = NCE; False = other amendment type. Critical for grant closeout planning and donor reporting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: justification
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the business rationale for the amendment, including the circumstances that necessitated the change (e.g., context changes, operational constraints, donor-directed modifications). Required for donor reporting and audit compliance under 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: ngo_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative of Ngo who signs this amendment on behalf of the organization. Required for legal enforceability and signatory change tracking.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; Internal Delegation of Authority Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal commentary, or operational notes related to this amendment that do not fit structured fields. Used by grants management and partnership teams for internal coordination.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Partnership Agreement Module

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total authorized budget of the agreement prior to this amendment, expressed in the agreement currency. Retained for Budget versus Actual (BvA) analysis and audit trail of financial modifications.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Unit4 ERP — Grant Financial Management

attributes.name: original_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Period of Performance End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the period of performance as defined in the agreement prior to this amendment. Used to calculate extension duration and track no-cost extension history.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: original_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Period of Performance Start Date
attributes.description: The start date of the period of performance as defined in the agreement prior to this amendment. Retained for audit trail and comparison purposes when a period-of-performance amendment is processed.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: partner_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative of the partner organization who signs this amendment on behalf of the CSO, CBO, INGO, government body, or UN agency. Required for signatory change amendments and legal enforceability.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: revised_beneficiary_target
attributes.description: Updated total number of direct beneficiaries targeted under the agreement following this amendment. Null if beneficiary_target_change is False. Used for MEL/MEAL indicator tracking and donor results reporting.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; SPHERE Standards; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total authorized budget of the agreement as updated by this amendment. Null if this amendment does not modify the budget. Used for BvA reporting and donor financial compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Unit4 ERP — Grant Financial Management

attributes.name: revised_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revised Period of Performance End Date
attributes.description: The updated end date of the period of performance as established by this amendment. Null if this amendment does not modify the end date. Key field for no-cost extension tracking.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: revised_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revised Period of Performance Start Date
attributes.description: The updated start date of the period of performance as established by this amendment. Null if this amendment does not modify the start date.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.308; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: scope_change_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing changes to the Scope of Work (SoW), program activities, geographic coverage, target beneficiary populations, or deliverables introduced by this amendment. Null if amendment type is not scope_change.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; DFID Smart Rules; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment request was formally submitted to the approval authority or donor/prime for review. Used to track processing timelines and compliance with advance notification requirements under 2 CFR 200.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this amendment record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Internal Data Governance Standard

products.name: partner_performance_review
products.description: Periodic performance review records for implementing partners assessing delivery against agreed SoW milestones, reporting compliance, financial accountability, and programmatic quality. Captures review period, performance rating, key findings, corrective action requirements, and reviewer details. Feeds into partnership renewal and risk management decisions.

attributes.name: partner_performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each partner performance review record. Primary key for the partner_performance_review data product.

attributes.name: implementation_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the program or project that the implementing partner is delivering under review.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Program Record

attributes.name: internal_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.internal_review. Business justification: Partner performance reviews may trigger or reference internal compliance reviews when issues are identified. Links performance monitoring to compliance oversight. Essential for integrated risk managem

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the implementing partner organisation being reviewed. Links to the partner master record in the partnership domain.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Partner/Account Record

attributes.name: partnership_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing agreement (MoU, LoA, SoW, or sub-award) under which this performance review is conducted.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Agreement Record

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to communication.communication_plan. Business justification: High-performing partnerships warrant visibility in donor communications, annual reports, and advocacy materials. Links performance reviews to communication plans for identifying success stories, coord

attributes.name: primary_partner_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member or team lead who conducted and is accountable for this performance review.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the performance review was formally approved by the authorised reviewer or partnership manager.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Internal Governance Policy

attributes.name: areas_for_improvement
attributes.description: Narrative description of performance gaps, weaknesses, or risks identified during the review that require corrective action or capacity strengthening.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: beneficiary_feedback_incorporated
attributes.description: Indicates whether beneficiary feedback (e.g., from Post-Distribution Monitoring (PDM), Focus Group Discussions (FGD), or KoboToolbox surveys) was incorporated into the review findings.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Commitment 4 (Participation); HAP Standard

attributes.name: budget_utilisation_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of the sub-award budget expended by the partner during the review period (0.00–100.00). Key Budget versus Actual (BvA) indicator for financial stewardship assessment.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; Unit4 ERP — Grant Financial Management

attributes.name: capacity_building_areas
attributes.description: Narrative description of specific capacity building areas recommended for the partner (e.g., financial management, MEL systems, safeguarding, ICT4D). Populated when capacity_building_recommended is True.
attributes.references: USAID Local Capacity Strengthening Policy; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: capacity_building_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer recommends a formal capacity building or organisational development intervention for the partner based on identified gaps.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; USAID Local Capacity Strengthening Policy

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of required corrective actions, including specific steps the partner must take to address identified deficiencies. Populated when corrective_action_required is True.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the partner must demonstrate completion of required corrective actions. Null when corrective_action_required is False.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Corrective Action Plan (CAP) is required as an outcome of this review. True triggers a CAP workflow in the partnership management system.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Subrecipient Monitoring; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the corrective action plan associated with this review. Tracks partner remediation progress for risk management and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance review record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Record Retention

attributes.name: field_visit_conducted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical field visit to the partner's implementation site was conducted as part of this review. Required for high-risk partners per OMB Uniform Guidance subrecipient monitoring standards.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Subrecipient Monitoring

attributes.name: financial_accountability_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the partner's financial management practices including Budget versus Actual (BvA) variance, expenditure documentation, and compliance with Indirect Cost Rate (ICR) / NICRA requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: key_findings_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the principal findings from the performance review covering programmatic, financial, and compliance dimensions. Informs partnership renewal and risk management decisions.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OECD DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance review record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Record Retention

attributes.name: milestone_achievement_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of agreed SoW milestones achieved within the review period (0.00–100.00). Key Results-Based Management (RBM) indicator for partner performance tracking.
attributes.references: OECD DAC Evaluation Criteria; Results-Based Management (RBM) Framework

attributes.name: milestones_achieved_count
attributes.description: Number of SoW milestones fully achieved within the review period. Numerator for milestone achievement rate calculation.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — SoW Milestone Tracking

attributes.name: milestones_planned_count
attributes.description: Total number of SoW milestones scheduled for delivery within the review period. Denominator for milestone achievement rate calculation.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — SoW Milestone Tracking

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next performance review of this partner under the current agreement. Determined by risk level and agreement terms.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Subrecipient Monitoring Frequency; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: overall_performance_rating
attributes.description: Composite performance rating assigned to the partner for the review period. Drives partnership renewal, risk classification, and sub-award decisions. Aligned with DAC evaluation criteria.
attributes.references: OECD DAC Evaluation Criteria; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: overall_performance_score
attributes.description: Numeric composite score (e.g., 0.00–100.00) aggregating all scored dimensions of the review. Enables quantitative ranking and trend analysis across partners.
attributes.references: OECD DAC Evaluation Criteria; Results-Based Management (RBM) Framework

attributes.name: partner_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the implementing partner formally acknowledged the review findings. Null until acknowledgement is received.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP Standard

attributes.name: partner_acknowledgement_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the implementing partner has formally acknowledged receipt of the review findings and agreed corrective actions. Required for CHS accountability compliance.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Commitment 5 (Complaints); HAP Standard

attributes.name: partnership_renewal_recommendation
attributes.description: Reviewer's recommendation on whether to renew, conditionally renew, or terminate the partnership agreement based on this review's findings. Feeds into partnership pipeline decisions.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OCHA Cluster Coordination Guidelines

attributes.name: programmatic_quality_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the partner's delivery quality against agreed SoW milestones, Theory of Change (ToC) outputs, and LogFrame indicators. Distinct from financial accountability.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; IASC Results-Based Management Framework

attributes.name: reporting_compliance_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the partner's adherence to agreed reporting schedules, SitRep submissions, and donor reporting requirements including IATI data publication obligations.
attributes.references: IATI Standard; OCHA Reporting Guidelines; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: reports_due_count
attributes.description: Total number of reports required from the partner during the review period per the agreement schedule.
attributes.references: IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: reports_submitted_count
attributes.description: Number of required narrative and financial reports submitted by the partner during the review period.
attributes.references: IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the performance review meeting or assessment was conducted with the partner.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Partner Accountability Framework

attributes.name: review_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to conduct the performance review. Field visits provide direct observation; desk reviews rely on submitted documentation; joint reviews involve donor or cluster lead participation.
attributes.references: OECD DAC Evaluation Criteria; OCHA Cluster Coordination Guidelines

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the performance period being assessed in this review. Together with review_period_start_date defines the assessment window.
attributes.references: IATI Standard — Reporting Period; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the performance period being assessed in this review. Aligns with the reporting cycle defined in the partner SoW.
attributes.references: IATI Standard — Reporting Period; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: review_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this review for tracking in correspondence, donor reports, and audit trails. Format: PPR-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) — Activity Identifier Standard

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the performance review record. Drives workflow routing for approval and archiving.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Partner Accountability Framework

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the review occasion. Scheduled reviews occur at fixed intervals per the SoW; triggered reviews are initiated by risk events or compliance concerns; final reviews occur at agreement close-out.
attributes.references: Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Subrecipient Monitoring

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned to the partner as an outcome of this review. Informs sub-award monitoring intensity, financial controls, and escalation protocols.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Risk Assessment; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: safeguarding_compliance_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the partner's compliance with safeguarding policies including GBV prevention, child protection, and HAP/CHS accountability commitments.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP Standard; IASC GBV Guidelines

attributes.name: strengths_noted
attributes.description: Narrative description of the partner's notable strengths and positive performance areas identified during the review. Used for learning and best-practice documentation.
attributes.references: OECD DAC Evaluation Criteria; Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Framework

products.name: consortium
products.description: Master record for multi-partner consortia and joint programming arrangements where Ngo acts as lead agency or member. Captures consortium name, lead organization, governance structure (steering committee composition, decision-making protocols), consortium agreement reference, geographic scope, thematic focus, total funding envelope, and operational status. Supports coordination with OCHA cluster leads, IASC working groups, and pooled fund mechanisms. Essential for Grand Bargain localization commitments and joint donor reporting.

attributes.name: consortium_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the consortium record. Primary key for the consortium master data product within the partnership domain.

attributes.name: advocacy_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to communication.advocacy_campaign. Business justification: Consortia frequently run joint advocacy campaigns on policy issues, humanitarian access, or localization. products.name: capacity_building_plan
products.description: Master record with embedded activity line-items for structured capacity-building interventions developed for partner organizations based on capacity assessment findings. Plan-level data captures objectives, targeted functional areas (financial management, HR, procurement, governance, MEL), timeline, responsible staff, budget allocation, and overall progress status. Activity-level line-items capture individual trainings, mentoring sessions, technical assistance visits, and peer learning events with delivery dates, facilitators, participant lists, topics covered, pre/post assessment scores, and completion status. Supports localization strategies, partner strengthening, and Grand Bargain commitments. This is the SSOT for all capacity-building planning and delivery tracking in the partnership domain.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Individual capacity building activities (workshops, training sessions) incur direct costs that must be charged to specific cost centers for activity-based costing and financial tracking. Required for

attributes.name: impact_story_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to communication.impact_story. Business justification: Capacity building outcomes (trained staff, improved systems, organizational transformation) are compelling impact narratives for donors and advocates. Links stories to specific capacity interventions

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the program or project under which this capacity-building activity is funded and implemented. Enables program-level aggregation of partner strengthening efforts.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP — Project Accounting module; IATI Activity Standard v2.03

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the partner organization (CSO, CBO, INGO, government body, UN agency, or consortium member) receiving this capacity-building activity. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Partner/Account entity; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal staff member or consultant who facilitated or led this capacity-building activity. Used for workload tracking and quality assurance reviews.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker entity; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits

attributes.name: system_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.system_platform. Business justification: Capacity building training delivered via LMS, webinar platforms, or e-learning systems. Tracking platform enables participant access management, completion tracking, certificate generation, technical

attributes.name: volunteer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to volunteer.volunteer. Business justification: Experienced volunteers frequently serve as trainers, facilitators, or peer mentors in partner capacity building activities. This is a core localization pattern where volunteer expertise builds partner

attributes.name: activity_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total direct cost incurred to deliver this capacity-building activity, expressed in US Dollars. Includes facilitator fees, venue, materials, and travel. Used for Budget versus Actual (BvA) tracking and cost-effectiveness analysis under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; Unit4 ERP — Project Accounting module

attributes.name: activity_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this capacity-building activity, used in partner communications, donor reports, and IATI disclosures. Format: CBA-{COUNTRY}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: IATI Activity Standard v2.03; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: activity_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capacity-building activity. Drives workflow management, MEL dashboard filtering, and completion reporting to donors. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Case/Activity Management; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: activity_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the capacity-building activity (e.g., 'Financial Management Training for Partner Finance Officers', 'MEAL System Technical Assistance Visit'). Used in reports and partner communications.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; IATI Activity Standard v2.03

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the modality or format of the capacity-building activity. Drives reporting disaggregation and MEL indicator tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: training|mentoring|technical_assistance|peer_learning|coaching|workshop|on_the_job_support|e_learning — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; USAID Capacity Development Framework

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The real-world date on which the capacity-building activity was delivered or commenced. The principal business event date for this transaction. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: IATI Activity Standard v2.03; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The real-world date on which the capacity-building activity concluded. Used to calculate actual duration and compare against planned schedule.
attributes.references: IATI Activity Standard v2.03; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Method used to evaluate participant knowledge or competency before and after the activity. Informs the validity and comparability of pre/post assessment scores across activities.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Capacity Development Guidelines; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: capacity_domain
attributes.description: High-level domain of organizational capacity being strengthened through this activity, aligned with standard capacity assessment frameworks. Used for portfolio-level gap analysis and Theory of Change (ToC) alignment.
attributes.references: USAID Organizational Capacity Assessment (OCA) Framework; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the accrediting or certifying body that issued the certificate for this activity (e.g., 'CHS Alliance', 'SPHERE Association', 'USAID', 'Internal'). Populated only when is_certified is True.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; SPHERE Association

attributes.name: completion_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of registered participants who completed the full capacity-building activity (attended all sessions or met minimum attendance threshold). Key MEL indicator for activity quality and partner engagement.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Reporting Requirements; IATI Activity Standard v2.03; DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the location where the capacity-building activity was delivered. Enables geographic disaggregation in MEL dashboards and OCHA cluster reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; OCHA Common Operational Datasets

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity-building activity record was first created in the system. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Mode through which the capacity-building activity was delivered to participants. Distinguishes face-to-face field visits from remote or blended approaches, relevant for cost analysis and ICT4D reporting.
attributes.references: USAID Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance (BHA) Capacity Development Guidelines; ICT4D Framework

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total number of contact hours delivered during this capacity-building activity. Used for MEL indicator reporting (e.g., total training hours delivered to partners) and cost-per-hour analysis.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Capacity Development Guidelines; IATI Activity Standard v2.03

attributes.name: facilitator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead facilitator or trainer who delivered this capacity-building activity. Captured for quality assurance, follow-up, and facilitator performance tracking. Classified confidential as it identifies a specific individual in a professional context.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker entity; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits

attributes.name: facilitator_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity or individual who facilitated the capacity-building activity. Distinguishes internal staff-led sessions from externally contracted consultants or peer-learning facilitated by other NGOs or UN agencies.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Capacity Development Guidelines; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: feedback_collected
attributes.description: Indicates whether participant feedback or a post-distribution monitoring (PDM) equivalent survey was collected for this capacity-building activity. Supports accountability and learning (MEAL) requirements.
attributes.references: HAP Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: female_participants
attributes.description: Number of female participants in this capacity-building activity. Required for gender disaggregation reporting per USAID Gender Equality Policy, DFID guidelines, and SDG 5 indicators.
attributes.references: USAID Gender Equality and Female Empowerment Policy; SDG 5; IATI Activity Standard v2.03

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the follow-up action identified after this capacity-building activity should be completed. Populated only when follow_up_required is True.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Case Management; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up visit, mentoring session, or technical assistance is required after this activity to reinforce learning or address outstanding gaps. Drives scheduling of subsequent capacity-building activities.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Case Management

attributes.name: is_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether a certificate of completion or competency was issued to participants upon successful completion of this capacity-building activity. Relevant for accredited training programs and professional development tracking.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; Workday HCM — Learning module

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity-building activity record was most recently modified. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and incremental ETL processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits

attributes.name: linked_capacity_gap
attributes.description: Description or reference code of the specific capacity gap identified in the partner's capacity assessment that this activity is designed to address. Enables traceability from gap identification to intervention delivery.
attributes.references: USAID Organizational Capacity Assessment (OCA) Framework; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Partner Capacity Assessment

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific city, district, or venue where the capacity-building activity took place (e.g., 'Nairobi Regional Office', 'Kampala Training Centre'). Complements country code for field-level geographic reporting.
attributes.references: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap; OCHA Common Operational Datasets

attributes.name: male_participants
attributes.description: Number of male participants in this capacity-building activity. Required for gender disaggregation reporting per USAID Gender Equality Policy and SDG 5 indicators.
attributes.references: USAID Gender Equality and Female Empowerment Policy; SDG 5; IATI Activity Standard v2.03

attributes.name: materials_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether training materials, toolkits, manuals, or job aids were distributed to participants as part of this capacity-building activity. Relevant for resource tracking and follow-up support planning.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; USAID BHA Capacity Development Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing qualitative observations, lessons learned, contextual factors, or any other relevant information about the capacity-building activity not captured in structured fields. Supports MEL narrative reporting.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: participant_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Average satisfaction rating provided by participants in post-activity feedback forms, typically on a scale of 1–5 or 1–10. Used for activity quality improvement and facilitator performance assessment.
attributes.references: HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: post_assessment_score
attributes.description: Average knowledge or competency assessment score recorded for participants after the capacity-building activity concluded. Compared against pre-assessment score to measure learning gain and activity effectiveness.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Capacity Development Guidelines; MEAL Framework; DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: pre_assessment_score
attributes.description: Average knowledge or competency assessment score recorded for participants before the capacity-building activity commenced. Used to establish a baseline for measuring learning gain. Expressed as a percentage (0–100). Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category (non-monetary).
attributes.references: USAID BHA Capacity Development Guidelines; MEAL Framework; DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the capacity-building activity was originally scheduled to conclude. Used for duration planning and workplan management.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Program Management module

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the capacity-building activity was originally scheduled to begin. Used for planning, calendar management, and variance analysis against actual delivery.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Program Management module

attributes.name: thematic_area
attributes.description: Primary thematic or sectoral focus of the capacity-building activity (e.g., 'Financial Management', 'MEAL', 'WASH', 'GBV Prevention', 'Procurement', 'Safeguarding', 'Proposal Writing'). Used for portfolio analysis and gap identification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: financial_management|meal|wash|gbv_prevention|procurement|safeguarding|proposal_writing|hr_management|logistics|governance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USAID Capacity Development Framework; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; SPHERE Standards

attributes.name: topics_covered
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of the specific topics, modules, or competencies addressed during the activity (e.g., 'Budget vs Actual reporting, SAP navigation, donor compliance rules'). Supports curriculum documentation and knowledge management.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; USAID BHA Capacity Development Guidelines

attributes.name: total_participants
attributes.description: Total number of individuals from the partner organization who participated in this capacity-building activity. Core MEL indicator for reach and coverage reporting to donors.
attributes.references: IATI Activity Standard v2.03; USAID BHA Reporting Requirements; DAC Evaluation Criteria

products.name: partner_risk_register
products.description: Master record maintaining the risk register for each partner organization covering fiduciary risk, programmatic risk, reputational risk, safeguarding risk, and compliance risk. Captures risk category, risk description, likelihood rating, impact rating, composite risk score, mitigation measures, risk owner, and review date. Feeds into sub-award management and oversight decisions.

attributes.name: partner_risk_register_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each risk entry in the partner risk register. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: due_diligence_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.due_diligence_record. Business justification: partner_risk_register stores capacity_assessment_score and capacity_assessment_date but has no FK to due_diligence_record. Risks are identified through due diligence processes. Adding due_diligence_re

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner organization for which this risk entry is recorded. Links to the partner master record.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Partner/Account Record

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member record of the designated risk owner responsible for monitoring and managing this risk. Enables automated escalation workflows and accountability tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker Record; CHS Alliance RACI Framework

attributes.name: subaward_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific sub-award agreement under which this risk is being assessed, if applicable. Links to the sub-award management record.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart F — Audit Requirements for Sub-Awards

attributes.name: composite_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated product of likelihood_rating multiplied by impact_rating (range 1–25), yielding the overall risk severity score used to prioritise mitigation actions and sub-award oversight decisions. Stored as a business-recorded value from the risk assessment process, not a real-time derived metric.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; USAID ADS 303 Risk Scoring Methodology

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk register entry was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker required for data governance and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: donor_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the risk event or materialisation requires formal notification to the donor per grant agreement terms (True). Relevant for USAID, DFID/FCDO, CERF, and other institutional donors with mandatory incident reporting clauses.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; DFID Smart Rules — Incident Reporting

attributes.name: donor_notified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the donor was formally notified of this risk or incident. Null if notification has not yet occurred or is not required. Used for compliance tracking against donor agreement notification timelines.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; DFID Smart Rules

attributes.name: due_diligence_level
attributes.description: Level of due diligence applied to this partner in relation to this risk: standard (routine checks), enhanced (additional scrutiny for high-risk partners), simplified (low-risk, minimal checks). Aligns with donor-mandated partner vetting requirements.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303 — Partner Vetting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; DFID Smart Rules

attributes.name: escalated_to
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual, committee, or external body to whom this risk was escalated (e.g., 'Country Director', 'Board Risk Committee', 'USAID Agreement Officer'). Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Core Humanitarian Standard; USAID ADS 303; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this risk was formally escalated to senior management, the board, or the donor. Null if escalation has not occurred. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Core Humanitarian Standard; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk has been flagged for escalation to senior management, the board, or the donor (True). Set automatically when risk_level is 'critical' or when safeguarding_risk_flag is True.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Core Humanitarian Standard; USAID ADS 303; OCHA Risk Escalation Protocols

attributes.name: fiduciary_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk entry has been classified as a fiduciary risk (True) involving financial management, fund accountability, or procurement integrity concerns. Triggers enhanced financial monitoring protocols.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart F; USAID ADS 303; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: financial_exposure_usd
attributes.description: Estimated maximum financial exposure in US Dollars associated with this risk, representing the value of funds at risk if the risk materialises (e.g., sub-award value at risk of misappropriation). Used in fiduciary risk prioritisation and BvA oversight.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 — Not-for-Profit Entities; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: impact_rating
attributes.description: Numeric score (1–5) representing the severity of consequences if the risk materialises: 1=Negligible, 2=Minor, 3=Moderate, 4=Major, 5=Catastrophic. Assessed across financial, programmatic, reputational, and safeguarding dimensions.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: inherent_impact_rating
attributes.description: Impact rating (1–5) assessed BEFORE any mitigation controls are applied. Together with inherent_likelihood_rating, establishes the gross risk score prior to control application.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: inherent_likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Likelihood rating (1–5) assessed BEFORE any mitigation controls are applied. Captures the gross/inherent risk level to benchmark the effectiveness of mitigation measures.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk entry was most recently reviewed and updated by the risk owner or oversight team. Used to flag stale entries requiring re-assessment.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331

attributes.name: likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Numeric score (1–5) representing the probability that the risk will materialise: 1=Rare, 2=Unlikely, 3=Possible, 4=Likely, 5=Almost Certain. Used in composite risk scoring per standard NGO risk matrices.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; USAID ADS 303 Risk Rating Scale

attributes.name: mitigation_measures
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific controls, actions, and safeguards implemented or planned to reduce the likelihood or impact of the risk. May include capacity-building, enhanced financial monitoring, spot-checks, or escalation protocols.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: mitigation_status
attributes.description: Current implementation status of the mitigation measures: planned (not yet started), in_progress (underway), completed (fully implemented), overdue (past target date without completion).
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; IASC Risk Management Policy

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this risk entry is actively monitored and reviewed: weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi_annual, annual, or ad_hoc. Drives scheduling of oversight activities and MEL review cycles.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; USAID ADS 303; IATI Standard

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this risk entry. Drives automated reminders and compliance with periodic risk review obligations under donor agreements.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; USAID ADS 303; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, or supplementary information related to this risk entry that does not fit into structured fields. May include references to related incident reports, audit findings, or SitRep entries.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs

attributes.name: oversight_mechanism
attributes.description: Description of the specific oversight mechanism applied to manage this risk (e.g., 'Monthly financial spot-checks', 'Quarterly field monitoring visits', 'Third-party audit', 'PDM surveys'). Documents the control environment for donor compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331; USAID ADS 303; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: risk_appetite_alignment
attributes.description: Assessment of whether this risk falls within the organisation's defined risk appetite: within_appetite (acceptable), at_tolerance (borderline, requires monitoring), exceeds_appetite (unacceptable, requires immediate action or sub-award suspension).
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; IASC Risk Management Policy; Charity Commission (UK) Risk Management Guidance

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the risk type: fiduciary (financial mismanagement, fraud), programmatic (delivery failure, quality gaps), reputational (media, political exposure), safeguarding (protection of beneficiaries and staff), or compliance (regulatory, donor-condition breaches).
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; USAID ADS 303 Partner Risk Assessment

attributes.name: risk_closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk was formally closed, either because it was fully mitigated, the sub-award ended, or the risk was deemed no longer applicable. Null if the risk remains open.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; IATI Standard

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nature of the risk, its potential causes, and the context in which it may materialise. Supports due diligence documentation and donor compliance reporting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331 — Requirements for Pass-Through Entities; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: risk_identification_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk was first formally identified and entered into the risk register. Marks the start of the risk lifecycle and is used for ageing analysis.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Qualitative risk band derived from the composite risk score: low (1–4), medium (5–9), high (10–16), critical (17–25). Used for traffic-light reporting in MEL dashboards, donor SitReps, and sub-award oversight decisions.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; OCHA Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: risk_materialisation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the risk was confirmed to have materialised into an actual incident or adverse event. Null if the risk has not materialised. Used for incident timeline analysis and donor reporting.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Core Humanitarian Standard; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: risk_materialised
