attributes.description: Indicates whether the identified risk has actually materialised into an incident or adverse event (True). When True, triggers incident management workflows and may require sub-award suspension or termination review.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; USAID ADS 303; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: risk_owner
attributes.description: Name or role title of the individual within the NGO responsible for monitoring and managing this risk entry. Typically a Program Manager, Grants Manager, or Country Director.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; RACI Framework

attributes.name: risk_register_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to this risk entry for cross-system reference and reporting (e.g., RR-FISC-2024-0012). Used in donor reports, audit trails, and compliance filings.
attributes.references: IATI Standard — Organisation and Activity Reporting; CHS Alliance Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the risk entry: open (identified, not yet addressed), under_review (being assessed), mitigated (controls applied), escalated (elevated to senior management or donor), closed (resolved or no longer applicable).
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; IASC Risk Management Policy

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: Granular classification within the risk category (e.g., 'Procurement Fraud' under fiduciary, 'GBV Incident' under safeguarding, 'FCPA Violation' under compliance). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: procurement_fraud|financial_misreporting|conflict_of_interest|gbv_incident|child_protection|data_breach|political_interference|media_exposure|delivery_failure|quality_failure|regulatory_breach|donor_condition_breach — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Risk Management for NGOs; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title summarising the risk (e.g., 'Inadequate financial controls at field office level'). Used as the primary label in risk dashboards and SitRep summaries.
attributes.references: IATI Standard — Activity Reporting; CHS Alliance Risk Register Template

attributes.name: safeguarding_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk entry involves safeguarding concerns (True), including GBV, child protection, or protection of beneficiaries and staff from exploitation and abuse. Triggers mandatory escalation per CHS safeguarding protocols.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Core Humanitarian Standard on Quality and Accountability; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; HAP Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk register entry was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Internal Data Governance Standard

products.name: mou_obligation
products.description: Tracks specific obligations, deliverables, and commitments defined within MoUs and partnership agreements. Captures obligation description, responsible party, due date, completion status, evidence of fulfillment, and escalation status. Enables systematic monitoring of whether both parties are meeting their agreed commitments under each partnership instrument.

attributes.name: mou_obligation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each obligation, deliverable, or commitment record defined within an MoU or partnership agreement. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI)

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.award. Business justification: MOU obligations frequently derive from specific award compliance requirements, donor special conditions, and regulatory flow-down clauses. Tracking which award drives each obligation is essential for

attributes.name: field_monitoring_visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.field_monitoring_visit. Business justification: mou_obligation has verified_date and verified_by_name but no link to the field_monitoring_visit where verification occurred. Obligations are often verified during field monitoring visits. Adding field

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.intervention. Business justification: MOU obligations (deliverables, milestones, reporting requirements) are tied to specific program interventions for performance monitoring, results verification, and intervention-level obligation tracki

attributes.name: partnership_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent MoU, LoA, SoW, or sub-award agreement under which this obligation is defined. Links the obligation to its governing partnership instrument.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: achieved_value
attributes.description: Actual quantitative result achieved against the target value at the time of completion or latest reporting. Enables performance tracking and BvA (Budget versus Actual) style analysis for non-financial obligations.
attributes.references: RBM Framework; IATI Standard; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: amendment_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or description of the partnership agreement amendment that introduced or modified this obligation. Null for obligations defined in the original agreement. Supports change management and audit trail.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: capacity_building_component
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this obligation includes a capacity building or institutional strengthening component for the partner organization (e.g., training, mentoring, systems development). Supports partner capacity assessment tracking.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; USAID Local Capacity Strengthening Policy

attributes.name: cluster_lead_agency
attributes.description: Name of the OCHA cluster lead agency (e.g., UNICEF for WASH, WFP for Food Security, UNHCR for Shelter) under whose coordination framework this obligation falls. Relevant for obligations arising from cluster coordination commitments.
attributes.references: OCHA Cluster System; IASC Reference Module for Cluster Coordination

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the obligation was fulfilled and accepted by the receiving party. Null if the obligation has not yet been completed. Used to calculate timeliness and compliance metrics.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this obligation record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the financial_value_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required when financial_value_amount is populated.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this obligation is past its due_date without completion, as of the last system refresh. Populated only when obligation_status is 'overdue'. Used for escalation prioritization and partner performance scoring.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: donor_reference_number
attributes.description: The donor's own reference number or grant award number associated with this obligation, where the obligation is tied to a specific donor-funded grant. Enables traceability from obligation to donor grant for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: USAID BHA; DFID; CERF; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The agreed deadline by which the obligation must be fulfilled, as specified in the partnership instrument. Drives automated reminders, escalation triggers, and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this obligation was formally escalated to senior management, the donor, or a dispute resolution mechanism due to non-fulfillment or contested completion.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: escalation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the reason for escalation, actions taken, and resolution steps. Captures the escalation history for audit and learning purposes.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP Standards

attributes.name: escalation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation has been escalated due to non-compliance or dispute: none (no escalation), flagged (internally noted as at-risk), escalated (formally raised to senior management or donor), or resolved (escalation closed after remediation).
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: evidence_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the evidence submitted to demonstrate fulfillment of this obligation (e.g., 'Quarterly narrative report submitted via email on 2024-03-31', 'Training attendance register and photos uploaded to SharePoint'). Supports audit and compliance review.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: evidence_document_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, URL, or unique document identifier pointing to the supporting evidence artifact (report, photo, attendance list, financial statement) that demonstrates fulfillment of this obligation.
attributes.references: IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: financial_value_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value associated with this obligation where it involves a financial commitment (e.g., sub-grant tranche disbursement, in-kind contribution valuation, or cost-sharing commitment). Null for non-financial obligations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 (Not-for-Profit Entities); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: geographic_location
attributes.description: Sub-national geographic scope of the obligation (e.g., region, district, camp, or settlement name) where the deliverable is to be executed. Supports GIS-based field operations monitoring.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap

attributes.name: indicator_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific KPI or MEL indicator that this obligation contributes to, as defined in the partnership's MEAL framework or donor reporting requirements. Supports DHIS2 indicator tracking and MEL dashboard reporting.
attributes.references: MEAL Framework; DHIS2; DAC Evaluation Criteria; IATI Standard

attributes.name: is_critical_obligation
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this obligation is classified as critical to the partnership's core deliverables or donor compliance requirements. Critical obligations trigger priority escalation workflows and are highlighted in SitRep and donor reporting.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: is_donor_reportable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether fulfillment of this obligation must be reported to the donor (e.g., USAID BHA, DFID, CERF). Drives inclusion in donor compliance reports and IATI activity updates.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Reporting Requirements; DFID Reporting Standards; CERF Guidelines; IATI Standard

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this obligation record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: logframe_output_reference
attributes.description: Reference code or label linking this obligation to a specific output, outcome, or activity in the partnership's Logical Framework (LogFrame) or Theory of Change (ToC). Enables Results-Based Management (RBM) tracking and MEL alignment.
attributes.references: DAC (Development Assistance Committee) Evaluation Criteria; IATI Standard; RBM Framework

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, clarifications, or internal commentary related to this obligation that does not fit into structured fields. Used by partnership managers for operational notes and follow-up actions.

attributes.name: obligation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the obligation, deliverable, or commitment as defined in the partnership instrument. Captures the full scope, quality standards, and acceptance criteria agreed upon by both parties.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: obligation_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code or clause reference identifying this obligation within the partnership instrument (e.g., 'MOU-2024-001-OBL-03', or clause reference 'Section 4.2.1'). Used in partner communications and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: obligation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the obligation: pending (not yet started), in_progress (work underway), completed (fulfilled and verified), overdue (past due date without completion), waived (formally excused by mutual agreement), or disputed (fulfillment contested by either party).
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: obligation_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title summarizing the obligation or deliverable (e.g., 'Quarterly Program Progress Report', 'WASH Training for 50 Community Health Workers'). Used in dashboards and partner communications.

attributes.name: obligation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the obligation by its nature: deliverable (tangible output), reporting (narrative or data submission), financial (fund transfer or accounting), capacity_building (training or institutional strengthening), coordination (attendance at cluster/working group meetings), or compliance (regulatory or donor requirement). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deliverable|reporting|financial|capacity_building|coordination|compliance — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; IASC Reference Module for Cluster Coordination

attributes.name: operational_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country where this obligation is to be fulfilled. Enables geographic filtering and country-level compliance reporting.

attributes.name: program_sector
attributes.description: The humanitarian or development sector to which this obligation relates (e.g., WASH, GBV, Health, Education, Food Security, Shelter, PSS, Nutrition). Aligns with OCHA cluster system and IATI sector codes for cross-program reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Cluster System; IATI Standard Sector Codes; SDG Framework

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation is a one-time commitment or a recurring one, and if recurring, the frequency: monthly, quarterly, semi_annual, annual, or ad_hoc. Drives automated scheduling of future obligation instances.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: reminder_days_before_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before the due_date that an automated reminder notification should be triggered to the responsible focal point and partnership manager. Configurable per obligation based on complexity and risk.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Program Management

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the reporting or performance period to which this obligation applies. Together with reporting_period_start_date, defines the window for periodic compliance obligations.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the reporting or performance period to which this obligation applies. Used for periodic obligations (e.g., quarterly reports, monthly financial submissions) to align with donor reporting cycles.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard

attributes.name: responsible_focal_point_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual designated as the primary focal point accountable for fulfilling this obligation on behalf of the responsible party. Used for escalation and follow-up communications.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; RACI Framework

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Indicates which party bears primary responsibility for fulfilling this obligation: lead_organization (the NGO itself), partner_organization (the CSO, CBO, INGO, or government counterpart), both_parties (joint obligation), or third_party (a designated sub-contractor or consortium member).
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; RACI Framework

attributes.name: target_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the target value (e.g., 'beneficiaries', 'households', 'training sessions', 'metric tons', 'reports'). Required when target_value is populated to give the quantity business meaning.
attributes.references: IATI Standard; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Quantitative target associated with this obligation (e.g., number of beneficiaries to be reached, number of training sessions to be conducted, quantity of NFIs to be distributed). Null for qualitative obligations.
attributes.references: RBM Framework; IATI Standard; DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: verified_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the staff member or authorized representative who verified and accepted the fulfillment evidence for this obligation on behalf of the receiving party.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the receiving party formally verified and accepted the evidence of fulfillment for this obligation. Distinct from completion_date, which is when the responsible party submitted the deliverable.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standards

attributes.name: waiver_justification
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of why this obligation was formally waived by mutual agreement of both parties. Required when obligation_status is 'waived'. Documents the business rationale for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

products.name: partner_accreditation
products.description: Tracks formal accreditations, certifications, and standards compliance held by partner organizations including CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard) certification, Sphere compliance, HAP membership, ISO certifications, and national NGO registration status. Captures accreditation body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, and verification status. Supports due diligence and quality assurance.
products.reference: CHS Certification / Sphere Compliance / NGO Accreditation

attributes.name: partner_accreditation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each partner accreditation record. Primary key for the partner_accreditation data product.

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner organization that holds this accreditation. Links to the partner_org master record.

attributes.name: accreditation_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code or identifier for the accreditation scheme (e.g., 'CHS', 'SPHERE', 'HAP', 'ISO9001', 'ISO27001', 'NGO-REG'). Used for filtering, reporting, and cross-partner comparisons in MEL dashboards.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); Sphere Association; ISO Standards; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership)

attributes.name: accreditation_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the accreditation, certification, or standard (e.g., 'Core Humanitarian Standard Certification', 'ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management', 'Sphere Humanitarian Standards Compliance', 'HAP Membership', 'National NGO Registration – Kenya'). Human-readable label used in due diligence reports and partner dashboards.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); Sphere Association; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership); ISO 9001

attributes.name: accreditation_score
attributes.description: Numeric score or rating assigned by the accrediting body upon assessment, where applicable (e.g., CHS self-assessment score out of 100, ISO audit score). Null if the accreditation is pass/fail with no numeric score. Used in partner capacity assessment scoring and due diligence risk rating calculations.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership)

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accreditation record. 'active' indicates the accreditation is valid and in force; 'expired' indicates the validity period has lapsed; 'suspended' indicates temporary withdrawal by the accrediting body; 'pending_renewal' indicates renewal application submitted; 'withdrawn' indicates permanent revocation; 'under_review' indicates the accrediting body is conducting a review.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations (US); CHS Alliance

attributes.name: accreditation_type
attributes.description: Broad category of the accreditation record. Distinguishes between formal certifications (e.g., CHS, ISO), membership bodies (e.g., HAP), national NGO registrations, compliance standards (e.g., Sphere), licenses, and awards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: certification|membership|registration|compliance_standard|license|award — promote to reference product if additional values emerge]
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); Sphere Association; International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI)

attributes.name: accrediting_body_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the accrediting body is domiciled or where the registration is issued (e.g., 'CHE' for Switzerland-based CHS Alliance, 'GBR' for UK Charity Commission). Supports geographic compliance analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations (US)

attributes.name: accrediting_body_name
attributes.description: Full name of the organization or authority that issued the accreditation or certification (e.g., 'CHS Alliance', 'Sphere Association', 'Bureau Veritas', 'Kenya NGO Coordination Board', 'ISO Certification Body'). Critical for verification and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); Sphere Association; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership); ISO Standards

attributes.name: applicable_standard_version
attributes.description: Version or edition of the standard or framework against which the accreditation was assessed (e.g., 'CHS 2018', 'Sphere 2018', 'ISO 9001:2015'). Important for tracking compliance against evolving standards and identifying partners certified to outdated versions.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); Sphere Association; ISO Standards

attributes.name: assessment_level
attributes.description: Indicates the rigor and methodology of the accreditation assessment. 'full' denotes a comprehensive third-party audit; 'partial' denotes assessment of selected components; 'self_assessment' denotes partner-reported compliance without external verification; 'third_party' denotes independent external audit; 'peer_review' denotes assessment by peer organizations. Informs the weight given to the accreditation in due diligence scoring.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Official certificate or registration number issued by the accrediting body. Serves as the externally-known unique identifier for the accreditation document. Used for verification with the issuing body and referenced in due diligence reports and donor compliance submissions.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); ISO Standards; Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations (US)

attributes.name: chs_commitment_level
attributes.description: For CHS-specific accreditations, records the highest CHS commitment level achieved by the partner organization (Commitments 1–9 per the CHS framework). Null for non-CHS accreditations. Supports CHS-aligned partner quality benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commitment_1|commitment_2|commitment_3|commitment_4|commitment_5|commitment_6|commitment_7|commitment_8|commitment_9 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); CHS Alliance Verification Scheme

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this accreditation record was first created in the system. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958 (Not-for-Profit Entities); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or URL pointing to the scanned certificate or official accreditation document stored in Ngo's document repository. Enables auditors and compliance staff to retrieve the source document for verification.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations (US)

attributes.name: document_upload_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation certificate document was uploaded to Ngo's document management system. Used to assess document currency and flag records where the uploaded document may be outdated relative to the most recent renewal. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Internal Document Management Policy

attributes.name: donor_reference
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the donor that mandates this accreditation as a grant or sub-award condition (e.g., 'USAID/BHA', 'FCDO', 'CERF'). Populated only when donor_required is True. Supports grant compliance reporting and sub-award management.
attributes.references: USAID (United States Agency for International Development); BHA (Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance); DFID (Department for International Development); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: donor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific accreditation is required by a donor as a condition of a grant or sub-award agreement. True if mandated by a donor (e.g., USAID, DFID/FCDO, CERF); False otherwise. Supports grant compliance tracking and sub-award due diligence.
attributes.references: USAID (United States Agency for International Development); DFID (Department for International Development); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; CERF (Central Emergency Response Fund)

attributes.name: due_diligence_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight assigned to this accreditation in Ngo's partner due diligence scoring model (e.g., 0.25 for 25% weight). Reflects the relative importance of this accreditation type in the overall partner risk rating calculation. Configured by the Partnership team in alignment with donor requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Ngo Partner Due Diligence Policy; Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation, certification, or registration expires and must be renewed. Null for accreditations with no fixed expiry. Used to trigger renewal workflows and flag partners with lapsed credentials in due diligence reviews. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); ISO Standards; Charity Commission (UK); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: geographic_applicability
attributes.description: Country or region where this accreditation is valid and recognized. May be a specific ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., 'KEN', 'ETH'), a regional designation, or 'GLOBAL' for internationally recognized accreditations. Supports geographic due diligence and partner deployment decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative); OCHA (Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs)

attributes.name: iati_activity_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Activity Identifier
attributes.description: IATI activity identifier associated with the partnership or program context in which this accreditation was assessed or required. Supports IATI-compliant transparency reporting and donor traceability.
attributes.references: IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative); IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: is_mandatory_for_partnership
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accreditation is a mandatory prerequisite for Ngo to enter into or maintain a partnership agreement with this organization. True if required by Ngo's partnership policy, donor conditions, or regulatory requirements; False if optional or informational. Drives partnership eligibility checks.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); Ngo Partnership Policy

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrediting body formally issued or granted the accreditation, certification, or registration. Marks the start of the accreditation's validity period. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); ISO Standards; Charity Commission (UK)

attributes.name: max_possible_score
attributes.description: The maximum score achievable under the accreditation assessment framework, used to contextualize the accreditation_score (e.g., 100 for a percentage-based CHS assessment). Null if the accreditation is pass/fail. Enables normalized cross-partner comparisons.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, conditions, limitations, or observations related to this accreditation record. May include details of any conditions attached to the accreditation, findings from the assessment, or follow-up actions required. Used by partnership officers during due diligence reviews.

attributes.name: renewal_alert_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the accreditation expiry_date at which an automated renewal alert should be triggered for the partnership management team. Configurable per accreditation type (e.g., 90 days for CHS certification, 30 days for national NGO registration). Supports proactive compliance management.
attributes.references: Internal Partnership Management Policy; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the partner organization submitted or is scheduled to submit a renewal application for this accreditation. Distinct from expiry_date (when it lapses) and issue_date (when originally granted). Supports proactive renewal tracking and partner capacity management workflows.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); ISO Standards

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the scope, coverage, or applicability of the accreditation. Specifies which programs, sectors, geographic areas, or operational activities the accreditation covers (e.g., 'WASH and shelter programs in East Africa', 'Financial management systems only'). Supports targeted due diligence assessments.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); Sphere Association; IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative)

attributes.name: thematic_sector
attributes.description: The humanitarian or development sector to which this accreditation primarily applies (e.g., 'WASH', 'GBV', 'Health', 'Education', 'Shelter', 'Food Security', 'PSS'). Supports sector-specific partner capability mapping and program design. Uses common humanitarian sector taxonomy aligned with OCHA cluster system.
attributes.references: OCHA (Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs); IASC (Inter-Agency Standing Committee); Sphere Association

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this accreditation record was most recently modified. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958 (Not-for-Profit Entities); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which Ngo staff last verified the accreditation with the issuing body. Used to assess how current the verification is and to schedule re-verification cycles. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS)

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether Ngo staff have independently verified the accreditation with the issuing body. 'verified' means the certificate has been confirmed as authentic and current; 'unverified' means no verification has been performed; 'pending_verification' means verification is in progress; 'verification_failed' means the accrediting body could not confirm the certificate. Critical for due diligence quality assurance.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership)

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or staff identifier of the Ngo staff member who performed the most recent verification of this accreditation with the issuing body. Supports audit trail and accountability for due diligence processes.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS)

products.name: field_monitoring_visit
products.description: Transactional record for field monitoring and supportive supervision visits conducted by Ngo staff to implementing partner project sites as part of sub-award oversight obligations. Captures visit date, site location, visit purpose (programmatic monitoring, financial spot-check, safeguarding audit, asset verification), findings categorized by severity, recommendations, corrective action plans with deadlines, and follow-up verification status. Distinct from MEL domain programmatic monitoring: this product focuses on partner compliance and sub-award oversight rather than program outcome measurement. Supports donor compliance requirements for partner monitoring under USAID ADS 303 and 2 CFR 200.332.

attributes.name: field_monitoring_visit_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each field monitoring and supportive supervision visit record. Primary key for the field_monitoring_visit data product.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.award. Business justification: Field monitoring visits verify partner compliance with specific award terms, donor conditions, and programmatic requirements. Award context determines visit scope, checklist items, and whether finding

attributes.name: capacity_building_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.capacity_building_plan. Business justification: field_monitoring_visit has corrective_action_plan_required (BOOLEAN) and corrective_action_plan_status (STRING) but no FK to an actual plan. When field visits identify issues, corrective action plans

attributes.name: compliance_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.incident. Business justification: Field monitoring visits may identify compliance incidents (fraud, safeguarding violations, financial irregularities). Direct discovery-to-incident link for audit trail. Critical for incident reporting

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Field monitoring visits incur costs (travel, accommodation, per diem, local transport) that must be charged to specific cost centers for expense tracking and budget management. Essential for monitorin

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.intervention. Business justification: Field monitoring visits assess partner implementation quality of specific interventions. Linking visit to intervention enables program-level quality assurance, intervention-specific findings aggregati

attributes.name: it_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.it_asset. Business justification: Field monitoring visits use specific equipment (tablets, GPS devices, cameras) for data collection. Linking to it_asset enables equipment accountability, maintenance scheduling, insurance claims for d

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the implementing partner organization being monitored during this visit. Links to the partner_org master record in the partnership domain.

attributes.name: partnership_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sub-award agreement, MoU, LoA, or SoW under which this monitoring visit is conducted, linking oversight activity to the specific binding instrument.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: prior_visit_field_monitoring_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous field monitoring visit record for the same partner and site, enabling longitudinal tracking of compliance trends and verification of prior corrective actions.

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Ngo staff member who led and is responsible for this field monitoring visit. Links to the workforce staff_member record.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: volunteer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to volunteer.volunteer. Business justification: Volunteers with specialized expertise (technical advisors, monitoring specialists) routinely participate in partner monitoring visits. Standard practice in consortium arrangements and quality assuranc

attributes.name: assets_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether donor-funded assets (equipment, vehicles, NFI stocks, infrastructure) were physically verified against the partner's asset register during this monitoring visit.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.313

attributes.name: beneficiaries_interviewed_count
attributes.description: Number of program beneficiaries or Persons of Concern (PoC) directly interviewed or consulted during the monitoring visit as part of accountability and feedback mechanisms.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; HAP Standards; Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which the partner is required to submit or fully implement the Corrective Action Plan (CAP) addressing findings from this monitoring visit.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the monitoring visit findings require the partner to develop and submit a formal Corrective Action Plan (CAP) to address identified non-compliance issues.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Corrective Action Plan (CAP) associated with this monitoring visit, tracking partner response from submission through acceptance.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this field monitoring visit record was first created in the grant management system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of findings classified as critical severity (requiring immediate corrective action, potential sub-award suspension, or donor notification) identified during the visit.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: donor_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the severity of findings from this monitoring visit triggers a mandatory notification obligation to the prime donor (e.g., USAID, DFID/FCDO, CERF) under the terms of the prime award.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; BHA Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: financial_findings_summary
attributes.description: Narrative description of financial management findings from the spot-check component of the visit, including observations on expenditure documentation, procurement compliance, BvA accuracy, and fund accounting practices.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of key findings from the monitoring visit, capturing the most significant observations across programmatic, financial, safeguarding, and operational dimensions for inclusion in monitoring reports.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: follow_up_visit_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the follow-up verification visit must be completed to confirm corrective action implementation and close outstanding findings.

attributes.name: follow_up_visit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a subsequent field monitoring visit is required to verify implementation of corrective actions or to conduct additional oversight based on findings from this visit.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to this field monitoring visit record, supporting change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of findings classified as major severity (significant non-compliance requiring corrective action within a defined timeframe) identified during the visit.

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of findings classified as minor severity (observations or recommendations for improvement that do not constitute material non-compliance) identified during the visit.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: monitoring_checklist_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the standardized monitoring checklist or tool used during the visit (e.g., KoboToolbox form version, internal checklist version number), ensuring reproducibility and comparability across visits.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox; USAID ADS 303; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: overall_compliance_rating
attributes.description: Aggregate compliance rating assigned to the partner following the monitoring visit, summarizing the overall level of adherence to sub-award terms, donor requirements, and organizational standards.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: partner_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner organization formally acknowledged receipt of the monitoring visit report and findings, initiating the corrective action response timeline.

attributes.name: partner_rep_name
attributes.description: Full name of the senior partner organization representative who received the monitoring team and participated in the opening and closing meetings during the visit.

attributes.name: program_sector
attributes.description: Humanitarian or development sector of the program being monitored (e.g., WASH, GBV, Nutrition, Education, Shelter, Health, Livelihoods, PSS). Aligns with OCHA cluster system and IATI sector codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wash|gbv|nutrition|education|shelter|health|livelihoods|pss|food_security|protection — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OCHA Cluster System; IATI Sector Vocabulary; DAC Sector Codes

attributes.name: safeguarding_findings_summary
attributes.description: Narrative description of safeguarding and protection findings from the visit, including observations on GBV prevention measures, child protection protocols, complaint and feedback mechanisms, and CHS compliance.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards; HAP Standards

attributes.name: site_admin1_name
attributes.description: First-level administrative division (state, province, region, governorate) where the monitored project site is located, aligned with OCHA Common Operational Datasets (COD) administrative boundaries.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap

attributes.name: site_admin2_name
attributes.description: Second-level administrative division (district, county, department, woreda) where the monitored project site is located, supporting geographic disaggregation in SitRep and donor reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap

attributes.name: site_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country where the monitored project site is located.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IATI Activity Standard; OCHA Geographic Standards

attributes.name: site_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the monitored project site in decimal degrees (WGS84), enabling GIS mapping and spatial analysis of monitoring coverage.
attributes.references: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap; OCHA GIS Standards; WGS84

attributes.name: site_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the monitored project site in decimal degrees (WGS84), enabling GIS mapping and spatial analysis of monitoring coverage.
attributes.references: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap; OCHA GIS Standards; WGS84

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific partner project site, field office, distribution point, health facility, or community location visited during the monitoring exercise.

attributes.name: staff_interviewed_count
attributes.description: Number of partner organization staff members interviewed or consulted during the monitoring visit, supporting assessment of organizational capacity and program implementation quality.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: total_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct findings documented during the monitoring visit across all severity levels, providing a quantitative measure of monitoring intensity and partner compliance issues.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: visit_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the field monitoring visit was conducted at the partner project site. Principal real-world event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: visit_end_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the field monitoring visit concluded at the partner site, enabling duration tracking and staff time reporting.

attributes.name: visit_purpose
attributes.description: Primary objective classification of the field monitoring visit. Determines the scope of review activities, checklists applied, and reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: programmatic_monitoring|financial_spot_check|safeguarding_audit|asset_verification|capacity_building|closeout_review — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: visit_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to the visit for tracking in grant management systems, donor reports, and partner correspondence. Format: FMV-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; 2 CFR 200.332; IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: visit_report_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the completed field monitoring visit report was formally submitted to the partnership management team and/or uploaded to the grant management system.

attributes.name: visit_report_url
attributes.description: URL or document management system path to the full field monitoring visit report, including all findings, recommendations, and supporting evidence uploaded to the GMS or document repository.

attributes.name: visit_start_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the field monitoring visit commenced at the partner site, used for scheduling, duration calculation, and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: visit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the field monitoring visit record, tracking progression from planning through completion and any required follow-up actions.

attributes.name: visit_type
attributes.description: Modality of the monitoring visit indicating whether the partner was notified in advance (announced), visited without prior notice (unannounced), conducted remotely, or performed as a desk review of submitted documentation.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.332

products.name: partner_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between partner_org and obligation. It captures the assignment of specific compliance obligations to partner organizations, tracking partner-specific compliance status, responsible focal points, and completion tracking. Each record links one partner organization to one compliance obligation with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship: which partner must fulfill which obligation, who is responsible, when it is due, and whether it has been completed.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit operations, partner organizations are subject to multiple compliance obligations (IRS filings, donor reporting, audit requirements, registration renewals), and each compliance obligation applies to multiple partner organizations. The NGO actively manages partner compliance tracking as an operational process: assigning obligations to partners, monitoring due dates, tracking completion status, and escalating overdue items. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process where compliance officers create, update, and monitor partner-specific compliance assignments.

attributes.name: partner_compliance_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a partner compliance assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to compliance.obligation. Identifies which compliance obligation this partner must fulfill.

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to partnership.partner_org. Identifies which partner organization this compliance obligation applies to.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: The date when this obligation was assigned to this partner. Used to track when the compliance requirement became applicable to this partner relationship.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date when this partner successfully completed or submitted this obligation. Null if not yet completed. Used for compliance reporting and performance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this partner compliance assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which this partner must fulfill this obligation. May differ from the obligation's global next_due_date if partner-specific extensions or custom schedules apply. Used for monitoring and escalation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this partner compliance assignment record was most recently modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes specific to this partner's fulfillment of this obligation. May include partner-specific instructions, exceptions, submission details, or follow-up actions. Supplements the global obligation notes with partner-specific context.

attributes.name: partner_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of this partner's fulfillment of this specific obligation. Tracks lifecycle from assignment through completion. Values: assigned (obligation applies but work not started), in_progress (partner actively working on fulfillment), submitted (partner submitted but pending review), completed (successfully fulfilled), overdue (past due date without completion), waived (obligation waived for this partner), not_applicable (determined not to apply to this partner).

attributes.name: responsible_focal_point
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the specific individual at the partner organization responsible for fulfilling this obligation. May reference a contact from partner_org embedded contact records or be a free-text name. Used for accountability and follow-up communications.

attributes.name: waiver_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether a waiver has been requested or granted for this partner for this obligation. Values: none (no waiver), requested (partner requested waiver, pending decision), approved (waiver granted, obligation does not apply), denied (waiver request rejected, obligation still applies). Used when partners seek exemptions from specific obligations.

products.name: campaign_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between partner organizations and advocacy campaigns. It captures each partner's role, contribution type, visibility level, and approval status for their involvement in specific campaigns. Each record links one partner organization to one advocacy campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship. This is the operational record of partner engagement in advocacy, awareness, and fundraising campaigns managed by the communications team.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit operations, partner organizations participate in multiple advocacy campaigns simultaneously (e.g., a CSO may be involved in a humanitarian access campaign, a localization advocacy initiative, and a policy reform campaign at the same time). Each advocacy campaign involves multiple partner organizations with distinct roles (lead, supporting, implementing). The communications team actively manages these participation relationships, tracking each partner's role, contribution type, visibility level, and approval status per campaign for coordination, attribution, and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: campaign_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a specific partner organization's participation in a specific advocacy campaign.

attributes.name: advocacy_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to communication.advocacy_campaign identifying which campaign the partner is participating in.

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to partnership.partner_org identifying which partner organization is participating.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval status of the partner organization's participation in this campaign. Pending indicates invitation sent but not yet confirmed; approved indicates partner has confirmed participation; declined indicates partner declined the invitation; withdrawn indicates partner initially approved but later withdrew. This tracks the lifecycle of each participation relationship.

attributes.name: contribution_type
attributes.description: The type of contribution the partner organization provides to this specific campaign. Examples include advocacy (policy influence), content (materials and messaging), funding (financial support), field implementation (on-ground activities), technical expertise (specialized knowledge), media amplification (press and social reach), or coalition building (network mobilization). A partner may have different contribution types across different campaigns.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this participation record was created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: participation_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the partner organization's active participation in this campaign ended or is planned to end. May differ from the campaign end date if the partner's involvement is time-limited. Null for ongoing participation. Used for tracking partner engagement duration and post-campaign evaluation.

attributes.name: participation_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the partner organization's active participation in this campaign began. May differ from the campaign start date if the partner joined mid-campaign. Used for tracking partner engagement duration and coordination timelines.

attributes.name: partner_role
attributes.description: The specific role the partner organization plays in this campaign. Distinguishes between lead partners (primary coordinators), supporting partners (secondary contributors), implementing partners (field execution), technical partners (subject matter expertise), financial partners (funding contributors), and media partners (amplification and outreach). This attribute exists only in the context of a specific partner-campaign relationship.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this participation record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: visibility_level
attributes.description: The level of public visibility and attribution the partner organization receives for their participation in this campaign. Public means prominently featured in campaign materials; acknowledged means listed as a partner but not prominently featured; confidential means partner involvement is tracked internally but not publicly disclosed; anonymous means partner requested no attribution. Visibility level varies by partner preference and campaign context.

products.name: consortium_communication
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of communication plans to consortia in multi-partner humanitarian coordination contexts. It captures the specific role each consortium plays in a communication plan, approval authority for consortium-branded materials, visibility requirements for donor and cluster reporting, branding guidelines for joint communications, and review status for coordinated multi-stakeholder messaging. Each record links one consortium to one communication plan with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, supporting Grand Bargain transparency commitments and IASC coordination protocols.. Existence Justification: In humanitarian multi-partner coordination, a single consortium can be referenced in multiple communication plans (donor-specific reports, OCHA SitReps, advocacy campaigns, emergency response briefings), and a single communication plan (especially strategic plans or crisis SitReps) can cover multiple consortia or joint programming arrangements. The business actively manages consortium-specific communication requirements including approval authority, branding protocols, visibility commitments, and review workflows for each consortium-plan combination.

attributes.name: consortium_communication_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the consortium_communication association

attributes.name: consortium_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the consortium record. Identifies which multi-partner consortium arrangement this communication plan assignment relates to.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the communication plan record. Identifies which communication plan or deliverable (strategic plan, SitRep, briefing note) is associated with this consortium.

attributes.name: reviewed_by_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member from this consortium who conducted the review and approval. Captures accountability for consortium governance compliance in joint communications.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The level of approval authority this consortium holds over the communication plan content. Required indicates consortium steering committee must approve before publication; advisory indicates consortium provides input but does not have veto power; none indicates no formal approval process for this consortium.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date when this consortium was formally assigned to or included in the communication plan scope. Used for tracking when consortium coordination requirements were established.

attributes.name: branding_guidelines
attributes.description: Specific branding and logo usage guidelines for this consortium in the communication plan. Captures consortium logo placement requirements, member organization logo protocols, lead agency branding hierarchy, pooled fund mechanism branding requirements, and any donor-mandated branding restrictions for joint communications.

attributes.name: consortium_role
attributes.description: The specific role this consortium plays in the communication plan execution. Lead_communicator indicates the consortium is the primary author/distributor; contributing_partner indicates input/review responsibilities; review_only indicates approval rights without authorship; information_recipient indicates the consortium receives but does not contribute to the communication.

attributes.name: review_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when this consortium completed its review and approval process for the communication plan. Used for tracking consortium governance cycle times and coordination efficiency.

attributes.name: review_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline by which this consortium must complete its review and approval process for the communication plan. Critical for time-sensitive humanitarian coordination reporting such as OCHA SitReps and cluster updates.

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing consortium feedback, revision requests, or approval conditions for the communication plan. Documents consortium steering committee input and ensures transparency in multi-partner coordination.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current status of this consortium's review and approval process for the communication plan. Tracks the workflow state of consortium steering committee review, ensuring governance protocols are followed for multi-partner communications.

attributes.name: visibility_requirements
attributes.description: Specific visibility and acknowledgment requirements for this consortium in the communication deliverables. Captures donor visibility clauses, OCHA cluster reporting requirements, IASC working group acknowledgment protocols, and Grand Bargain localization visibility commitments that must be reflected in the communication materials.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Authoritative domain for fund accounting, general ledger (GL), Chart of Accounts (CoA), Budget vs. Actual (BvA) tracking, accounts payable (AP), accounts receivable (AR), restricted fund tracking, NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement), grant financial management, and cost allocation. Ensures compliance with FASB ASC 958, GAAP for nonprofits, and OMB Uniform Guidance in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.

products.name: finance_fund
products.description: Master record for each restricted or unrestricted fund managed by the NGO. Captures fund name, fund code, restriction type (donor-restricted, board-designated, unrestricted), associated grant or donor source, fund purpose, opening balance, currency, fiscal year, fund status, and compliance flags per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 and FASB ASC 958. The SSOT for fund identity used across grant financial management, cost allocation, and BvA reporting in Unit4 ERP and SAP S/4HANA.
products.reference: FASB ASC 958 Fund Accounting / Unit4 Fund Master

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund record. Primary key for the finance_fund product.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Restricted funds must track applicable compliance obligations (donor reporting schedules, audit requirements, IATI publication). Fund managers need to know which obligations apply to each fund for com

attributes.name: constituent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the donor or funding source that provided the resources for this fund. Links to Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud constituent records.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: finance_nicra_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.nicra_rate. Business justification: Funds are governed by NICRA agreements that define allowable indirect cost rates. This FK enables joining to get the rate percentage and agreement details.

attributes.name: funding_source_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific funding source record that channels resources into this fund. May represent government agencies, foundations, or institutional donors.

attributes.name: parent_fund_finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent fund if this fund is a sub-fund or component of a larger fund structure. Enables hierarchical fund accounting and roll-up reporting.

attributes.name: allowable_cost_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of cost categories that are allowable charges to this fund per donor restrictions or OMB Uniform Guidance. Guides expense posting and audit compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.403 - Allowable Costs

attributes.name: audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund is subject to external audit requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance Single Audit provisions or donor-specific audit clauses.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart F - Audit Requirements

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount allocated to the fund for the current fiscal period. Used as the baseline for Budget versus Actual (BvA) variance analysis.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.430 - Budget Planning

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_segment
attributes.description: The fund dimension segment code in the organization's Chart of Accounts structure. Used for General Ledger posting and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: GAAP for Nonprofits - Chart of Accounts Design

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the fund was officially closed. Marks the completion of the fund lifecycle and triggers closeout procedures per OMB Uniform Guidance.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount committed through purchase orders, contracts, or other encumbrances but not yet expended. Used for fund availability calculations.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Budget Execution

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund is currently in compliance with all donor conditions, OMB Uniform Guidance requirements, and internal policies. False triggers compliance review workflows.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fund record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fund's primary currency. Essential for multi-currency fund management and foreign exchange reporting.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The current available balance in the fund after all posted transactions. Updated in real-time by the ERP system for fund availability checking.

attributes.name: donor_reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which financial reports must be submitted to the donor or funding source. Drives reporting calendar and compliance workflows.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the fund expires or is scheduled to close. Critical for grant closeout planning and restricted fund compliance.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the fund becomes active and available for transactions. Aligns with grant award start dates or board approval dates.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.309 - Period of Performance

attributes.name: expended_amount
attributes.description: Total amount expended from the fund during the current fiscal period. Tracks actual spending against budget for BvA reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (YYYYMM format) for fund activity tracking. Supports monthly and quarterly financial reporting cycles.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this fund record applies. Enables year-over-year fund performance analysis and multi-year grant tracking.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the fund for identification in financial systems and reporting. Used as the business identifier across SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the fund as it appears in financial statements and donor reports.

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the fund in the financial system. Determines whether transactions can be posted to the fund.

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fund based on restriction type and purpose. Determines how funds can be used and reported per FASB ASC 958 net asset classification requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958-210 - Statement of Financial Position

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.description: The Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement (NICRA) percentage applicable to this fund. Used for Facilities and Administration (F&A) cost allocation per OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.414 - Indirect Costs

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent external audit that included this fund. Used for audit cycle tracking and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: last_report_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent financial report was submitted to the donor for this fund. Tracks reporting compliance and timeliness.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the staff member or department responsible for managing and overseeing the fund. Accountable for fund stewardship and compliance.

attributes.name: match_fulfilled_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of matching funds or in-kind contributions fulfilled to date. Tracked for grant reporting and compliance verification.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.306 - Cost Sharing

attributes.name: match_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of matching funds or cost share required by the donor or grant agreement. Critical for tracking cost share commitments and compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.306 - Cost Sharing

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fund record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next external audit covering this fund. Supports audit planning and documentation preparation.

attributes.name: next_report_due_date
attributes.description: The due date for the next scheduled financial report to the donor. Critical for compliance and relationship management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or contextual information about the fund. Used by fund managers for operational guidance.

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The fund balance at the beginning of the current fiscal year or at fund inception. Represents the starting financial position for Budget versus Actual (BvA) tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958-210 - Statement of Financial Position

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: The program or project code linked to the fund. Enables program-level financial reporting and Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL) integration.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Detailed description of the intended use and purpose of the fund, including any donor-specified restrictions or programmatic objectives.

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Specific nature of restrictions placed on the fund by donors or the board. Governs allowable expenditures and compliance requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.403 - Factors Affecting Allowability

attributes.name: unallowable_cost_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of cost categories that are explicitly unallowable for this fund. Prevents non-compliant expense posting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.420-475 - Unallowable Costs

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master record for organizational cost centers used to allocate expenses across programs, departments, country offices, and projects. Captures cost center code, name, type (program, administrative, fundraising), responsible manager, parent cost center (for hierarchy), organizational hierarchy level, associated country or region, active status, and functional expense classification per GAAP. The SSOT for organizational cost structure used in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP for cost allocation, indirect cost recovery, NICRA base calculations, and Budget vs. Actual reporting.
products.reference: SAP Cost Center Master / OMB 2 CFR 200 Cost Allocation

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key for the cost center master record.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Cost centers (programs/field offices) have specific compliance obligations (CHS commitments, sphere standards, donor-specific requirements). Program managers track obligations by cost center for opera

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cost center in the organizational hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting from field offices to regional hubs to headquarters. Nullable for top-level cost centers.

attributes.name: primary_cost_user_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this cost center record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.333 Record Retention

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who is accountable for budget performance, expense approval, and financial stewardship of this cost center. Used in RACI (Responsible Accountable Consulted Informed) matrices and budget versus actual (BvA) reporting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Financial Management

attributes.name: system_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.system_platform. Business justification: Cost centers track IT platform-specific expenses (ERP licenses, grants management subscriptions) for budget allocation and indirect cost recovery. Required for platform cost reports in NICRA calculati

attributes.name: tertiary_cost_approved_by_user_user_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this cost center for activation. Typically a finance director, controller, or Chief Financial Officer (CFO). Nullable for cost centers not yet approved.

attributes.name: activity_type
