products.reference: SAP Exchange Rate / UN Operational Rate of Exchange

attributes.name: exchange_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the exchange rate record. Primary key for the exchange rate reference master.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific grant or award that requires or is associated with this exchange rate. Nullable for general organizational rates. Links donor-mandated rates to specific funding agreements.

attributes.name: created_by_staff_member_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Created By Staff Member Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.staff_member. Business justification: Finance tracks which staff member created each exchange rate for accountability in foreign exchange rate management and multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Exchange rates are effective for fiscal periods and used for multi-currency financial reporting and revaluation. The existing fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (STRING) columns are denormalized repr

attributes.name: superseded_by_rate_exchange_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the exchange rate record that replaces this rate. Nullable for current active rates. Creates a chain of rate succession for historical tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this exchange rate requires formal approval before being activated for use in financial transactions. True indicates approval workflow is required; false indicates rate can be used immediately upon publication.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this exchange rate was formally approved for use. Nullable for rates that do not require approval. Establishes the point at which the rate became authorized for financial transactions.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the authorized user who approved this exchange rate for use in financial transactions. Nullable for rates that do not require approval. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this exchange rate record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: donor_required_rate_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this exchange rate is mandated by a specific donor or grant agreement. True indicates the rate must be used for specific donor reporting; false indicates it is a general organizational rate. Critical for grant compliance.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this exchange rate becomes valid and should be used for currency conversions. Represents the start of the rate's applicability period.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_value
attributes.description: The numeric exchange rate value representing how many units of the target currency equal one unit of the source currency. For example, if USD to EUR rate is 0.85, then 1 USD equals 0.85 EUR. Stored with six decimal places for precision.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this exchange rate ceases to be valid. Nullable for rates that remain effective until superseded. Represents the end of the rate's applicability period.

attributes.name: from_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the source currency in the exchange rate pair (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). The currency being converted from.

attributes.name: inverse_rate_value
attributes.description: The inverse of the exchange rate value, representing how many units of the source currency equal one unit of the target currency. Calculated as 1 divided by exchange_rate_value. Facilitates bidirectional currency conversions.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who most recently modified this exchange rate record. Tracks responsibility for the latest changes and supports audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this exchange rate record was most recently updated. Tracks the latest change to any field in the record for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: mid_market_rate_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this rate represents the mid-market rate (the midpoint between buy and sell rates). True indicates a neutral market rate without spread markup; false indicates a rate that may include transaction costs or spreads.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or explanatory remarks about this exchange rate. May include information about unusual market conditions, donor-specific requirements, or deviations from standard rate sources.

attributes.name: rate_calculation_method
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used to calculate or derive the exchange rate. For average rates, describes the averaging period and calculation approach. For budget rates, describes the forecasting methodology. Ensures transparency in rate determination.

attributes.name: rate_publication_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the exchange rate was officially published or released by the rate source. Provides precise temporal reference for rate validity and audit purposes.

attributes.name: rate_source
attributes.description: The authoritative source or provider of the exchange rate data. Examples include central banks (Federal Reserve, European Central Bank), commercial providers (OANDA, Bloomberg, Reuters), UN Operational Rates of Exchange, or internal treasury systems. Ensures traceability and auditability of rate origins.

attributes.name: rate_source_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier or URL from the rate source system that can be used to verify or trace back to the original rate publication. Supports audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the exchange rate record. Active rates are currently in use, inactive rates are no longer valid, superseded rates have been replaced by newer rates, pending rates are awaiting approval, and draft rates are under preparation.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exchange rate indicating its purpose and calculation method. Spot rates are real-time market rates, average rates are period averages, budget rates are planning rates, closing rates are end-of-period rates, forward rates are future-dated contracts, and historical rates are past reference rates.

attributes.name: revaluation_rate_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this rate is designated for use in general ledger foreign currency revaluation processes. True indicates the rate should be used for balance sheet revaluation; false indicates it is for transactional purposes only.

attributes.name: spread_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage spread or markup applied to the base exchange rate to account for transaction costs, bank fees, or foreign exchange margins. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0150 for 1.5%). Nullable for rates without spreads.

attributes.name: to_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the target currency in the exchange rate pair (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). The currency being converted to.

attributes.name: un_operational_rate_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this rate is sourced from the United Nations Operational Rates of Exchange, commonly used by international NGOs and humanitarian organizations for standardized multi-currency reporting.

attributes.name: usage_context
attributes.description: Description of the specific business contexts or transaction types for which this exchange rate should be used. Examples include donor reporting, budget planning, accounts payable processing, grant financial statements, or general ledger revaluation. Provides guidance for appropriate rate application.

attributes.name: variance_from_prior_rate
attributes.description: The absolute difference between this exchange rate value and the immediately preceding rate for the same currency pair and rate type. Facilitates trend analysis and identification of significant rate movements.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage change between this exchange rate and the immediately preceding rate for the same currency pair and rate type. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.5% increase). Supports volatility monitoring and financial risk assessment.

products.name: fund_compliance_tracking
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between finance_fund and donor_requirement. It captures the applicability and compliance status of specific donor requirements to individual funds. Each record links one fund to one donor requirement with attributes that track when the requirement applies, compliance verification, and waiver status. Essential for grant financial management, audit preparation, and donor reporting per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.. Existence Justification: In NGO grant financial management, a single fund can be subject to multiple donor compliance requirements (financial reporting, audit, procurement rules, anti-terrorism certification), and a single donor requirement (e.g., quarterly financial reporting per OMB Uniform Guidance) can apply to multiple funds managed by the organization. Organizations actively manage compliance status, verification dates, and waiver requests at the fund-requirement level because compliance obligations vary by fund based on donor source, grant terms, and restriction type.

attributes.name: fund_compliance_tracking_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this fund-requirement compliance tracking record. Primary key.

attributes.name: assigned_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member assigned responsibility for ensuring this fund's compliance with this specific requirement. May differ from the general requirement owner.

attributes.name: donor_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to donor_requirement. Identifies which donor requirement applies to this fund.

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to finance_fund. Identifies which fund this compliance tracking applies to.

attributes.name: fund_finance_fund_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fund Compliance Tracking - Finance Fund Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the fund being tracked for compliance

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of this fund's compliance with this specific requirement. Tracks progress from initiation through approval or waiver. Distinct from the donor_requirement.compliance_status which may aggregate across multiple funds.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund-requirement compliance tracking record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance tracking record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which compliance with this requirement was verified for this fund. Used for audit trail and to determine when next verification is due.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes specific to this fund's compliance with this requirement, including fund-specific challenges, accommodations, or context.

attributes.name: requirement_applicability_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this donor requirement ceases to apply to this specific fund. May differ from fund effective_end_date if requirement is waived or modified.

attributes.name: requirement_applicability_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this donor requirement becomes applicable to this specific fund. May differ from the fund effective_start_date if requirement is added mid-grant.

attributes.name: waiver_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the donor made a decision (granted or denied) on the waiver request for this fund-requirement combination.

attributes.name: waiver_request_date
attributes.description: Date on which a waiver was formally requested for this fund-requirement combination.

attributes.name: waiver_status
attributes.description: Status of any waiver request for this requirement as it applies to this specific fund. A requirement may be waived for one fund but not others.

products.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: closed_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: days_in_period

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description or notes about the fiscal period, including any special considerations, adjustments, or organizational context.

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: exchange_rate_date

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: is_active

attributes.name: is_adjustment_period

attributes.name: is_year_end_period

attributes.name: locked_date
attributes.description: The date when the fiscal period was permanently locked, preventing any further modifications. Nullable if not yet locked.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fiscal period record was last modified. Updated whenever period status or attributes change.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: The date when the fiscal period was officially opened for transaction posting. May differ from start_date due to administrative processes.

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the fiscal period (e.g., FY24-Q1, P01-2024). Used as a business identifier for reporting and reference.

attributes.name: period_name

attributes.name: period_number

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fiscal period. Open allows transactions; closed prevents new entries but allows adjustments; locked is final and immutable; future indicates not yet active.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fiscal period by duration and frequency (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, or custom).

attributes.name: quarter_number

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for financial reporting in this period (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency nonprofit operations.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the fiscal period. Defines when the period becomes effective for financial transactions and reporting.

attributes.name: working_days_in_period

attributes.name: prior_fiscal_period_id

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: SSOT for all staff and human resources data including employee records, payroll, benefits, talent acquisition, performance management, learning and development, and talent retention in Workday HCM. Covers national and international staff, expatriate management, field personnel, HRIS data, and RACI role assignments across programs.

products.name: staff_member
products.description: Core master record for all paid staff at Ngo, including national staff, international staff, expatriates, and field personnel. Captures full employee identity (name, date of birth, nationality, gender), employment classification, contract type, duty station, cost center assignment, emergency contact/next-of-kin details, and HRIS identifiers sourced from Workday HCM. Includes separation lifecycle attributes: separation type (resignation, end of contract, redundancy, termination, retirement, death in service), effective date, exit interview completion, final settlement amount, rehire eligibility, and separation reason narrative. Serves as the SSOT for workforce identity across all HR sub-domains, the anchor entity for all workforce transactions, and the single record of employment lifecycle from hire to separation.

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each staff member record in the Ngo workforce system. Primary key for the staff_member data product, serving as the anchor entity for all workforce transactions across HR sub-domains.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Object; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: supervisor_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff_member_id of this staff member's direct line manager. Enables organizational hierarchy traversal, RACI reporting, performance management workflows, and approval chain configuration in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Manager Hierarchy; RACI Framework; CHS Alliance Accountability Standards

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: The gross annual base salary of the staff member in the contract currency, as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for payroll processing, Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting, and grant cost allocation under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Compensation Allowability; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled expiry date of the staff member's current employment contract. Null for permanent/open-ended contracts. Used for contract renewal alerts, workforce planning, and grant-funded position management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract End Date; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Grant Period Alignment

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the staff member's current employment contract. May differ from hire_date for staff on renewed or amended contracts. Used for contract lifecycle management and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract Start Date; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The legal nature of the employment arrangement. Determines statutory entitlements, benefits eligibility, payroll treatment, and compliance obligations under local labor law. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: permanent|fixed_term|consultancy|secondment|internship|volunteer_staff — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract Type; IRS 501(c)(3) Employment Classification; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The financial cost center code from the Chart of Accounts (CoA) to which the staff member's salary and benefits are charged. Enables Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting and grant fund accounting per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 cost allocation requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts (CoA); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958 Fund Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the staff member record was first created in the Ngo data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data governance and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); FASB ASC 958 Audit Trail; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: The staff member's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for age verification, retirement planning, benefits eligibility, and visa/travel documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; IRS 401(k) Eligibility Rules; Workday HCM Personal Information

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The organizational department or division to which the staff member is assigned (e.g., Programs, Finance, MEAL, Logistics, HR, Communications). Used for organizational reporting, budget allocation, and RACI assignments.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization; SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Hierarchy; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: duty_station
attributes.description: The official location where the staff member is assigned to work, typically expressed as a city and country (e.g., Nairobi, KEN; Kabul, AFG). Used for hardship allowance calculation, security risk management, and field operations coordination per OCHA duty station classifications.
attributes.references: OCHA Duty Station Classification; UN Common System Hardship Allowances; Workday HCM Location

attributes.name: duty_station_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the staff member's duty station country. Used for geographic workforce analytics, country-level headcount reporting, and compliance with host-country labor laws.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Country Office Reporting; IATI Geographic Coding

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: The full name of the staff member's designated next-of-kin or emergency contact person. Used for critical incident notification, medical emergencies, and death-in-service protocols in field operations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; OCHA Critical Incident Management; CHS Alliance Staff Safety Standards

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: The telephone number of the staff member's designated emergency contact in E.164 international format. Used for critical incident notification and next-of-kin communication in field operations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; OCHA Critical Incident Management; CHS Alliance Staff Safety Standards

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the emergency contact to the staff member (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling). Used to contextualize next-of-kin notifications and legal next-of-kin determinations in death-in-service cases.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Emergency Contact; CHS Alliance Staff Safety; OCHA Critical Incident Protocols

attributes.name: employee_number
attributes.description: The human-readable, organization-assigned employee identification number used in payroll, HR correspondence, and access control systems. Distinct from the surrogate staff_member_id.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employee ID Field; IRS 501(c)(3) Payroll Compliance

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the staff member's employment at Ngo. Drives access control, payroll processing, and workforce headcount reporting. 'active' = currently employed and working; 'on_leave' = approved absence; 'suspended' = temporarily not working pending investigation; 'separated' = employment ended; 'probation' = within initial probationary period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employment Status; FASB ASC 958 Workforce Disclosures; CHS Alliance HR Standards

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member by geographic and operational deployment category. National staff are locally hired; international staff are deployed from another country; expatriates are on international assignment; field personnel are based in program delivery locations. Drives compensation bands, benefits packages, and NICRA cost allocation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS Chapter 302

attributes.name: exit_interview_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member completed an exit interview prior to or at separation. Used to track organizational learning compliance and ensure knowledge transfer processes are followed per CHS Core Humanitarian Standard accountability requirements.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; Workday HCM Offboarding Checklist; HAP Accountability Standards

attributes.name: final_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount paid to the staff member as final settlement upon separation, including any outstanding salary, accrued leave payout, severance, and gratuity as applicable under local labor law and contract terms.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Final Pay; Local Labor Law Severance Requirements; FASB ASC 958 Compensation Disclosures

attributes.name: fte_percentage
attributes.description: The proportion of full-time hours this staff member is contracted to work, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 100.00 for full-time, 50.00 for half-time). Used for headcount reporting, grant effort allocation, and Indirect Cost Rate (ICR/NICRA) calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM FTE; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Effort Reporting; NICRA Compliance

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The staff member's self-identified gender. Used for workforce diversity reporting, gender-disaggregated MEL indicators, and compliance with donor reporting requirements (e.g., USAID, DFID gender equity mandates).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); USAID Gender Equality Policy; IATI Gender Marker; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the staff member commenced employment with Ngo, as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for service length calculations, benefits vesting schedules, probation period tracking, and anniversary-based entitlements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Hire Date; IRS W-2 Reporting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: job_grade
attributes.description: The salary band or grade level assigned to the staff member's position within Ngo's compensation framework (e.g., G1–G7 for national staff, P1–P5 for international staff following UN-equivalent scales). Drives compensation benchmarking and benefits eligibility.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; UN Common System Salary Scales; USAID Compensation Compliance

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title of the staff member as defined in the organizational job catalogue and reflected in their employment contract. Used for organizational charts, donor reporting, and RACI role assignments across programs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; IATI Staff Disclosure; CHS Alliance Competency Framework

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to the staff member record in the Ngo data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); FASB ASC 958 Audit Trail; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: The staff member's legal given name as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. Used for payroll, visa, and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IRS W-2 Reporting; IATI Staff Disclosure Standards

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: The staff member's legal family/surname as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. Used for payroll, visa, and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IRS W-2 Reporting; IATI Staff Disclosure Standards

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: The staff member's nationality represented as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, GBR, KEN). Used for expatriate management, work permit tracking, and national vs. international staff classification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Humanitarian Staff Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: passport_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiry date of the staff member's passport. Used to trigger renewal alerts and ensure compliance with international travel and visa requirements for field deployments.
attributes.references: ICAO Travel Document Standards; OCHA Field Deployment Protocols; Workday HCM Document Tracking

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: The staff member's passport number, required for international travel, visa applications, and expatriate deployment documentation. Stored securely in compliance with data protection regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; ICAO Travel Document Standards; OCHA Humanitarian Travel Protocols

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the staff member is paid (e.g., monthly, bi-weekly). Drives payroll cycle scheduling in Workday HCM and cash flow planning for field operations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Pay Group; IRS Payroll Compliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the staff member prefers to be addressed by in day-to-day operations, which may differ from their legal name. Used in internal communications, email display names, and staff directories.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Preferred Name Field; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard — Staff Dignity

attributes.name: probation_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member's probationary period is scheduled to end. Used to trigger performance review workflows and confirm or terminate employment within the probation window.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Probation Period; Local Labor Law Compliance; CHS Alliance HR Standards

attributes.name: rehire_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member is eligible for rehire at Ngo following separation. Set to false for staff separated due to gross misconduct, fraud, or serious policy violations. Used during talent acquisition screening.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Rehire Eligibility; CHS Alliance HR Standards; Ngo HR Policy

attributes.name: salary_currency
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the staff member's base salary is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, KES). Required for multi-currency payroll consolidation and grant financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: separation_date
attributes.description: The effective date on which the staff member's employment with Ngo ended. Used for final payroll processing, benefits termination, access revocation, and workforce attrition reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Date; IRS W-2 Final Reporting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: separation_reason
attributes.description: A free-text narrative describing the specific reason for the staff member's separation from Ngo. Complements the separation_type categorical field with contextual detail for HR records, exit documentation, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Reason; CHS Alliance HR Standards; Local Labor Law Documentation

attributes.name: separation_type
attributes.description: The category of employment separation event for staff members whose employment has ended. Drives final settlement calculations, rehire eligibility determination, and statutory reporting. Values: resignation (voluntary), end_of_contract (fixed-term expiry), redundancy (position eliminated), termination (involuntary dismissal), retirement (age/service-based), death_in_service.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Type; IRS 501(c)(3) HR Compliance; Local Labor Law; CHS Alliance HR Standards

attributes.name: work_email
attributes.description: The official organizational email address assigned to the staff member. Primary digital contact channel for HR communications, system access provisioning, and donor/partner correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Workday HCM Contact Information; CHS Alliance Staff Communication Standards

attributes.name: work_permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiry date of the staff member's work permit or visa authorization. Used to trigger renewal workflows and ensure continuous legal authorization to work in the duty station country.
attributes.references: Host Country Labor Law; OCHA Humanitarian Staff Compliance; Workday HCM Document Tracking

attributes.name: work_permit_number
attributes.description: The work permit or visa authorization number for staff members who require legal authorization to work in their duty station country. Null for staff working in their country of nationality.
attributes.references: Host Country Labor Law; OCHA Humanitarian Staff Compliance; Workday HCM Document Tracking

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: The staff member's official work telephone number in E.164 international format. Used for operational communications, field coordination, and emergency contact protocols.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; GDPR Article 4; OCHA Field Communications Standards

attributes.name: workday_worker_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workday Human Resource Information System (HRIS) Worker ID
attributes.description: The unique worker identifier assigned by Workday HCM, used to cross-reference this record with the source system of record for all HR transactions, payroll, and benefits data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Object; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

products.name: position
products.description: Authorized organizational position (headcount slot) within Ngos structure, distinct from the person filling it. Tracks position title, grade level, FTE allocation, funding source (grant or core), duty station, department, and whether the position is filled or vacant. Includes embedded job profile catalog: job family, job level, job function, competency requirements, minimum qualifications, pay grade band, and career progression path aligned with Workday HCM job catalog. Supports workforce planning, grant-funded headcount tracking, recruitment requisition creation, RACI role assignments, and organizational design.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for an authorized organizational position (headcount slot) within Ngo's structure. This is the primary key for the position entity in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Positions have mandatory compliance obligations (safeguarding-designated roles require specific certifications, field positions require security clearances). Enables role-based compliance tracking and

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the program or project to which this position is assigned. Enables grant-funded headcount tracking per program and supports RACI role assignments across programs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Program Management; IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: Positions represent authorized headcount slots that should be defined by standardized job profiles. Currently position has job_family, job_function, and job_level as standalone attributes, but these s

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department or cost center to which this position belongs. Used in organizational design, Chart of Accounts (CoA) mapping, and headcount reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Management; SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting

attributes.name: reports_to_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent position in the organizational hierarchy to which this position reports. Enables organizational chart construction, span-of-control analysis, and RACI role assignment across programs.

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the current worker (employee or contractor) filling this position. Null when the position is vacant. Links the position slot to the person record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: availability_date
attributes.description: Date from which the position is authorized and available for filling, either through recruitment or internal transfer. Marks the effective start of the headcount slot in the organizational plan.

attributes.name: budgeted_annual_cost
attributes.description: Total budgeted annual cost of the position including salary, benefits, and applicable indirect cost rate (ICR/NICRA), in the salary currency. Used in grant budget justifications, Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting, and workforce cost planning.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA; Unit4 ERP Project Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this position record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: duty_station
attributes.description: Geographic location where the position is based, typically expressed as city and country (e.g., 'Nairobi, KEN'). Critical for expatriate management, hardship allowance determination, and field operations staffing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Location Management; OCHA Field Operations Standards

attributes.name: duty_station_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the position is based. Used for expatriate management, tax compliance, and geographic workforce analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Workday HCM Location Management

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the position authorization expires or is eliminated. Nullable for permanent positions. For grant-funded positions, typically aligned with the grant period of performance end date.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: filled_date
attributes.description: Date on which the position was most recently filled by an incumbent. Used to calculate time-to-fill metrics and vacancy duration reporting.

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Authorized Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) percentage allocated to this position, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.00 = full-time, 0.50 = half-time). Used in workforce planning, grant budget justifications, and headcount reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Headcount Planning; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430

attributes.name: funding_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary funding source for this position. 'Grant' indicates the position is funded by a specific donor award; 'core' indicates unrestricted organizational funding; 'split' indicates funding from multiple sources; 'in-kind' indicates a contributed position; 'cost-share' indicates a position partially funded as match on a grant.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management

attributes.name: headcount_plan_year
attributes.description: Fiscal or calendar year for which this position is authorized in the organizational headcount plan. Used in annual workforce planning cycles and grant budget period alignment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Headcount Planning; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: icr_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement (NICRA) / Indirect Cost Rate (ICR) applies to this position's costs when charged to federal grants. Drives Facilities and Administration (F&A) cost calculations in grant financial management.

attributes.name: is_field_position
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position is classified as a field operations position (True) versus a headquarters or support office position (False). Drives hardship allowance eligibility, security protocols, and field operations staffing analytics.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Operations Standards; Sphere Association

attributes.name: is_supervisory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position carries supervisory or managerial responsibility over other positions (True = supervisory). Used in organizational design, RACI role assignments, and span-of-control analytics.

attributes.name: is_vacant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position currently has no active incumbent (True = vacant, False = filled). Drives recruitment requisition creation and vacancy reporting to donors and boards.

attributes.name: job_description_url
attributes.description: URL or document management system reference to the official job description document for this position. Provides access to the full scope of work, responsibilities, and qualifications for recruitment and performance management purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this position record was most recently updated, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: max_salary
attributes.description: Maximum base salary authorized for this position's pay grade band, in the local or organizational currency. Used in budget ceiling planning and compensation equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430

attributes.name: min_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum academic qualification required for this position as defined in the job profile. Used in recruitment requisition creation and candidate screening. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|secondary|diploma|bachelor|master|doctorate|professional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CHS Alliance HR Standards

attributes.name: min_salary
attributes.description: Minimum base salary authorized for this position's pay grade band, in the local or organizational currency. Used in budget planning, grant budget justifications, and compensation equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430

attributes.name: min_years_experience
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for this position as defined in the job profile. Used in recruitment requisition creation and candidate screening.

attributes.name: pay_grade_band

attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Management; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the position within the organization's headcount plan and Workday HCM job catalog. Used in grant proposals, budget submissions, and organizational charts.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the position headcount slot. 'Open' indicates a vacancy available for recruitment; 'filled' indicates an active incumbent; 'frozen' indicates a position on hold due to budget constraints; 'eliminated' indicates the position has been removed from the headcount plan; 'proposed' indicates pending organizational approval.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Classification of the position by employment arrangement. 'Permanent' indicates an indefinite contract; 'fixed-term' indicates a time-bound contract; 'temporary' indicates a short-term assignment; 'secondment' indicates a position filled by staff from a partner organization; 'volunteer' indicates an unpaid position.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; CHS Alliance HR Standards

attributes.name: raci_role
attributes.description: Primary Responsible Accountable Consulted Informed (RACI) role designation for this position within program delivery processes. Supports organizational design and program accountability frameworks.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; RACI Framework; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: required_competencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of core competencies required for this position as defined in the Workday HCM competency framework (e.g., 'Results Orientation, Teamwork, Communication, WASH Technical Skills'). Used in performance management and talent acquisition.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency Framework; CHS Alliance HR Standards

attributes.name: required_languages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of language proficiency requirements for this position (e.g., 'English (fluent), French (working), Swahili (basic)'). Critical for field operations positions in multilingual humanitarian contexts.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; OCHA Field Operations Standards

attributes.name: salary_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the salary values associated with this position (e.g., 'USD', 'KES', 'EUR'). Required for multi-currency workforce cost reporting and grant budget submissions.

attributes.name: security_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires a formal security clearance or background check (True = required). Relevant for positions handling restricted donor data, financial systems, or operating in high-risk field environments.

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the position by staff type. Drives compensation frameworks, benefits eligibility, and visa/work permit requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; OCHA HR Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official job title of the position as defined in the organizational structure and Workday HCM job catalog. Used in recruitment requisitions, offer letters, and donor/grant reporting.

attributes.description: Native position identifier from the Workday HCM source system. Used for data lineage, system reconciliation, and integration with Workday HCM APIs.

Tracks contract renewals and amendments over time. For internationally-recruited staff, includes full expatriate compensation package: hardship allowance tier and amount, housing allowance, education allowance for dependents, home leave entitlement and frequency, relocation allowance, medical evacuation coverage level, R&R cycle, and applicable INGO salary scale (e.g., UN common system, organizational scale). Supports multi-currency compensation across 50+ country operations. Sourced from Workday HCM.

attributes.name: employment_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each employment contract record in Workday HCM. Serves as the primary key for the employment_contract data product in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (worker) to whom this employment contract applies. Links to the worker/employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: amendment_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the most recent contract amendment takes effect. Null for original contracts with no amendments. Used in conjunction with amendment_number to track the timeline of contract changes.

attributes.description: Sequential integer tracking the number of amendments made to the original employment contract. Zero indicates the original contract; each amendment increments this counter. attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for the most recent contract amendment. Used for HR analytics, audit trails, and workforce planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: renewal|salary_revision|duty_station_change|promotion|contract_type_change|scope_change|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract Amendment Reason; ILO Convention C158

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the employment contract. Draft indicates pending approval; active indicates a currently binding agreement; on_hold covers suspension; terminated covers early cessation; expired covers contracts that reached their end date without renewal; amended covers contracts under revision.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract Status; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance HR Principles

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement defining the legal nature of the engagement. Fixed-term contracts have defined end dates; open-ended are indefinite; consultancy covers independent contractors; secondment covers staff loaned from/to partner organizations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fixed_term|open_ended|consultancy|secondment|internship|volunteer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract Type; ILO Employment Relationship Recommendation No. 198; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this employment contract record was first created in the system. Corresponds to the MASTER_AGREEMENT RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: duty_station
attributes.description: The official location (city and country) where the staff member is assigned to perform their duties under this contract. Determines applicable hardship classification, housing allowance, cost-of-living adjustments, and applicable labor law jurisdiction. Standard OCHA/UN terminology for field deployment location.
attributes.references: OCHA Duty Station Classification; UN Common System; Workday HCM Location

attributes.name: duty_station_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country of the duty station (e.g., ETH for Ethiopia, SSD for South Sudan, COD for Democratic Republic of Congo). Used for geographic reporting, compliance, and multi-country workforce analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Country Codes; IATI Standard

attributes.name: education_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The annual monetary amount of education allowance provided for dependent children of expatriate staff members. Covers school fees and related educational expenses at the duty station or in the home country. Expressed in the contract currency. Null for non-expatriate staff or staff without eligible dependents.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Education Allowance; UN Common System Education Grant; INGO Expatriate Policies

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employment contract expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null for open-ended contracts. Corresponds to the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category. Used for contract renewal tracking and workforce planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract End Date; ILO Convention C158

attributes.name: funding_source_code
attributes.description: The grant, project, or cost center code against which the staff member's salary and benefits are charged. Enables grant cost allocation, BvA (Budget versus Actual) reporting, and compliance with donor restrictions. Aligns with the Chart of Accounts (CoA) in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430; FASB ASC 958; Unit4 ERP Project Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting

attributes.name: hardship_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The monthly monetary amount of hardship allowance payable to the expatriate staff member based on their hardship tier and salary grade. Expressed in the contract currency. Null for non-expatriate staff or H-classified duty stations.
attributes.references: UN ICSC Hardship Allowance Tables; Workday HCM Allowance Plan; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430

attributes.name: hardship_tier
attributes.description: The UN/ICSC hardship classification tier assigned to the duty station, determining the hardship allowance percentage applicable to the staff member's salary. H = headquarters (no hardship); A through E represent increasing levels of hardship, with E being the most difficult duty stations (e.g., active conflict zones). Null for non-expatriate staff.
attributes.references: UN ICSC Hardship Classification; UN Common System Conditions of Service; OCHA Duty Station Classification

attributes.name: home_leave_frequency_months
attributes.description: The number of months between home leave entitlements for expatriate staff, defining how frequently the staff member is entitled to travel to their home country at organizational expense. Typically 12 or 24 months depending on duty station hardship classification. Null for non-expatriate staff.
attributes.references: UN Common System Home Leave Entitlement; Workday HCM Leave Plan; INGO Expatriate Policies

attributes.name: housing_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The monthly monetary amount of housing allowance provided to the expatriate staff member at the duty station. Reflects local rental market rates and organizational housing policy. Expressed in the contract currency. Null for non-expatriate staff or staff in NGO-provided accommodation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Housing Allowance; UN Common System Post Adjustment; INGO Compensation Policies

attributes.name: icr_rate
attributes.description: The Indirect Cost Rate (ICR) or Facilities and Administration (F&A) rate applicable to this staff member's contract for grant cost recovery purposes. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Derived from the organization's NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement) with the US government or equivalent donor agreement.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.414; NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement); USAID Cost Principles

attributes.name: ingo_salary_scale
attributes.description: The salary scale framework applied to this contract, particularly relevant for internationally-recruited staff. UN common system applies UN salary tables; organizational_scale uses the NGO's internal scale; national_scale applies host-country national staff scales. Determines applicable grade tables and allowance structures.
attributes.references: UN International Civil Service Commission (ICSC); INGO HR Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: is_expatriate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member under this contract is classified as an expatriate (internationally-recruited staff deployed outside their home country). Triggers eligibility for expatriate compensation package components including hardship allowance, housing allowance, education allowance, home leave, and R&R.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Expatriate Management; UN Common System; INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: labor_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction whose labor laws and employment regulations govern this contract (e.g., 'Kenya', 'Ethiopia', 'United Kingdom', 'United States'). Determines statutory entitlements, termination procedures, and compliance obligations. Critical for multi-country NGO operations.
attributes.references: ILO Convention C158; Local Labor Law Jurisdictions; Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) (US)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this employment contract record was most recently updated in the system. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: medevac_coverage_level
attributes.description: The tier of medical evacuation coverage provided under this contract, determining the scope of emergency medical transport and treatment entitlements. Full coverage includes international evacuation to a tertiary care facility; basic covers regional evacuation only. Critical for field staff safety and duty of care compliance.
attributes.references: IASC Duty of Care Framework; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; Workday HCM Benefits Plan; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for HR staff to record additional context, special conditions, or exceptions applicable to this employment contract that are not captured in structured fields (e.g., special security arrangements, unique compensation agreements, donor-specific staffing conditions).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract Notes; CHS Alliance HR Documentation Standards

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days of advance notice required by either party to terminate the employment contract. Varies by contract type, seniority, and applicable labor law jurisdiction. Used in workforce planning and HR compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Notice Period; ILO Convention C158; Local Labor Law Jurisdictions

attributes.name: probation_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member's probationary period concludes. During probation, different notice periods and performance review requirements typically apply. Null if no probation period is applicable (e.g., for short-term consultancies).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Probation Period; Local Labor Law Jurisdictions

attributes.name: relocation_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The one-time monetary amount provided to cover relocation costs when the staff member moves to the duty station at the start of the contract. Expressed in the contract currency. Null for locally-recruited national staff or contract renewals without relocation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Relocation Allowance; UN Common System Assignment Grant; INGO Mobility Policies

attributes.name: rnr_cycle_weeks
attributes.description: The number of weeks between Rest and Recuperation (R&R) breaks for staff deployed to high-hardship or non-family duty stations. R&R is a mandatory welfare entitlement for staff in difficult operating environments (e.g., every 6, 8, or 12 weeks). Null for staff at H or A hardship-classified duty stations.
attributes.references: OCHA R&R Policy; UN Common System R&R Entitlements; IASC HR Policies; Workday HCM Leave Plan

attributes.name: salary_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the base salary and allowances are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, KES, ETB). Supports multi-currency compensation management across 50+ country operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Workday HCM Currency; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: salary_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the base salary is paid to the staff member. Determines payroll cycle alignment and annualization calculations for budget planning and grant reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Pay Frequency; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: salary_grade
attributes.description: The compensation band or grade level assigned to the position under this contract, as defined in the NGO's salary scale (e.g., UN common system grade G5, P3, or organizational scale Band C). Determines the salary range and step progression applicable to the staff member.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; UN Common System Salary Scales; NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement)

attributes.name: salary_step
attributes.description: The incremental step within the salary grade assigned to the staff member, reflecting years of experience or merit progression within the grade band (e.g., Step 1, Step 2, Step III). Used in conjunction with salary_grade to determine exact base pay.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Step; UN Common System Salary Scales

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member's recruitment category under this contract. International staff are recruited internationally and typically receive expatriate packages; national staff are locally recruited; third-country nationals are neither from the HQ country nor the duty station country. Determines applicable compensation package and entitlements.
attributes.references: UN Common System Staff Categories; INGO HR Standards; Workday HCM Worker Type

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employment contract becomes effective and the staff member's obligations and entitlements commence. Corresponds to the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract Start Date; ILO Convention C158

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the employment contract was terminated, if applicable. Distinct from end_date (scheduled expiry); this captures early terminations, resignations, and dismissals. Null for active contracts.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Date; ILO Convention C158; Local Labor Law Jurisdictions

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for contract termination, used in workforce analytics, exit reporting, and compliance with labor law notification requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resignation|end_of_contract|redundancy|dismissal|mutual_agreement|death|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Reason; ILO Convention C158; Local Labor Law Jurisdictions

attributes.name: workday_contract_reference
attributes.description: The native contract or worker agreement identifier from Workday HCM, the system of record for this data product. Used for data lineage, source system reconciliation, and integration with Workday payroll and benefits modules.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Contract Object; Data Lineage Standards

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Organizational unit hierarchy for Ngo, representing departments, divisions, country offices, area/field offices, program units, and cost centers in a recursive parent-child structure. Captures unit name, unit type (HQ department, regional office, country office, field office, program unit), parent unit reference, geographic location, responsible manager, funding model (core vs grant), and active status. Enables hierarchical reporting of headcount, payroll costs, and program staffing across the global organization.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each organizational unit record in the Ngo hierarchy. Primary key for the org_unit data product in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: parent_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate parent organizational unit, enabling recursive parent-child hierarchy traversal for headcount, payroll, and program staffing rollups. Null for the root/top-level unit.

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member designated as the responsible manager or head of this organizational unit, used for accountability and RACI role assignments across programs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: annual_budget_usd
attributes.description: Total approved annual operating budget allocated to this organizational unit in US Dollars, covering both core and grant-funded expenditures. Used for BvA reporting, fund accounting, and financial stewardship in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 Not-for-Profit Entities; GAAP for Nonprofits; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: Name of the city or locality where the organizational unit's primary office is situated. Used for operational logistics, staff deployment planning, and field operations coordination.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Location Management; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code assigned to this organizational unit in the Chart of Accounts (CoA) within SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP. Used for fund accounting, payroll cost allocation, Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting, and grant financial management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts (CoA); Unit4 ERP Project Accounting; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code indicating the country where this organizational unit is physically located or registered (e.g., 'KEN' for Kenya, 'SDN' for Sudan, 'USA' for United States). Used for geographic reporting and IATI disclosure.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI Standard; OCHA Geographic Coding

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this organizational unit record was first created in the source system (Workday HCM) and ingested into the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the primary operating currency of this organizational unit (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'KES'). Used for multi-currency financial reporting and fund accounting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 958; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Accounting

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this organizational unit ceased to be operationally effective (dissolution, merger, or restructuring). Null for currently active units. Used for historical headcount and grant financial reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Effective Dating; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this organizational unit became operationally effective and began appearing in headcount, payroll, and program staffing reports. Supports point-in-time historical analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Effective Dating; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: funding_model
attributes.description: Indicates how the organizational unit is financially sustained. 'core' = funded from unrestricted/core organizational budget; 'grant_funded' = funded entirely by restricted donor grants; 'mixed' = combination of core and grant funding; 'self_funded' = generates own revenue. Critical for fund accounting and BvA reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 Not-for-Profit Entities; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code associated with this organizational unit for financial stewardship and fund accounting in SAP S/4HANA. Enables direct linkage between org unit payroll costs and the GL for financial reporting and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger (GL); FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: headcount_actual
attributes.description: Current number of active staff members assigned to this organizational unit as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for real-time workforce reporting, MEL dashboards, and BvA staffing analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Management; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: headcount_authorized
attributes.description: Maximum number of staff positions (both national and international) authorized for this organizational unit as per the approved organizational structure and donor-approved staffing plans. Used for workforce planning and grant compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Headcount Planning; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Unit4 ERP Budget Control

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this organizational unit within the global hierarchy tree (e.g., 1 = Global HQ, 2 = Regional Office, 3 = Country Office, 4 = Area/Field Office, 5 = Program Unit). Enables efficient hierarchical queries and rollup reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization Hierarchy; Unit4 ERP Project Accounting

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path string representing the full ancestry chain of the organizational unit from root to current node (e.g., '/1/5/12/34/'). Enables fast subtree queries for headcount and payroll rollups without recursive joins.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Design Patterns

attributes.name: iati_org_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Organization Identifier
attributes.description: Unique International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) organization identifier assigned to this unit for transparent aid reporting and donor disclosure. Required for IATI-compliant activity reporting by USAID, DFID, and other ODA donors.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03; USAID ADS Chapter 579; DFID Smart Rules

attributes.name: icr_rate
attributes.description: Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate (NICRA) applicable to this organizational unit, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Used for Facilities and Administration (F&A) cost recovery calculations on federal grants and donor-funded projects per OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart E; NICRA; BHA/USAID Cost Principles

attributes.name: international_staff_count
attributes.description: Number of international (expatriate) staff currently assigned to this organizational unit. Used for expatriate management reporting, visa/work permit tracking, and INGO staffing ratio compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Expatriate Management; OCHA; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: is_field_office
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is classified as a field office operating in a humanitarian or development program context (True) versus a non-field administrative or HQ unit (False). Used to apply field-specific HR policies, allowances, and security protocols.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; OCHA Field Operations Standards; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: is_hq
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is the global or regional headquarters (True). Used to distinguish HQ administrative units from field and country offices in hierarchical reporting and governance structures.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization Management; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; Charity Commission (UK)

attributes.name: mandate_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the organizational unit's mandate, scope of work (SoW), and primary responsibilities within the Ngo's Theory of Change (ToC). Used for onboarding, stakeholder engagement, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; OCHA; IATI Standard

attributes.name: national_staff_count
attributes.description: Number of national (locally-hired) staff currently assigned to this organizational unit. Supports localization reporting, donor compliance requirements, and INGO staffing ratio analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; OCHA Humanitarian Workforce Standards; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: office_address
attributes.description: Physical street address of the organizational unit's primary office location. Classified as confidential organizational contact data used for operational correspondence, audit, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Charity Commission (UK) Registration Requirements; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations

attributes.name: office_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the organizational unit used for official correspondence, donor communications, and regulatory filings. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations

attributes.name: office_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the organizational unit's office. Classified as confidential organizational contact data used for inter-office communications, emergency coordination, and stakeholder engagement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations

attributes.name: org_unit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organizational unit. 'active' = operational; 'inactive' = temporarily suspended; 'pending' = awaiting activation; 'dissolved' = permanently closed; 'merged' = absorbed into another unit.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization Lifecycle; FASB ASC 958 Not-for-Profit Entities

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary humanitarian or development program this organizational unit is aligned to (e.g., WASH, GBV, PSS, Nutrition). Enables program-level staffing and cost reporting in MEL dashboards and donor reports. Applicable primarily to program_unit type org units.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Program Management; IATI Activity Standard; OCHA

attributes.name: region_name
attributes.description: Name of the geographic region or sub-national administrative area where this unit operates (e.g., 'East Africa', 'West Africa', 'Middle East and North Africa', 'South Asia'). Supports regional rollup reporting for MEL dashboards and donor reports.
attributes.references: OCHA Geographic Coding; IATI Standard; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap

attributes.name: registration_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which this organizational unit is legally registered. May differ from the operational country for country offices registered under host-country law.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; IATI Standard

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official legal registration or charity registration number issued by the relevant national regulatory authority (e.g., Charity Commission UK, IRS EIN, national NGO registration body). Required for regulatory compliance filings and donor due diligence.
attributes.references: Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; National NGO Registration Requirements

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code associated with this organizational unit for General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and fund accounting integration. Enables cross-system financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA for Nonprofits; FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: UN/UNDSS security phase classification applicable to the location of this organizational unit (Phase 1 = Minimal, Phase 5 = Emergency). Drives staff deployment decisions, field operations protocols, and duty-of-care obligations for expatriate and national staff.
attributes.references: UNDSS Security Phase Framework; OCHA; CHS Alliance Duty of Care

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the organizational unit across systems (Workday HCM, SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts, Unit4 ERP). Used as the business identifier in cross-system integrations and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts (CoA); Unit4 ERP

attributes.name: unit_mission_statement
attributes.description: Formal mission statement specific to this organizational unit, articulating its contribution to the Ngo's overall mission and SDG alignment. Used in annual reports, donor communications, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; Charity Commission (UK); IATI Standard

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the organizational unit (e.g., 'East Africa Regional Office', 'WASH Program Unit – South Sudan', 'Finance and Administration Department – HQ'). Used in all reporting, dashboards, and donor communications.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization Management; IATI Organizational Identifier Standard

attributes.name: unit_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or shortened display name for the organizational unit used in dashboards, SitRep headers, and space-constrained reporting contexts (e.g., 'EA Regional', 'WASH-SSD').
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Power BI / Tableau MEL Dashboards

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit within the global Ngo structure. Drives hierarchical reporting logic and determines applicable governance rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hq_department|regional_office|country_office|area_office|field_office|program_unit|cost_center — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization Types; OCHA Organizational Structure Standards; IATI

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this organizational unit record in the source system (Workday HCM). Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental loads, and audit compliance in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: volunteer_count
attributes.description: Number of active volunteers currently assigned to or managed by this organizational unit, as tracked in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Volunteer Coordination. Used for workforce capacity reporting and donor impact metrics.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Volunteer Coordination; Workday HCM

attributes.name: workday_org_reference
attributes.description: Native organization identifier assigned by Workday HCM to this organizational unit. Used as the source system key for data integration, reconciliation, and lineage tracking between Workday HCM and the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.

products.name: job_profile
products.description: Standardized job profile catalog defining roles within Ngo, including job family, job level, competency requirements, minimum qualifications, and pay grade band. Used as the template for position creation and recruitment. Aligned with Workday HCM job catalog and HRIS classification standards.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the job profile record in the Ngo HRIS. Primary key for the job_profile data product in the Workday HCM job catalog.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Job profiles define mandatory compliance requirements (background check levels, safeguarding training, professional certifications). Enables compliance matrix by role type and ensures recruitment requ

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this job profile was formally approved by the designated HR authority. Required for governance documentation and audit compliance in donor-funded programs.
