attributes.references: Workday HCM Business Process; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Charity Commission UK

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the HR authority (e.g., HR Director, Country Director) who approved this job profile for use in Workday HCM. Supports governance, audit trail, and compliance with organizational HR policies.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Business Process; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: background_check_level
attributes.description: Required level of pre-employment background screening for this job profile. 'child_protection' and 'enhanced' checks are mandatory for safeguarding-designated roles and roles with access to vulnerable beneficiaries, per CHS and donor requirements.
attributes.references: CHS Core Humanitarian Standard; HAP Humanitarian Accountability Partnership; Charity Commission UK; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations

attributes.name: competency_framework_code
attributes.description: Reference code identifying the competency framework applied to this job profile (e.g., CHS competency framework, Ngo internal framework, IASC humanitarian competencies). Links to the competency library in Workday HCM for performance management and talent development.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency Framework; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard; IASC Inter-Agency Standing Committee

attributes.name: core_competencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of core behavioral and technical competencies required for this job profile as defined in the Workday HCM competency library (e.g., 'Accountability', 'Communication', 'Collaboration', 'Results Orientation', 'MEAL Proficiency'). Used in performance reviews and talent assessments.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard; IASC Competency Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was first created in the Workday HCM system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance and FASB ASC 958.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: duty_station_type
attributes.description: Classification of the expected duty station for this job profile. 'roving' indicates the role covers multiple field locations. Drives hardship allowance eligibility, security protocols, and benefits packages for field personnel.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Location; OCHA Duty Station Classification; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this job profile version became active and available for use in position creation and recruitment in Workday HCM. Supports versioning and historical tracking of job profile changes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Effective Dating; HRIS Classification Standards

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Standard employment type associated with this job profile, indicating the expected contractual arrangement (e.g., full-time permanent, part-time, fixed-term contract, casual, secondment). Drives benefits eligibility and contract template selection in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employment Type; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; Charity Commission UK

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this job profile version was retired or superseded. Null for currently active profiles. Supports effective-dated versioning in Workday HCM and historical workforce analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Effective Dating; HRIS Classification Standards

attributes.name: field_experience_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior humanitarian field experience (e.g., deployment in conflict zones, disaster response, IDP (Internally Displaced Person) settings) is a mandatory requirement for this job profile. Critical for operational roles in Ngo's field programs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Qualification Profile; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the job profile is classified as exempt or non-exempt under the US Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) for overtime eligibility purposes. 'not_applicable' for roles outside US jurisdiction. Required for US-based payroll compliance.
attributes.references: US Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: icr_cost_category
attributes.description: Classification of the job profile's cost as direct, indirect, or shared for purposes of grant budget allocation and NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement) compliance. Determines how staff costs are charged to grants and reported to donors such as USAID and BHA.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA; FASB ASC 958; USAID BHA Requirements

attributes.name: is_critical_role
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile is designated as a critical or key position within Ngo's organizational structure. Critical roles are prioritized in succession planning, talent retention programs, and emergency staffing protocols.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Succession Planning; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: is_safeguarding_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile is designated as a safeguarding role requiring enhanced background checks, child protection clearances, and mandatory safeguarding training. Mandatory for roles working directly with beneficiaries, children, or vulnerable populations.
attributes.references: CHS Core Humanitarian Standard; HAP Humanitarian Accountability Partnership; Charity Commission UK Safeguarding Requirements

attributes.name: job_category
attributes.description: Classification of the job profile by employment category as used in Ngo HR and payroll systems. Distinguishes national staff, international staff (INGO), expatriates, consultants, volunteers, and interns. Drives benefits eligibility, tax treatment, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: job_family_group_name
attributes.description: The broader job family group that clusters related job families in the Workday HCM hierarchy (e.g., 'Operations', 'Finance', 'Technical Specialists', 'Leadership'). Enables enterprise-level workforce analytics and organizational design.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Family Group; HRIS Classification Standards

attributes.name: job_family_name
attributes.description: The job family grouping to which this profile belongs within the Workday HCM job architecture (e.g., 'Program Management', 'Finance and Accounting', 'Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL)', 'Logistics and Supply Chain', 'Human Resources'). Supports workforce planning and compensation benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Family; HRIS Classification Standards

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Standardized job level designation indicating seniority and scope of responsibility within the Ngo grading structure (e.g., 'Entry', 'Junior', 'Mid', 'Senior', 'Lead', 'Manager', 'Director', 'Executive'). Drives pay grade assignment and career pathing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entry|junior|mid|senior|lead|manager|director|executive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Level; HRIS Classification Standards; NICRA Indirect Cost Rate Agreement

attributes.name: key_responsibilities
attributes.description: Structured narrative of the primary duties and accountabilities for this job profile. Serves as the basis for position descriptions, performance agreements, and RACI (Responsible Accountable Consulted Informed) role mapping across programs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard; RACI Framework

attributes.name: language_requirements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of language proficiency requirements for this job profile (e.g., 'English:Fluent', 'French:Working', 'Arabic:Basic'). Particularly relevant for international and field-based roles in Ngo's multi-country operations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Qualification Profile; OCHA Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was most recently updated in the Workday HCM system. Used to detect changes, trigger downstream data pipeline refreshes, and support audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: leadership_competencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of leadership-specific competencies required for managerial and senior roles in this job profile (e.g., 'Strategic Thinking', 'People Development', 'Change Management', 'Stakeholder Engagement'). Populated only for management-level profiles.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: management_level
attributes.description: Indicates whether the job profile is for an individual contributor or a people manager role, and at what management tier. Used in organizational design, RACI (Responsible Accountable Consulted Informed) role assignments, and leadership development programs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Management Level; RACI Framework

attributes.name: min_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum academic qualification required for this job profile (e.g., Bachelor's degree, Master's degree). Used as a screening criterion in recruitment and talent acquisition workflows in Workday HCM and Microsoft Dynamics 365. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|secondary|diploma|bachelor|master|doctorate|professional_certification — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Qualification Profile; HRIS Classification Standards

attributes.name: min_years_experience
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for this job profile. Used as a screening criterion in recruitment and for determining eligibility for internal mobility and promotions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Qualification Profile; HRIS Classification Standards

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: The compensation pay grade band assigned to this job profile (e.g., 'G5', 'P3', 'M2'). Defines the salary range applicable to positions created from this profile. Confidential as it reveals internal compensation structure. Aligned with Ngo's compensation framework and NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement) requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; NICRA; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: pay_grade_max_usd
attributes.description: Maximum base salary in US Dollars for the pay grade band associated with this job profile. Used in compensation benchmarking, offer approvals, and grant budget ceiling calculations. Confidential as it reveals internal compensation structure.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Range; NICRA; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: pay_grade_midpoint_usd
attributes.description: Midpoint salary in US Dollars for the pay grade band, representing the market reference point for fully competent performance in this job profile. Used in compensation equity analysis and salary benchmarking against sector surveys (e.g., Birches Group, Hay Group).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Range; NICRA; Birches Group Salary Survey

attributes.name: pay_grade_min_usd
attributes.description: Minimum base salary in US Dollars for the pay grade band associated with this job profile. Used in budget planning, compensation benchmarking, and grant budget preparation. Confidential as it reveals internal compensation structure.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Range; NICRA; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: preferred_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of desirable but non-mandatory professional certifications for this job profile. Used to differentiate candidates during recruitment and to guide learning and development (L&D) planning in Workday HCM LMS.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Qualification Profile; Workday Learning Management System (LMS)

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the job profile within the Workday HCM job catalog and HRIS classification system. Used in position creation, recruitment requisitions, and cross-system integration (e.g., Unit4 ERP, payroll).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; HRIS Classification Standards

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the job profile as defined in the Workday HCM job catalog (e.g., 'Field Program Officer', 'MEAL Coordinator', 'Finance Manager'). Used in recruitment postings, organizational charts, and staff communications.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; IATI Organizational Standards

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job profile within the Workday HCM job catalog. 'active' profiles are available for position creation and recruitment; 'inactive' or 'archived' profiles are retired from use.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Lifecycle; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: program_area
attributes.description: Primary humanitarian or development program area associated with this job profile (e.g., 'WASH (Water Sanitation and Hygiene)', 'GBV (Gender-Based Violence)', 'Health', 'Education', 'Livelihoods', 'Nutrition', 'PSS (Psychosocial Support)'). Used for workforce planning and program staffing analytics.
attributes.references: OCHA Cluster System; IASC Humanitarian Clusters; SDG Sustainable Development Goals

attributes.name: required_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of mandatory professional certifications or licenses required for this job profile (e.g., 'CPA', 'PMP', 'CIPS', 'HEAT Training', 'SPHERE Certification'). Used in recruitment screening and compliance tracking in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Qualification Profile; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: sdg_alignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UN Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) numbers that this job profile primarily contributes to (e.g., '3,4,6' for Health, Education, WASH roles). Used in donor reporting and IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative) disclosures.
attributes.references: UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDG); IATI International Aid Transparency Initiative; OCHA

attributes.name: succession_eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile is included in Ngo's formal succession planning program in Workday HCM. Profiles marked as succession-eligible are tracked for talent pipeline development and leadership continuity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Succession Planning; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Concise narrative summary of the job profile's purpose, primary accountabilities, and organizational context. Used as the opening paragraph in job postings and position descriptions. Aligned with Workday HCM job profile description field.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Description; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: travel_requirement
attributes.description: Expected level of travel associated with this job profile. 'field_based' indicates deployment to humanitarian field operations (e.g., IDP camps, disaster response zones). Used in recruitment communications and duty of care planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the job profile, incremented each time the profile is substantively revised (e.g., competency updates, pay grade changes, qualification changes). Supports audit trail and change management in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Versioning; HRIS Classification Standards

attributes.name: workday_job_profile_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this job profile record in the Workday HCM source system. Used for system-of-record traceability, data lineage, and integration with Workday payroll, talent, and learning modules.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Object; HRIS Classification Standards

products.name: payroll_run
products.description: Payroll processing cycle record capturing each payroll run executed in Workday HCM, including pay period start and end dates, payroll group (national staff, international staff, expat), run status, total gross pay, total deductions, total net pay, currency, and approval status. Serves as the header record for payroll transactions.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each payroll run record in Workday HCM. Serves as the primary key for the payroll_run entity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958 Not-for-Profit Entities

attributes.name: payroll_system_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.system_platform. Business justification: Tracks which payroll system processed each run. Essential for financial audit trails, donor compliance reporting, system reconciliation, and regulatory requirements. NGOs must demonstrate which certif

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The authorization status of the payroll run within the organization's approval workflow. Tracks whether the run has been reviewed and approved by the designated approver (e.g., Finance Director, Country Director) before disbursement. Distinct from run_status which tracks the processing lifecycle.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Approval Workflow; CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard); RACI Framework; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the individual who authorized this payroll run. Captured for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance. Required for internal controls and external audit purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; CHS; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3)

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the payroll run received final authorization. Provides an immutable audit record of when approval was granted, supporting segregation of duties controls and compliance with OMB Uniform Guidance internal control requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; CHS; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: The organizational bank account identifier or reference number from which net pay is disbursed for this payroll run. Not an individual employee account — this is the organization's payroll disbursement account reference used for treasury reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; FASB ASC 958; Local Banking Regulations

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payroll calculation was executed in Workday HCM. Marks the business event of gross-to-net computation. Distinct from approved_timestamp and created_timestamp, this captures when the financial figures were computed.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The primary cost center code from the CoA (Chart of Accounts) to which the aggregate payroll costs of this run are allocated. Used for departmental budget tracking, grant cost allocation, and BvA (Budget versus Actual) reporting in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CoA; Unit4 ERP Project Accounting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country of operation for which this payroll run was executed (e.g., KEN, UGA, SSD). Determines applicable labor law, tax regime, and statutory deduction rules. Essential for multi-country NGO payroll operations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; OCHA Country Operations; Local Labor Law Standards; Workday HCM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll run record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, compliance, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which this payroll run is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, KES, NGN). Critical for multi-currency NGO operations where national staff may be paid in local currency while international staff are paid in USD or EUR.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative); FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: The total number of employees included in this payroll run. Used for headcount reporting, per-capita cost analysis, and validation that all eligible staff were processed. Reconciled against HRIS (Human Resource Information System) active headcount.
attributes.references: Workday HCM HRIS Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the payroll run amounts from the local currency to the organization's functional reporting currency (typically USD). Sourced from the organization's treasury or ERP at the time of payroll processing. Required for consolidated financial reporting and BvA (Budget versus Actual) analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; IATI; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number within the fiscal year, e.g., 1–12) to which this payroll run is posted in the General Ledger. Supports period-close processes, BvA (Budget versus Actual) reporting, and grant financial management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; SAP S/4HANA GL; Unit4 ERP; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this payroll run falls, as defined by the organization's financial calendar. Used for annual financial reporting, grant budget period tracking, and FASB ASC 958 compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the organization's functional reporting currency (e.g., USD). Used alongside exchange_rate to express payroll costs in a consistent currency for consolidated financial statements and donor reporting.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The fund code identifying the restricted or unrestricted fund from which payroll costs are drawn. Supports fund accounting requirements under FASB ASC 958, ensuring donor-restricted funds are used only for their designated purposes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 Fund Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL (General Ledger) account code in the CoA (Chart of Accounts) to which the payroll expense is posted. Ensures payroll costs are correctly classified in the financial statements per FASB ASC 958 not-for-profit accounting standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Module; FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: grant_code
attributes.description: The grant identifier to which a portion or all of this payroll run's costs are charged. Enables grant-level labor cost tracking and compliance with donor reporting requirements. May be null for unrestricted payroll runs not tied to a specific grant.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID BHA Reporting; Unit4 ERP Grant Management; IATI

attributes.name: icr_rate
attributes.description: The Indirect Cost Rate (ICR) or F&A (Facilities and Administration) rate applied to direct labor costs in this payroll run, as defined in the organization's NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement). Used to calculate indirect cost recovery charges against grants.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA; USAID BHA; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: is_retroactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll run includes retroactive pay adjustments for prior pay periods (e.g., backdated salary increases, correction of underpayments). Retroactive runs require special grant cost allocation treatment under OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll run record was most recently modified. Tracks corrections, status changes, and amendments to the payroll run. Essential for data lineage and change management in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: legal_entity_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the legal entity (registered country office or subsidiary) under which this payroll run is processed. Aligns with the organizational structure in SAP S/4HANA and Workday HCM for fund accounting and statutory reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting; FASB ASC 958; Charity Commission (UK); IRS 501(c)(3)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for payroll officers to document special circumstances, exceptions, or explanatory remarks about this payroll run (e.g., reason for off-cycle run, description of corrections made, emergency payment context). Supports audit trail and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which employees in this payroll group are paid. Determines the number of pay periods per year and affects annualized salary calculations, benefit proration, and grant budget reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; Local Labor Law Standards

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll run. Defines the closing boundary of the earnings window. Together with pay_period_start_date, determines the scope of labor costs chargeable to grants and programs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll run. Defines the beginning of the earnings window for all employees included in the run. Used for time-and-attendance reconciliation and grant cost allocation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date on which net pay is disbursed to employees' bank accounts or via alternative payment methods. Used for cash flow planning, bank reconciliation, and compliance with local labor law payment deadlines.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; Local Labor Law Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The disbursement method used to pay employees in this payroll run. In humanitarian contexts, mobile money (e.g., M-Pesa) is common for field staff in remote areas. Determines the payment processing channel and reconciliation approach.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Local Banking Regulations; OCHA Cash and Voucher Assistance Standards

attributes.name: payroll_group
attributes.description: Classification of the staff population covered by this payroll run. Distinguishes between national staff (locally hired), international staff (globally mobile), expatriates (expat), volunteers with stipends, and consultants. Drives applicable tax regimes, benefit structures, and compliance reporting requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement)

attributes.name: processed_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the payroll officer who initiated and processed this payroll run in Workday HCM. Supports RACI (Responsible Accountable Consulted Informed) accountability tracking and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; RACI Framework; CHS; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: The program identifier to which payroll costs are allocated, linking staff costs to specific humanitarian or development programs (e.g., WASH, GBV, PSS). Supports program-level financial reporting and MEL (Monitoring Evaluation and Learning) cost analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Unit4 ERP Project Accounting; IATI; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: retroactive_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the prior period for which retroactive pay adjustments are being made in this payroll run. Populated only when is_retroactive is True. Used to correctly allocate retroactive costs to the appropriate grant and fiscal period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the payroll run, typically formatted as PR-YYYY-MM-NNNN (e.g., PR-2024-03-0012). Used in audit trails, finance reconciliation, and donor/grant reporting to reference a specific payroll cycle.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payroll run within Workday HCM. Progresses from draft through calculation, approval, and payment. Cancelled status indicates the run was voided before disbursement. Used for workflow control and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard); FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the payroll run. Regular runs follow the standard pay schedule; off-cycle runs address missed payments; supplemental runs cover bonuses or allowances; correction runs fix prior errors; final runs process termination pay. Determines processing rules and audit requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: The aggregate of all deductions applied across employees in this payroll run, including statutory taxes, social security contributions, health insurance premiums, pension contributions, and voluntary deductions. Reconciled against payroll liabilities in the General Ledger (GL).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Workday HCM

attributes.name: total_employer_contributions
attributes.description: The aggregate employer-side payroll costs for this run, including employer social security, pension matching, health insurance, and other statutory employer contributions. Represents the full labor cost burden beyond gross pay, critical for grant budget management and F&A (Facilities and Administration) cost allocation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA; Workday HCM

attributes.name: total_gross_pay
attributes.description: The aggregate gross earnings for all employees included in this payroll run before any deductions. Includes base salary, allowances, overtime, and other earnings components. Used for BvA (Budget versus Actual) reporting, grant cost allocation, and financial stewardship.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Workday HCM Payroll Module

attributes.name: total_net_pay
attributes.description: The aggregate net amount disbursed to all employees in this payroll run after all deductions. Equals total_gross_pay minus total_deductions. Used for cash disbursement planning, bank transfer reconciliation, and treasury management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA AP

attributes.name: total_tax_withheld
attributes.description: The aggregate income tax and statutory levies withheld from employee earnings in this payroll run. Reported to tax authorities and reconciled against payroll tax liability accounts in the CoA (Chart of Accounts). Supports compliance with IRS and local tax authority reporting.
attributes.references: IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; Local Tax Authority Standards; FASB ASC 958; Workday HCM

attributes.name: workday_run_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this payroll run by Workday HCM, the system of record. Enables traceability back to the source system for audit, reconciliation, and support purposes. Distinct from the Silver layer surrogate key payroll_run_id.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

products.name: payslip
products.description: Individual payslip record for each staff member per payroll cycle, serving as SSOT for both payroll run processing (pay period start/end dates, payroll group — national/international/expat, run sequence number, run status, batch approval, total run aggregates) and individual pay details (gross salary, allowances — housing/hardship/field/expat, statutory deductions — income tax/social security/pension, voluntary deductions, net pay in local and payment currencies). Multi-currency supported for international operations across 50+ countries. Includes payment method, bank details reference, and payroll run approval chain. Supports BvA (Budget vs Actual) payroll cost allocation to grants and programs, donor audit requirements, and statutory payroll reporting.

attributes.name: payslip_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual payslip record in the Workday HCM payroll system. Serves as the primary key for the payslip data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: original_payslip_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payslip record that this corrected or reversed payslip supersedes. Null for standard payslips; populated only when is_correction is True, enabling full audit trail of payroll corrections.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll run batch under which this payslip was processed. Enables traceability of individual payslips back to the parent payroll run for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member for whom this payslip was generated. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM HRIS.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payroll run containing this payslip was formally approved in the Workday HCM approval workflow. Provides an auditable approval event timestamp for statutory and donor compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorising manager or finance officer who approved this payroll run in the Workday HCM approval chain. Supports RACI accountability documentation and donor audit requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Masked or tokenised reference to the employee's bank account details used for payment disbursement. Full account details are stored securely in Workday HCM; only a reference token is retained in the Silver Layer for audit traceability without exposing PCI-sensitive data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; PCI DSS; GDPR Article 25 (Data Minimisation)

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Chart of Accounts (CoA) cost center code to which the employee's payroll costs are primarily allocated. Supports Budget vs Actual (BvA) reporting and fund accounting in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting; Unit4 ERP; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the duty station where the employee is based and where payroll is processed. Determines applicable labour law, tax jurisdiction, statutory deduction rules, and local currency for multi-country NGO operations across 50+ countries.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payslip record was first created in the Workday HCM system and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Provides the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: employer_pension_contribution
attributes.description: Employer's contribution to the employee's pension or provident fund for the pay period. Recorded separately from employee deductions for total employment cost reporting and grant cost allocation under OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Local Pension Regulations

attributes.name: employer_social_security
attributes.description: Employer's statutory social security or national insurance contribution associated with this payslip. Not deducted from employee pay but recorded for total employment cost reporting, BvA grant cost allocation, and NICRA indirect cost rate calculations.
attributes.references: Local Labour Law; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert local currency salary amounts to the payment currency at the time of payroll processing. Critical for multi-currency reconciliation and donor financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: expat_allowance
attributes.description: Allowance specific to internationally-recruited expatriate staff, covering relocation, cost-of-living differentials, and international assignment premiums. Applicable only to staff in the expat payroll group.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; INGO Expat Compensation Standards

attributes.name: field_allowance
attributes.description: Allowance paid to staff working in active field operations, remote areas, or humanitarian response zones. Distinct from hardship allowance; compensates for operational field conditions and mobility requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SPHERE Standards; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: gl_journal_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the General Ledger journal entry posted in SAP S/4HANA or Unit4 ERP for this payslip's payroll costs. Enables reconciliation between payroll records and the fund accounting general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger; Unit4 ERP; FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: grant_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the grant or funding source to which this payroll cost is charged. Enables donor-specific payroll cost allocation for BvA reporting, USAID/DFID/CERF grant compliance, and NICRA indirect cost rate calculations.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID BHA Requirements

attributes.name: gross_salary
attributes.description: Total gross salary amount in local currency before any deductions, representing the employee's base contractual pay for the pay period. Forms the basis for all statutory deduction calculations and BvA payroll cost reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: hardship_allowance
attributes.description: Additional allowance paid to staff deployed in hardship or non-family duty stations as classified by UN/INGO hardship classification frameworks. Compensates for difficult living conditions in humanitarian field operations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; UN Common System Hardship Classification; INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: housing_allowance
attributes.description: Monetary allowance paid to the employee to cover accommodation costs, commonly provided to international and expat staff in high-cost or insecure duty stations. Taxability varies by country and employment contract type.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; INGO Compensation Frameworks

attributes.name: income_tax_deduction
attributes.description: Statutory income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay in accordance with the applicable national tax legislation of the duty station country. Reported to tax authorities and included in statutory payroll filings.
attributes.references: IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; Local Tax Authority Requirements; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: is_correction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payslip is a corrected reissue of a previously reversed payslip. When True, the original_payslip_id field references the superseded payslip for audit trail continuity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: is_off_cycle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payslip was generated as part of an off-cycle payroll run (e.g., for a new hire mid-period, a termination payment, or a correction) rather than the standard scheduled payroll cycle.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the local currency in which the employee's salary components are denominated and calculated. Supports multi-currency payroll operations across 50+ countries.

attributes.name: net_pay_local
attributes.description: Final take-home pay amount in local currency after all statutory and voluntary deductions have been subtracted from gross pay and allowances. Represents the amount the employee is entitled to receive for the pay period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: net_pay_payment_currency
attributes.description: Net pay amount converted to the payment currency using the applicable exchange rate. Represents the actual amount disbursed to the employee's bank account. May equal net_pay_local when local and payment currencies are the same.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; ISO 4217; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the payroll period covered by this payslip. Together with pay_period_start_date defines the exact payroll cycle window for statutory and donor reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the payroll period covered by this payslip. Used for Budget vs Actual (BvA) payroll cost allocation to grants and programs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the currency in which net pay is actually disbursed to the employee. May differ from local_currency_code for expatriate staff paid in USD or EUR regardless of duty station.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Workday HCM Payroll Module; INGO Expat Compensation Standards

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which net pay was disbursed to the employee's bank account or via the designated payment method. Represents the principal business event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee. Bank transfer is standard for most staff; cash and mobile money are used in remote field locations with limited banking infrastructure, common in humanitarian operations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; CHS Alliance Field Operations Standards

attributes.name: payroll_group
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member's employment category for payroll processing purposes. Determines applicable pay scales, allowances, tax treatment, and statutory deduction rules. National staff follow local labour law; international and expat staff follow INGO compensation frameworks.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: payroll_run_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential run number within the payroll period (e.g., 1 for the primary run, 2 for a supplemental or correction run). Distinguishes regular payroll runs from off-cycle or adjustment runs.

attributes.name: payslip_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable unique reference number for this payslip, typically formatted as PSL-{COUNTRY}-{YEAR}-{MONTH}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in employee communications, statutory filings, and donor audit documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: payslip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this individual payslip record. Distinguishes between payslips that have been generated and issued to the employee versus those that have been reversed or superseded by a corrected payslip.

attributes.name: pension_deduction
attributes.description: Employee contribution to pension or provident fund deducted from gross pay. Includes both mandatory statutory pension contributions and voluntary supplementary pension scheme contributions where applicable.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Local Pension Regulations; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the humanitarian or development program to which this payroll cost is allocated. Supports program-level cost tracking for MEL reporting, LogFrame financial monitoring, and donor accountability.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Project Accounting; IATI Standard; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payroll run associated with this payslip. Tracks the workflow from initial calculation through approval, payment disbursement, and any reversals required for corrections.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: social_security_deduction
attributes.description: Statutory social security or national insurance contribution deducted from the employee's pay as required by local labour law. Varies by country and employment type; may be zero for certain expat staff under bilateral social security agreements.
attributes.references: Local Labour Law; GAAP for Nonprofits; Workday HCM Payroll Module

attributes.name: total_allowances
attributes.description: Sum of all allowance components (housing, hardship, field, expat, transport, and any other applicable allowances) for the pay period in local currency. Used as a subtotal in payslip presentation and BvA reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: total_statutory_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all mandatory statutory deductions (income tax, social security, pension) for the pay period. Used as a subtotal in payslip presentation and for statutory remittance reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; Local Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: transport_allowance
attributes.description: Allowance paid to cover employee commuting or field transportation costs. Commonly provided to national staff in urban and peri-urban duty stations as part of the total compensation package.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Local Labour Law Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payslip record was last modified in the source system or Silver Layer. Tracks corrections, status changes, and reprocessing events for data lineage and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: voluntary_deductions
attributes.description: Total of all employee-elected voluntary deductions for the pay period, including staff association fees, health insurance premiums, loan repayments, savings scheme contributions, and other authorised deductions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Record of a staff members enrollment in a specific benefit plan, serving as SSOT for both the benefit plan catalog (plan name, provider, plan type, eligibility criteria for national vs international staff, coverage structure, cost model, effective dates) and individual enrollment instances (coverage tier, enrollment date, effective date, end date, employee contribution, employer contribution, dependent coverage). Covers health insurance, life insurance, pension, medical evacuation, and R&R (Rest and Recuperation) entitlements. Plan catalog entries have header-level attributes; enrollments are line-level records per staff member per plan. Sourced from Workday HCM Benefits module.

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each benefit enrollment record in the Workday HCM Benefits module. Serves as the primary key for this Silver Layer data product.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958 (Not-for-Profit Entities)

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the benefit plan catalog entry that the staff member is enrolled in. Links to the benefit plan master record defining plan name, provider, type, and eligibility rules.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member enrolled in this benefit plan. Links to the workforce employee master record in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit enrollment was formally approved by the authorized HR officer in Workday HCM. Part of the enrollment lifecycle audit trail.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the HR officer or manager who approved this benefit enrollment in Workday HCM. Supports RACI accountability and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated beneficiary for life insurance or pension death benefit plans. Populated for life insurance and pension plan types. Sensitive PII requiring restricted access.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; GDPR Article 4; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: beneficiary_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the designated beneficiary to the enrolled staff member for life insurance or pension death benefit purposes (e.g., spouse, child, parent).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member is eligible for continuation of health coverage under COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) or equivalent continuation provisions upon termination of employment. Applicable primarily for US-based staff.
attributes.references: US COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); Workday HCM Benefits Module; IRS 501(c)(3)

attributes.name: contribution_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which employee and employer contributions are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Critical for multi-currency NGO operations across field offices.

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: The pay period frequency at which employee and employer contributions are deducted and remitted. Aligns with the payroll cycle configured in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Chart of Accounts (CoA) cost center to which the employer benefit contribution is charged. Enables grant-level and program-level benefit cost allocation in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA for Nonprofits; Unit4 ERP; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The coverage level selected by the staff member, indicating whether the plan covers the employee alone or extends to dependents. Drives cost-sharing calculations and dependent eligibility.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was first created in Workday HCM, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Establishes the audit creation trail for compliance and data governance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents (spouse, children, or other eligible family members) covered under this enrollment. Drives coverage tier classification and premium calculation.

attributes.name: duty_station_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the staff member's duty station at time of enrollment. Determines eligibility for international vs. national staff benefit plans and medical evacuation entitlements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; Workday HCM; OCHA; CHS Alliance; SPHERE Standards

attributes.name: duty_station_hardship_level
attributes.description: UN/OCHA hardship classification of the duty station (H=Headquarters, A through E indicating increasing hardship). Determines eligibility for R&R (Rest and Recuperation) entitlements and hazard pay benefit components.
attributes.references: OCHA; UN International Civil Service Commission (ICSC) Hardship Classification; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which benefit coverage ends for this enrollment record. Null for open-ended active enrollments. Populated upon termination, resignation, contract end, or plan year close.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which benefit coverage becomes active and the staff member is entitled to use the plan. May differ from enrollment_date due to waiting periods or plan cycle start rules.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: eligibility_rule_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the eligibility rule set in Workday HCM that governs which staff categories qualify for this plan (e.g., 'INTL-STAFF-ONLY', 'NAT-STAFF-PENSION', 'ALL-STAFF-HEALTH'). Supports automated eligibility validation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount contributed by the staff member per pay period toward the benefit plan premium or pension. Used in payroll deduction processing and Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount contributed by the organization per pay period toward the benefit plan premium or pension on behalf of the staff member. Included in Facilities and Administration (F&A) cost calculations and grant budget reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA; F&A Cost Principles

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the staff member formally enrolled in the benefit plan, as recorded in Workday HCM. Represents the business event date of enrollment action.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: enrollment_event_type
attributes.description: The qualifying business event that triggered this enrollment record in Workday HCM. Determines eligibility windows and audit trail for compliance. Life events include marriage, birth, adoption, and loss of other coverage.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the benefit enrollment record. 'Active' indicates current coverage; 'Pending' indicates awaiting approval or effective date; 'Terminated' indicates coverage has ended; 'Waived' indicates the employee opted out; 'On Leave' indicates coverage maintained during approved leave; 'Suspended' indicates temporarily paused.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: grant_code
attributes.description: Grant or award identifier to which the employer benefit contribution is allocated, supporting donor-restricted fund accounting and indirect cost rate (ICR/NICRA) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP; SAP S/4HANA for Nonprofits; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA; USAID; BHA

attributes.name: is_dependent_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment includes coverage for one or more dependents beyond the enrolled staff member. True when coverage_tier extends beyond employee-only.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this benefit enrollment record in Workday HCM, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: life_insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The face value or sum assured of the life insurance benefit plan in the contribution currency. Populated only for life insurance plan type enrollments. Used for beneficiary payout calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: medevac_coverage_zone
attributes.description: Geographic zone or region to which the staff member is entitled to be medically evacuated under the medical evacuation benefit plan (e.g., 'Regional Hub', 'Home Country', 'Nearest Adequate Facility'). Applicable for international and field staff.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; OCHA; CHS Alliance; SPHERE Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for HR staff to record additional context, exceptions, or special circumstances related to this benefit enrollment (e.g., retroactive adjustments, special eligibility waivers, field office exceptions).

attributes.name: open_enrollment_period
attributes.description: Identifier or label for the open enrollment window during which this enrollment was submitted (e.g., 'OE-2024-Q4'). Supports audit and reconciliation of annual benefit elections.

attributes.name: pension_contribution_rate_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the staff member's gross salary contributed to the pension plan per pay period (combined employee and employer rate). Applicable for pension plan type enrollments. Used in NICRA indirect cost rate calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA

attributes.name: plan_provider
attributes.description: Name of the external insurance carrier, pension fund administrator, or service provider delivering the benefit plan (e.g., 'Cigna Global', 'AXA International', 'CIGNA Expatriate Benefits').

attributes.name: plan_provider_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy or contract number issued by the benefit plan provider to the organization. Used for claims processing and provider reconciliation.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan covering the enrollment. Includes health insurance, life insurance, pension/retirement, medical evacuation (medevac), and Rest and Recuperation (R&R) entitlements applicable to humanitarian field staff. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health_insurance|life_insurance|pension|medical_evacuation|rest_and_recuperation|disability — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; CHS Alliance; SPHERE Standards; OCHA Staff Welfare Guidelines

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: The four-digit calendar or fiscal year of the benefit plan cycle to which this enrollment belongs (e.g., '2024'). Used for annual open enrollment reconciliation and FASB ASC 958 period reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: rr_cycle_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the Rest and Recuperation (R&R) entitlement cycle for this enrollment, applicable to field staff in hardship locations. Determined by duty station hardship level per OCHA/organizational policy.
attributes.references: OCHA; CHS Alliance; SPHERE Standards; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member at time of enrollment, determining eligibility for specific benefit plans. National staff, international staff, and expatriates typically have distinct benefit entitlements in NGO/INGO operations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; CHS Alliance; OCHA Staff Welfare Guidelines; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the end of this benefit enrollment. Populated when enrollment_status transitions to 'terminated'. Supports HR analytics and compliance audit trails. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resignation|contract_end|termination|retirement|death|transfer|plan_discontinuation|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the enrollment date and the effective start date during which the staff member is not yet eligible to claim benefits. Defined by the plan's eligibility rules.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the staff member when opting out (waiving) a benefit plan. Populated only when enrollment_status is 'waived'. Examples: covered by spouse plan, covered by government scheme.

products.name: benefit_plan
products.description: Catalog of benefit plans offered by Ngo to staff, including health insurance schemes, pension plans, group life insurance, medical evacuation coverage, and R&R (Rest and Recuperation) entitlements. Captures plan name, provider, eligibility criteria (national vs international staff), coverage details, and cost structure.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each benefit plan record in the Workday HCM Benefits module. Serves as the primary key for the benefit_plan entity.

attributes.name: admin_system_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.system_platform. Business justification: Links benefit plans to their administration platform (Workday, SAP, local HRIS). Required for enrollment processing, vendor integration management, data migration planning, and system-specific configu

attributes.name: annual_coverage_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum total benefit payout or coverage amount per enrolled staff member per plan year, expressed in US Dollars. Used for financial liability estimation and BvA (Budget versus Actual) reporting in Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employer and employee contributions are made or deducted for this benefit plan (e.g., monthly, bi-weekly). Aligns with payroll cycle configuration in Workday HCM and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; SAP S/4HANA Payroll

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code in SAP S/4HANA or Unit4 ERP to which benefit plan costs are allocated. Supports program-level cost tracking and indirect cost rate (ICR/NICRA) calculations for donor reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; SAP S/4HANA; NICRA

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country for which this benefit plan is applicable when geographic_scope is 'country_specific' (e.g., 'KEN', 'ETH', 'SSD'). Null for global or regional plans.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IATI Standard; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: coverage_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the benefits and services covered under this plan, including key inclusions and exclusions (e.g., inpatient/outpatient care, emergency evacuation, dental, maternity, pre-existing conditions). Sourced from the provider's Summary of Benefits document.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Defines the coverage scope of the plan in terms of dependents included (e.g., individual only, individual plus spouse, full family). Determines premium cost structure and payroll deduction amounts.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the plan's financial terms (premiums, contributions, limits) are denominated (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Supports multi-currency operations across Ngo's country offices.

attributes.name: deductible_amount_usd
attributes.description: The amount an enrolled staff member must pay out-of-pocket before the benefit plan begins covering costs, expressed in US Dollars. Relevant for health insurance and medical evacuation plans.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: dependent_coverage_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrolled staff members may extend coverage under this plan to eligible dependents (spouse, children). Drives dependent enrollment workflows in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit plan ceases to be available for enrollment or active coverage. Nullable for open-ended plans. When populated, triggers off-boarding of enrolled staff in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the benefit plan becomes binding and available for staff enrollment. Used to determine plan applicability during open enrollment periods and new hire onboarding.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount_usd
attributes.description: Fixed monetary amount deducted from the enrolled staff member's salary per contribution period, expressed in USD. Used when the employee contribution is a flat amount rather than a percentage.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: employee_contribution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total benefit plan premium or contribution deducted from the enrolled staff member's salary. Complements employer_contribution_pct to total 100% of the plan cost.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount_usd
attributes.description: Fixed monetary amount contributed by Ngo per enrolled staff member per contribution period, expressed in USD. Used when the employer contribution is a flat amount rather than a percentage. Feeds into payroll and grant F&A (Facilities and Administration) cost calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA

attributes.name: employer_contribution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total benefit plan premium or contribution that Ngo (the employer) pays on behalf of the enrolled staff member. Used for payroll cost allocation and grant budget charging in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement)

attributes.name: employment_type_eligibility
attributes.description: Specifies which employment contract types are eligible for this benefit plan (e.g., full_time permanent, part_time, fixed_term contract, or all). Drives automated eligibility checks during onboarding in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollment in this plan is automatic (all eligible staff are enrolled by default), voluntary (staff opt in), or mandatory (required by law or policy). Drives Workday HCM enrollment workflow logic.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the benefit plan applies globally across all Ngo country offices, regionally, or is restricted to a specific country of operation. Supports multi-country INGO benefit administration.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance; IATI Standard; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code in SAP S/4HANA or Unit4 ERP to which employer benefit contributions for this plan are charged. Enables accurate fund accounting, grant cost allocation, and BvA (Budget versus Actual) reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts (CoA); GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: hardship_location_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit plan is specifically designed for or applicable to staff deployed in hardship or non-family duty stations (e.g., conflict zones, remote field locations). Relevant for MedEvac, R&R, and hazard pay benefit plans.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance; OCHA; Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: is_grant_chargeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer's contribution to this benefit plan can be directly charged to donor grants as an allowable cost under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200. Affects grant budget preparation and financial reporting to donors such as USAID and BHA.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; NICRA; USAID ADS

attributes.name: is_medevac_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether medical evacuation (MedEvac) coverage is included within this benefit plan. Critical for field personnel and expatriate staff operating in high-risk humanitarian contexts. Aligns with Sphere and CHS duty-of-care standards.
attributes.references: Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards; CHS Alliance; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: is_rnr_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rest and Recuperation (R&R) Entitlement Included Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Rest and Recuperation (R&R) entitlements are included in this benefit plan. R&R is a mandatory staff welfare provision for personnel deployed in hardship or non-family duty stations per INGO HR policy.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance; OCHA Staff Welfare Guidelines; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit plan was last formally reviewed by HR leadership or the benefits committee for adequacy, cost, and compliance. Supports governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance; Charity Commission UK; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: max_dependents_covered
attributes.description: Maximum number of dependents that can be enrolled under a single staff member's benefit plan coverage. Null or zero indicates no dependent coverage or unlimited dependents per plan rules.

attributes.name: minimum_service_months
attributes.description: Minimum number of months of continuous service an employee must complete before becoming eligible to enroll in this benefit plan. A value of 0 indicates immediate eligibility upon hire.

attributes.name: next_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit plan contract with the provider is due for renewal or renegotiation. Triggers procurement and HR review workflows to ensure continuity of staff coverage.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for HR administrators to capture additional context, special conditions, exceptions, or administrative notes related to the benefit plan that are not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: open_enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the annual open enrollment window closes. Staff who do not act before this date are subject to default enrollment rules or waiver of coverage for the plan year.

attributes.name: open_enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the annual open enrollment window opens, allowing eligible staff to enroll in, modify, or waive coverage for the upcoming plan year. Managed in Workday HCM Benefits enrollment events.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the benefit plan across HR and payroll systems (e.g., 'HLTH-INTL-01', 'PENSION-NAT-02'). Used for cross-system reconciliation with SAP S/4HANA payroll and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.description: URL or document management system path to the official plan document, Summary of Benefits, or provider contract. Enables HR staff and auditors to access the authoritative plan terms for compliance verification.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the benefit plan as displayed to staff and HR administrators (e.g., 'International Staff Health Insurance Scheme', 'National Staff Pension Plan', 'Group Life Insurance – Field Personnel').

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit plan indicating whether it is available for enrollment, suspended, or retired. Drives eligibility logic in Workday HCM and payroll deduction processing in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the benefit plan by its primary benefit category as administered in Workday HCM (e.g., health_insurance, pension, group_life_insurance, medical_evacuation, rest_and_recuperation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health_insurance|pension|group_life_insurance|medical_evacuation|rest_and_recuperation|disability|dental|vision|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: plan_year_start_month
attributes.description: The calendar month (1–12) in which the benefit plan year begins. Determines open enrollment windows, annual coverage resets, and financial year-end accruals in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the external insurance company, pension fund administrator, or benefit service provider underwriting or administering this plan (e.g., 'Cigna Global Health', 'AXA Assistance', 'Allianz Care').
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: provider_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy or contract reference number issued by the benefit provider to Ngo. Used for claims processing, renewals, and regulatory filings. Classified as confidential due to contractual sensitivity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific regulatory framework, local labor law, or donor compliance requirement that mandates or governs this benefit plan (e.g., 'Kenya Employment Act 2007', 'IRS 501(c)(3)', 'OMB 2 CFR 200', 'DFID Supplier Standards'). Supports compliance reporting and audit readiness.
attributes.references: IRS 501(c)(3); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Charity Commission UK; IATI; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: rnr_frequency_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rest and Recuperation (R&R) Frequency in Days
attributes.description: Number of days between each R&R entitlement cycle for staff covered under this plan (e.g., every 60 days for hardship locations). Applicable only when is_rnr_included is True.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance; OCHA Staff Welfare Guidelines; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: staff_category_eligibility
attributes.description: Defines which staff category is eligible to enroll in this benefit plan. Distinguishes between national staff (locally hired), international staff (expatriates/INGOs), or both. Critical for INGO compliance and equitable HR policy under CHS.
