attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; IATI

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after enrollment before coverage becomes effective for the enrolled staff member. A value of 0 indicates immediate coverage upon enrollment. Common for health insurance and pension plans.

products.name: recruitment_requisition
products.description: Talent acquisition request record initiated when a position needs to be filled or a new position is created, capturing requisition number, linked position, hiring manager, target start date, recruitment type (internal, external, emergency surge), funding source confirmation, approval chain status, sourcing channels (internal posting, external job boards, UN job network, ReliefWeb), and time-to-fill tracking. Supports Ngos workforce planning and rapid surge recruitment for emergency responses.

attributes.name: recruitment_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the recruitment requisition record in Workday HCM. Serves as the primary key for all downstream joins and audit trails. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant or funding award that will finance this position. Required for donor compliance, budget-versus-actual (BvA) tracking, and Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement (NICRA) reporting under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID BHA Requirements

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the humanitarian or development program that this position will support. Enables program-level workforce planning and ensures alignment with program design and Theory of Change (ToC) staffing requirements.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Program Management; IATI Standard

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized job profile in Workday HCM defining the role family, competency requirements, and compensation grade associated with this requisition.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog; HRIS Best Practices

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department or cost center within Ngo that is requesting the hire. Used for headcount reporting, budget allocation, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Management; SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved position in the organizational structure that this requisition is intended to fill. Links to the position management module in Workday HCM for headcount control and workforce planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: primary_recruitment_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member designated as the hiring manager responsible for defining requirements, participating in interviews, and making the final selection decision. Maps to PARTY_REFERENCE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; RACI Framework

attributes.name: tertiary_recruitment_recruiter_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HR staff member assigned as the primary recruiter responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process for this requisition in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; RACI Framework

attributes.name: actual_fill_date
attributes.description: The date on which the requisition was formally closed as filled, i.e., when an offer was accepted by the selected candidate. Used to calculate time-to-fill metrics and assess recruitment efficiency against targets.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; HRIS Best Practices

attributes.name: application_deadline
attributes.description: The closing date for candidate applications as advertised in the job posting. After this date, new applications are typically not accepted unless the requisition is extended. Supports candidate pipeline management and posting compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; ReliefWeb Posting Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final approval was granted for the requisition. Used to measure approval cycle time and to establish the official start of the active recruitment period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current state of the requisition within the organizational approval chain. 'pending' = awaiting review; 'approved' = all required approvals obtained; 'rejected' = denied by an approver; 'escalated' = routed to a higher authority due to exception or delay. Approval chain typically includes hiring manager, HR business partner, finance, and country director.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; RACI Framework

attributes.name: budgeted_annual_salary
attributes.description: The approved annual salary budget for this position in the organizational base currency. Used for budget-versus-actual (BvA) tracking, grant budget compliance, and workforce cost forecasting. Confidential financial data.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the requisition was cancelled or closed without being filled. Populated only when requisition_status is 'cancelled' or 'closed'. Common reasons include funding loss, program restructuring, or position elimination. Supports workforce planning retrospectives.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the requisition record was first created in Workday HCM, regardless of approval or opening status. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budgeted salary amount (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'KES'). Required for multi-currency workforce cost consolidation and donor financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 958; IATI Financial Reporting Standard

attributes.name: duty_station
attributes.description: The primary geographic location where the recruited staff member will be based, expressed as a city or field office name (e.g., 'Nairobi', 'Juba Field Office'). Used for hardship allowance determination, security risk classification, and GIS-based workforce mapping.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OCHA Duty Station Classification; UN Security Management System

attributes.name: duty_station_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the recruited position will be based (e.g., 'KEN', 'SSD', 'ETH'). Supports country-level workforce analytics, visa and work permit tracking, and IATI geographic reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI Standard; OCHA Country Office Reporting

attributes.name: education_level_required
attributes.description: Minimum academic qualification required for the position: 'certificate', 'diploma', 'bachelors', 'masters', 'phd', or 'none'. Used for candidate screening and workforce capability gap analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; HRIS Best Practices

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Nature of the employment arrangement being recruited for: 'full_time' = permanent or open-ended; 'part_time' = reduced hours; 'fixed_term' = time-bound contract; 'consultancy' = individual contractor engagement; 'volunteer' = unpaid service. Affects contract template, benefits eligibility, and payroll setup.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: funding_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the funding source for this position has been confirmed and budget availability verified prior to opening the requisition. True = funding confirmed; False = pending funding confirmation. Critical control for grant-funded positions to prevent unauthorized commitments.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: funding_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the funding mechanism supporting this position: 'grant' = donor-restricted award; 'core_funds' = unrestricted organizational funds; 'cost_share' = matching contribution required by donor; 'bridge_funding' = temporary internal funding pending grant confirmation; 'multi_donor' = split across multiple grants. Affects budget coding and NICRA applicability.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: gender_marker
attributes.description: Indicates any gender preference or affirmative action target for this position as part of Ngo's gender equity and diversity commitments: 'open' = no preference; 'female_preferred' = women strongly encouraged to apply; 'male_preferred' = men strongly encouraged to apply (rare, context-specific). Supports gender-disaggregated workforce reporting to donors and IASC gender accountability frameworks.
attributes.references: IASC Gender Accountability Framework; USAID Gender Equality Policy; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: headcount_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition is for a backfill of a vacated position, a newly created position, a replacement for a terminated employee, or a surge addition for emergency response. Drives workforce planning analytics and budget impact assessment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits

attributes.name: is_emergency_surge
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition was triggered by an emergency humanitarian response requiring rapid deployment (surge recruitment). True = emergency surge; False = standard recruitment. When True, expedited approval workflows and compressed time-to-fill targets apply per CHS and SPHERE standards.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; OCHA Surge Capacity Guidelines

attributes.name: job_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the job advertisement was first published on external or internal channels. Used to calculate time-to-post (from requisition opening to posting) and to manage posting expiry dates per platform requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; ReliefWeb Posting Standards; UN Jobs Network

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The specific job title for the position being recruited, as it will appear in job postings and the employment contract. May differ from the standardized job profile name to reflect local context or donor-specific naming conventions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; ReliefWeb Job Posting Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the requisition record in Workday HCM. Supports change detection, incremental ETL loads, and audit compliance. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: minimum_experience_years
attributes.description: The minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for the position as specified in the job description. Used for candidate screening, competency benchmarking, and workforce capability analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; HRIS Best Practices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or exceptions related to this requisition (e.g., donor-specific hiring restrictions, language requirements, security context notes). Captured by the HR business partner or hiring manager in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: number_of_openings
attributes.description: The total number of identical positions to be filled under this single requisition. Values greater than 1 are common for surge recruitment (e.g., hiring 10 community health workers for a WASH response). Drives candidate pipeline sizing and recruiter workload planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the requisition was formally opened and made available for sourcing. Represents the principal business event date for time-to-fill calculations and workforce planning analytics. Maps to BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: positions_filled_count
attributes.description: Running count of the number of openings that have been successfully filled under this requisition. Compared against number_of_openings to determine requisition completion. Supports partial-fill tracking for multi-opening surge requisitions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; HRIS Best Practices

attributes.name: recruitment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recruitment approach: 'internal' = open only to current staff; 'external' = open to the public; 'emergency_surge' = rapid deployment for humanitarian response; 'rehire' = former employee returning; 'secondment' = staff loaned from a partner organization. Drives sourcing channel selection and time-to-fill targets.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; SPHERE Standards

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable requisition reference number assigned by Workday HCM at creation (e.g., REQ-2024-000123). Used in all communications with hiring managers, HR business partners, and candidates. Maps to BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; IATI Transparency Standard

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the requisition within Workday HCM. Drives downstream actions: 'draft' = not yet submitted for approval; 'open' = actively recruiting; 'on_hold' = paused pending funding or approvals; 'filled' = candidate selected and offer accepted; 'cancelled' = withdrawn before fill; 'closed' = administratively closed. Maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: salary_grade
attributes.description: The compensation band or grade level assigned to this position as defined in the organizational salary scale (e.g., 'Grade 7', 'Band C', 'P3'). Confidential business data used for budget planning, equity analysis, and offer management. Not disclosed externally.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: security_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires a background check or security clearance prior to onboarding. True = clearance required; False = not required. Relevant for positions in conflict-affected areas, positions handling restricted donor data, or roles with fiduciary responsibilities.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; UN Security Management System; USAID Vetting Requirements

attributes.name: sourcing_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of recruitment sourcing channels activated for this requisition (e.g., 'internal_posting, reliefweb, un_jobs, linkedin, devex, ngo_network'). Supports sourcing effectiveness analytics and cost-per-hire reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal_posting|reliefweb|un_jobs|linkedin|devex|ngo_network|referral|direct_outreach — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; ReliefWeb; UN Jobs Network; DevEx

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the staff type being recruited: 'national_staff' = Host Country National (HCN) employed locally; 'international_staff' = globally recruited; 'expatriate' = staff deployed outside home country; 'hcn' = Host Country National; 'tcn' = Third Country National. Determines compensation framework, visa requirements, and NICRA cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: national_staff|international_staff|expatriate|hcn|tcn|regional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; USAID BHA Staffing Requirements; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: target_fill_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the requisition must be filled, distinct from the target start date. Drives recruiter workload prioritization and escalation triggers. For emergency surge requisitions, this date is typically within 72 hours of opening.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: target_start_date
attributes.description: The desired date by which the recruited candidate should be onboarded and operational. Used for workforce planning, program staffing gap analysis, and time-to-fill KPI measurement. May be adjusted based on recruitment progress.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Program Management

attributes.name: time_to_fill_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed from the requisition opened_date to the actual_fill_date. Populated once the requisition is filled. Key KPI for recruitment efficiency, benchmarked against organizational targets and humanitarian surge standards (e.g., 72-hour surge fill target).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; HRIS Best Practices; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

products.name: job_application
products.description: Candidate application record linked to a recruitment requisition, capturing applicant identity, application date, source channel, CV/resume reference, cover letter, application stage, stage outcome, interview scores, and final hiring decision. Tracks the full candidate pipeline from application to offer for both internal and external candidates.

attributes.name: job_application_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each job application record in the Workday HCM recruitment module. Serves as the primary key for the job_application data product.

attributes.name: candidate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate (applicant) master record containing personal profile, contact details, and employment history. Enables tracking of a single individual across multiple applications.

attributes.name: funding_source_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant or funding source that will cover the salary and benefits of this position. Required for donor compliance, cost allocation, and BvA reporting in Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organisational program or project to which the position is assigned. Links workforce planning to program delivery and MEL frameworks.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Program Management; IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: primary_job_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HR staff member or recruiter responsible for managing this application through the pipeline. Used for recruiter workload reporting and RACI accountability tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; RACI Framework

attributes.name: recruitment_requisition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job requisition (open position) against which this application was submitted. Links the candidate pipeline to the approved headcount request.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the candidate formally submitted the application. Used for time-to-hire calculations, pipeline aging analysis, and compliance reporting under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 equal-opportunity requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally communicated reference number assigned to the application at submission (e.g., APP-2024-000123). Used in candidate correspondence, offer letters, and audit trails.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Accountability to Affected Populations

attributes.name: application_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the candidate in the recruitment pipeline workflow (e.g., Applied, Screening, Assessment, Interview, Reference Check, Offer, Onboarding, Withdrawn, Rejected). Drives pipeline funnel analytics and recruiter workload dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Applied|Screening|Assessment|Interview|Reference Check|Offer|Onboarding|Withdrawn|Rejected — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; SHRM Talent Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Overall lifecycle status of the application record. Distinct from application_stage (which tracks pipeline position); this field reflects the terminal or current disposition of the entire application.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: application_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the application was received by the system. Supports SLA measurement, duplicate detection, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy)

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the pre-employment background screening (criminal record, sanctions list, sexual exploitation and abuse registry checks). Mandatory for roles involving direct contact with beneficiaries under CHS and USAID partner vetting requirements.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Preventing Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA); USAID ADS 303; OCHA Vetting Standards

attributes.name: candidate_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the applicant is an external candidate, an internal staff member applying for a different role, a former employee (rehire), or a contractor being converted to staff. Affects onboarding workflow and background check requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: cover_letter_reference
attributes.description: Storage path or document management system reference pointing to the candidate's submitted cover letter. Supports recruiter review and competency-based screening.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the job application record was first created in Workday HCM. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with GDPR Article 5 accountability principle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: cv_document_reference
attributes.description: Storage path or document management system reference (e.g., SharePoint URL, S3 URI) pointing to the candidate's submitted CV or resume. Enables recruiters to retrieve the document without storing binary content in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation)

attributes.name: disability_disclosure
attributes.description: Whether the candidate has voluntarily disclosed a disability for the purpose of reasonable accommodation requests and equal-opportunity monitoring. Collected under GDPR Article 9 explicit consent and UK Equality Act 2010 requirements.
attributes.references: UK Equality Act 2010; GDPR Article 9; UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD); USAID Disability Policy

attributes.name: duty_station
attributes.description: Geographic location (city, country, or field office) where the role will be based. Critical for hardship allowance calculations, security risk assessment, and field operations staffing under OCHA and SPHERE standards.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Operations Guidelines; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; UN Common System Duty Station Classification

attributes.name: duty_station_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the duty station where the position is located. Supports geographic workforce analytics, visa/work permit tracking, and donor country-of-operation reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI Country Codes Standard

attributes.name: gender_self_identified
attributes.description: Gender as self-reported by the candidate on the application form. Collected for equal-opportunity monitoring, gender-disaggregated workforce reporting, and donor diversity requirements (e.g., USAID Gender Policy, DFID Development Assistance Committee DAC gender markers).
attributes.references: USAID Gender Equality and Female Empowerment Policy; OECD DAC Gender Equality Marker; GDPR Article 9; UK Equality Act 2010

attributes.name: grant_funded_position
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position being applied for is funded by a specific donor grant rather than core/unrestricted organisational funds. Affects allowability review under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 and NICRA cost allocation.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: highest_education_level
attributes.description: Highest academic qualification attained by the candidate as declared on the application. Used for minimum qualification screening and workforce capability analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: secondary|bachelor|postgraduate_diploma|master|doctorate|professional_certification|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; UNESCO International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED)

attributes.name: hiring_decision
attributes.description: Final hiring decision made by the selection committee for this application. 'Reserve list' indicates the candidate was strong but the position was filled; they may be contacted for future vacancies.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Equal Opportunity

attributes.name: interview_date
attributes.description: Date on which the primary (or most recent) interview was conducted. Used for time-to-interview SLA tracking and scheduling analytics.

attributes.name: interview_panel_notes
attributes.description: Free-text summary of interview panel observations, competency ratings, and recommendation rationale. Stored for audit, grievance, and equal-opportunity compliance purposes. Access restricted to HR and hiring managers.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; GDPR Article 9 (special category data caution); CHS Alliance

attributes.name: interview_score
attributes.description: Aggregate numeric score (0–100) from the structured interview panel, combining scores across competency dimensions. Supports merit-based selection and equal-opportunity compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; SHRM Structured Interview Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: languages_spoken
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages the candidate is proficient in, as declared on the application. Critical for field operations roles requiring local language capability and for INGO multi-country deployments.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OCHA Field Operations Language Requirements

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the job application record in Workday HCM. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change data capture in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; Workday HCM Audit Trail

attributes.name: nationality_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the candidate's nationality. Required for work permit eligibility assessment, expatriate management, and national/international staff classification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Humanitarian Workforce Standards; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: offer_accepted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the candidate formally accepted the employment offer. Triggers onboarding workflow initiation in Workday HCM and Microsoft Dynamics 365.

attributes.name: offer_extended_date
attributes.description: Date on which a formal employment offer was extended to the selected candidate. Used for time-to-offer KPI measurement and offer acceptance rate analytics.

attributes.name: position_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the position being applied for as defined in the approved job requisition. Used in offer letters, employment contracts, and HRIS records.

attributes.name: proposed_salary
attributes.description: Gross annual or monthly salary amount proposed in the offer letter, in the local or contract currency. Used for budget-versus-actual (BvA) analysis and grant-funded position cost allocation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Compensation Allowability

attributes.name: proposed_start_date
attributes.description: Agreed or proposed date on which the candidate is expected to commence employment. Used for workforce planning, field deployment scheduling, and grant-funded position activation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; Unit4 ERP Project Staffing

attributes.name: reference_check_status
attributes.description: Current status of the professional reference verification process for this application. Reference checks are mandatory for senior and field security roles in most INGO HR policies.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Standardised reason code or description explaining why the application was not progressed or the candidate was not selected. Required for equal-opportunity reporting and candidate feedback under CHS accountability standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: overqualified|underqualified|failed_assessment|failed_interview|failed_background_check|position_cancelled|better_candidate_selected|withdrew|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CHS Alliance Accountability to Affected Populations; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 13 (right to information)

attributes.name: safeguarding_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the safeguarding and child protection vetting check. Required for all roles with access to vulnerable populations including children, IDPs, and PoCs under CHS, SPHERE, and donor safeguarding policies.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance Safeguarding Policy; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; USAID PSEA Requirements; UK Charity Commission Safeguarding Guidance

attributes.name: salary_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the proposed salary amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, KES). Required for multi-currency payroll and donor financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 958; IATI Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: salary_grade
attributes.description: Compensation band or grade level assigned to the position (e.g., G5, P3, Band C). Aligns with the organisation's pay scale framework and UN Common System salary grades for international staff.
attributes.references: UN Common System Salary Scales; Workday HCM Compensation Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: screening_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) assigned during the initial CV/application screening phase, reflecting how well the candidate meets the minimum qualifications and desirable criteria defined in the job requisition. Used for shortlisting decisions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; SHRM Competency-Based Hiring Framework

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: Channel or platform through which the candidate discovered and submitted the application. Supports sourcing effectiveness analysis and cost-per-hire reporting. ReliefWeb and UN Jobs are primary channels for INGO/NGO recruitment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: careers_portal|referral|linkedin|ngo_job_board|un_jobs|reliefweb|internal_transfer|recruitment_agency|walk_in|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; IATI Transparency Standards

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Workforce classification of the position being applied for. Distinguishes national staff, international staff, expatriates, consultants, and volunteers — critical for INGO payroll, tax treaty compliance, and donor reporting on staffing costs.
attributes.references: OCHA Humanitarian Workforce Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS Chapter 302

attributes.name: stage_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the most recently completed pipeline stage for this application. Indicates whether the candidate advanced, was eliminated, withdrew, or is awaiting a decision at the current stage.

attributes.name: written_assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) from a written technical or competency-based assessment administered to shortlisted candidates. Common in NGO recruitment for programme, finance, and MEL roles.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CHS Alliance Competency Framework

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total years of relevant professional experience declared by the candidate on the application form. Used for minimum qualification screening and competency benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; SHRM Competency Framework

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Formal performance appraisal record for a staff member covering a defined review period. Captures review cycle (annual, mid-year, probation), overall rating, competency ratings, objective achievement scores, reviewer identity, reviewee acknowledgment, and development recommendations. Supports Ngo's talent retention and results-based management (RBM) culture.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the performance review record. Primary key for the performance_review data product in the Workday HCM-sourced workforce domain.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary grant funding the employee's position during the review period. Supports donor-funded staff performance reporting requirements under USAID, DFID, CERF, and OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID; DFID

attributes.name: calibration_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the talent calibration session in which this review's rating was discussed and validated against peer employees. Ensures rating consistency and fairness across the organization.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Calibration; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary humanitarian or development program to which the employee was assigned during the review period. Links performance outcomes to program results for RBM and donor reporting.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Program Management; RBM Results-Based Management; IATI

attributes.name: pip_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) record if one was initiated as a result of this review. Null if no PIP was required.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational position held by the employee at the time of the review, capturing role context for benchmarking and talent analytics.

attributes.name: primary_performance_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (reviewee) who is the subject of this performance review. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Object; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: review_template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized performance review template used for this appraisal cycle, defining the competency framework, rating scales, and objective categories applied.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review Template Configuration

attributes.name: reviewer_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (manager or designated reviewer) who conducted and submitted this performance review. Supports Results-Based Management (RBM) accountability chains.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management Module; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: accountability_rating
attributes.description: Rating assessing the employee's demonstrated accountability to affected populations and beneficiaries, a core CHS and HAP requirement for all humanitarian staff. Reflects adherence to feedback mechanisms and complaint handling.
attributes.references: CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4; HAP Humanitarian Accountability Partnership; Sphere Association

attributes.name: collaboration_rating
attributes.description: Rating for the collaboration and partnership competency, assessing the employee's effectiveness in working across teams, with partner organizations (CSOs, CBOs, INGOs), and with beneficiary communities.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency Framework; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: competency_rating_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score reflecting the employee's average rating across all behavioral competencies assessed in the review (e.g., leadership, collaboration, accountability, humanitarian principles). Supports talent development analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency Framework; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 8

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the performance review record was first created in the system (Workday HCM or the Databricks Silver Layer ingestion). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: development_recommendations
attributes.description: Structured recommendations from the reviewer for the employee's professional development, including suggested training, mentoring, stretch assignments, or Learning Management System (LMS) courses to address identified gaps.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; LMS Learning Management System; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 8

attributes.name: duty_station
attributes.description: The geographic location (country, city, or field base) where the employee was deployed during the review period. Critical for field operations context, hardship allowance eligibility, and OCHA/USAID/BHA donor reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs; USAID Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance (BHA); Workday HCM Location

attributes.name: duty_station_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the employee was stationed during the review period. Enables geographic workforce analytics and cross-country performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI International Aid Transparency Initiative; OCHA

attributes.name: employee_acknowledged
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has formally acknowledged the performance review in Workday HCM. Required for HR audit compliance and CHS accountability to affected populations standards.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review Acknowledgment; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4; HAP

attributes.name: employee_acknowledged_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reviewed employee formally acknowledged receipt and review of their performance appraisal in Workday HCM. Required for HAP and CHS accountability compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management Module; HAP Humanitarian Accountability Partnership; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments submitted by the employee at the time of acknowledgment, capturing their response to the review outcome, including any disagreements, additional context, or commitments for the next period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4

attributes.name: employee_disagreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee formally disputed or disagreed with the performance review outcome. Triggers the HR grievance and appeals process in accordance with organizational HR policy and CHS accountability standards.
attributes.references: CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4; HAP Humanitarian Accountability Partnership; IRS 501(c)(3) HR Compliance

attributes.name: employee_self_assessment
attributes.description: Free-text self-assessment narrative submitted by the employee prior to the review meeting, documenting their own perspective on achievements, challenges, and development needs during the review period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review Self-Evaluation; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the performance review record was most recently modified in the system. Tracks the full edit history for audit compliance and data quality monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: leadership_rating
attributes.description: Rating for the leadership competency dimension, assessing the employee's ability to guide teams, make decisions under pressure, and drive program outcomes in humanitarian field contexts.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency Framework; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 8

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The planned date for the employee's next performance review or check-in, as agreed during the current review meeting. Supports proactive HR scheduling and talent management planning.

attributes.name: objective_achievement_score
attributes.description: Composite percentage score (0–100) reflecting the degree to which the employee achieved their defined performance objectives during the review period. Derived from individual objective ratings in Workday HCM and used in RBM and LogFrame reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Goals Management; RBM Results-Based Management; LogFrame Logical Framework

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: The holistic performance rating assigned to the employee for the review period, reflecting the reviewer's consolidated assessment across all competencies and objectives. Drives talent retention, promotion, and RBM reporting decisions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Rating Scale Configuration; FASB ASC 958; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score corresponding to the overall performance rating on the configured rating scale (e.g., 1.00–5.00). Enables quantitative talent analytics, benchmarking, and Results-Based Management (RBM) reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Rating Scale; RBM Results-Based Management Framework

attributes.name: pip_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) has been recommended or initiated as a result of this review, typically triggered by an unsatisfactory or needs_improvement overall rating.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management; IRS 501(c)(3) HR Compliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: promotion_recommendation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer recommends the employee for promotion or advancement to a higher grade or responsibility level based on this review cycle's performance outcomes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: rating_scale_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the performance rating scale applied in this review (e.g., 'v2.1-2024'). Ensures historical comparability as rating scales evolve over time.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Rating Scale Configuration

attributes.name: retention_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer or HR has flagged this employee as at risk of leaving the organization, enabling proactive talent retention interventions. Supports NGO workforce stability in high-turnover humanitarian contexts.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 8

attributes.name: review_cycle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the performance review cycle that this appraisal belongs to. Distinguishes annual appraisals, mid-year check-ins, probationary reviews, end-of-contract assessments, and ad hoc reviews triggered by specific events.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review Cycle Configuration; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 8

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the performance review must be completed and submitted by the reviewer. Used for HR compliance tracking and manager accountability reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management Module; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: review_meeting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal performance review discussion meeting took place between the reviewer and the employee. Distinct from the submission date; required for CHS accountability documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the performance review record (e.g., PR-2024-000123). Used in HR correspondence, audit trails, and donor-funded program compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the performance period being evaluated in this review. Together with review_period_start_date, defines the full appraisal window.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Period Configuration; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the performance period being evaluated in this review. Defines the temporal boundary for objective achievement and behavioral observation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Period Configuration; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the performance review workflow in Workday HCM. Tracks progression from draft through manager completion to employee acknowledgment and final closure.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Business Process Framework; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: review_submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reviewer formally submitted the completed performance review in Workday HCM. Used to measure timeliness compliance against the review due date.

attributes.name: reviewer_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text qualitative narrative provided by the reviewer summarizing the employee's performance, key achievements, areas for improvement, and behavioral observations during the review period. Confidential HR record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's staff category at the time of the review. Distinguishes national staff, international staff, expatriates, consultants, and volunteers, which affects applicable HR policies, review templates, and donor reporting requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type Configuration; OCHA Humanitarian Workforce Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: technical_skills_rating
attributes.description: Rating for the employee's technical competency relevant to their functional role (e.g., MEAL methodology, WASH engineering, GBV case management, financial stewardship, ICT4D). Supports targeted learning and development planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency Framework; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; IATI International Aid Transparency Initiative

attributes.name: values_alignment_rating
attributes.description: Rating assessing the degree to which the employee demonstrates alignment with the NGO's core organizational values and humanitarian principles (e.g., humanity, neutrality, impartiality, accountability). Critical for CHS compliance and organizational culture.
attributes.references: CHS Core Humanitarian Standard; Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards; HAP Humanitarian Accountability Partnership

products.name: learning_enrollment
products.description: Record of a staff members enrollment in a learning or training activity, serving as SSOT for both the course catalog (course code, title, delivery mode, duration, provider, required frequency, content category) and individual enrollment instances (enrollment date, completion date, pass/fail status, certification issued, expiry date). Course catalog entries are header-level reference records; enrollments are line-level records per staff member per course. Covers mandatory compliance courses (PSEA, CHS, security, safeguarding), technical skills, leadership development, and field operations training. Supports compliance training tracking, mandatory training deadline monitoring, and staff capacity building.

attributes.name: learning_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each learning enrollment record. Serves as the primary key for the learning_enrollment data product in Workday HCM Learning module.

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational program or project to which this training is linked. Enables allocation of training costs and capacity building efforts to specific grants or programs for donor reporting and Budget versus Actual (BvA) analysis.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard; Unit4 ERP

attributes.name: learning_course_id
attributes.description: Reference to the course catalog header record defining the learning activity. Links the enrollment line to the course master record containing title, provider, and content details.

attributes.name: lms_enrollment_id
attributes.description: External enrollment identifier from the source Learning Management System (LMS) such as Workday Learning or a third-party LMS platform. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.

attributes.name: primary_learning_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member enrolled in the learning activity. Corresponds to the Workday Worker record for national staff, international staff, or expatriate personnel.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: actual_hours_spent
attributes.description: Actual number of hours the staff member spent on the course, as recorded in the Learning Management System (LMS). May differ from duration_hours for self-paced or blended courses. Used for staff capacity building analytics.

attributes.name: attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which attempt this enrollment record represents for the staff member on this course. A value of 1 indicates the first attempt; values greater than 1 indicate retakes following a failed or incomplete prior attempt.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the certificate issued to the staff member upon successful course completion. Used for verification and audit purposes. Null if no certificate was issued.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the issued certification expires and the staff member must recertify. Applicable for time-bound certifications such as first aid, security, PSEA refreshers, and safeguarding. Null if the certification does not expire.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the staff member completed all required course activities. Null if the course has not yet been completed. Used for compliance reporting and certification issuance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: completion_evidence_url
attributes.description: URL or document reference path to the digital evidence of course completion, such as a scanned certificate, attendance register, or e-learning completion screenshot stored in the document management system. Supports audit and compliance verification.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Chart of Accounts (CoA) cost center code to which the training cost is allocated in the General Ledger (GL). Supports fund accounting and grant financial management in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the training was physically delivered. Used for geographic analysis of staff capacity building investments and field operations training coverage. Null for fully virtual or e-learning courses.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative) Standard

attributes.name: course_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the course content area. Compliance covers mandatory regulatory courses (PSEA, CHS, safeguarding); technical_skills covers programmatic and operational competencies; leadership_development covers management and supervisory training; field_operations covers WASH, GBV response, NFI distribution, and humanitarian field protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: compliance|technical_skills|leadership_development|field_operations|safeguarding|security|health_safety|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; SPHERE Standards

attributes.name: course_title
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the learning course or training activity as defined in the course catalog. Examples: 'Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Awareness', 'Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Orientation', 'Field Security Management'.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the enrollment record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the training_cost amount. Supports multi-currency operations across field offices in different countries.

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Method by which the course content is delivered to the learner. e_learning: online self-paced modules; instructor_led: classroom or in-person facilitated; blended: combination of online and in-person; on_the_job: practical field-based learning; webinar: live virtual instructor-led; self_study: reading materials or independent study.

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: Name of the organizational department or unit to which the staff member belongs at the time of enrollment. Used for departmental training compliance reporting and capacity building analytics.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the staff member must complete the course to remain compliant. Critical for mandatory compliance courses such as PSEA, CHS, safeguarding, and security training. Drives automated deadline monitoring and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership)

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours required to complete the course as defined in the course catalog. Used for workforce capacity planning, learning hours reporting, and donor compliance reporting on staff development investments.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the staff member was registered or enrolled in the learning activity. Used for mandatory training deadline monitoring and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Indicates how the enrollment was initiated. self_enrolled: staff member registered independently; manager_assigned: direct supervisor assigned the course; hr_assigned: Human Resources (HR) team assigned as part of onboarding or compliance cycle; system_auto: automatically assigned by Workday HCM based on role or policy; donor_required: mandated by a donor or grant agreement.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the staff member's enrollment in the course. enrolled: registered but not yet started; in_progress: actively engaged in the course; completed: finished with pass or fail outcome; withdrawn: removed before completion; waived: exempted from mandatory requirement by authorized approver.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: is_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal certificate of completion or competency was issued to the staff member upon successful completion of the course. True when a certificate has been generated and recorded.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course is a mandatory compliance requirement for the staff member. True for courses such as PSEA, CHS, safeguarding, security, and donor-mandated training. False for optional or elective learning activities.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: job_profile
attributes.description: Workday HCM job profile or role title of the staff member at the time of enrollment. Used to assess training coverage by role and to link mandatory training requirements to specific job profiles (e.g., Field Officer, Program Manager, Finance Officer).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the enrollment record. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the silver layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the staff member's assessment or evaluation for the course. pass: met the minimum passing threshold; fail: did not meet the minimum threshold; not_applicable: no formal assessment required for this course type; pending_assessment: course completed but assessment result not yet recorded.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum percentage score required to achieve a passing result for the course assessment. Defined at the course catalog level and copied to the enrollment for historical accuracy. Null if no scored assessment applies.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization or individual responsible for delivering the course content. May be an internal team (e.g., HR, MEL unit), an external training provider, a UN agency, or an INGO partner. Examples: 'OCHA Training Unit', 'RedR International', 'Internal HR Learning Team'.

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the training provider. internal: delivered by the organization's own staff; external: commercial or independent training company; un_agency: United Nations body (e.g., OCHA, UNICEF); ingo_partner: another International Non-Governmental Organization (INGO); government: national or local government authority; academic: university or research institution.

attributes.name: required_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the staff member is required to complete or refresh this course. once: one-time onboarding requirement; annual: yearly renewal (e.g., PSEA, security); biennial: every two years; quarterly: every three months; as_needed: triggered by role change or incident.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Numeric score achieved by the staff member on the course assessment or final evaluation, expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Null if no formal scored assessment exists for the course.

attributes.name: staff_type
attributes.description: Classification of the enrolled staff member's employment category at the time of enrollment. Supports disaggregated reporting on training coverage across national staff, international staff, expatriates, volunteers, consultants, and interns as required by donor and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the staff member began engaging with the course content. Distinct from enrollment_date; used to measure time-to-start and learning engagement metrics.

attributes.name: training_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for the staff member's enrollment in this training activity, in the organization's functional currency. Includes registration fees, materials, and direct delivery costs. Used for Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting and grant financial management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: training_location
attributes.description: Physical location or virtual platform where the training was delivered. For in-person training, records the city, country, or field office name. For virtual delivery, records the platform name (e.g., 'Zoom', 'Workday Learning', 'Moodle LMS'). Null for fully self-paced e-learning.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized person who approved the training waiver. Required for audit trail and compliance accountability when a mandatory course is waived. Null for non-waived enrollments.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership)

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Documented justification for waiving a mandatory training requirement for this staff member. Required when enrollment_status is 'waived'. Must be approved by an authorized HR or compliance officer. Null for non-waived enrollments.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

products.name: learning_course
products.description: Catalog of learning and development courses available to Ngo staff, including mandatory compliance courses (PSEA, CHS, security, safeguarding), technical skills courses, leadership development, and field operations training. Captures course code, title, delivery mode (e-learning, classroom, blended), duration, provider, and required frequency.

attributes.name: learning_course_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each learning and development course record in the Workday HCM Learning module. Serves as the primary key for the learning_course data product.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: hosting_system_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.system_platform. Business justification: Identifies which LMS hosts each course. Essential for user access provisioning, course migration planning, vendor contract management, and integration with HR systems. Replaces denormalized platform_n

attributes.name: available_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the course becomes available for enrollment in the Workday HCM Learning catalog. Used for scheduling new course launches, onboarding cohort planning, and compliance deadline management.

attributes.name: available_until_date
attributes.description: Date after which the course is no longer available for new enrollments. Null for courses with no planned end date. Used to manage course retirement and transition to updated versions in the Workday HCM Learning catalog.

attributes.name: certificate_validity_months
attributes.description: Number of months for which the course completion certificate or credential remains valid before recertification is required. Null if the certificate does not expire. Used to calculate recertification due dates and compliance status in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; USAID Regulations

attributes.name: competency_framework
attributes.description: Name of the competency framework or standard to which this course is aligned (e.g., 'CHS Core Commitments', 'SPHERE Minimum Standards', 'IASC Gender Handbook', 'Ngo Internal Competency Framework', 'USAID CDCS'). Enables skills gap analysis and results-based management (RBM) reporting.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; SPHERE Association; Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC); Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: cost_per_learner
attributes.description: Estimated or actual cost in USD to deliver this course to one learner, including licensing, facilitation, materials, and platform fees. Used for budget planning, Budget versus Actual (BvA) analysis, and indirect cost rate (ICR/NICRA) calculations under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the course in the Workday HCM Learning catalog and referenced in staff communications, compliance registers, and donor reporting (e.g., PSEA-001, CHS-FOUND-02). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; IATI

attributes.name: course_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal team or role responsible for maintaining and updating this course (e.g., 'Global L&D Team', 'HR Business Partner - Field Operations', 'Safeguarding Unit'). Used for content governance, RACI assignment, and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: course_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the course in the Workday HCM Learning catalog. 'active' means available for enrollment; 'draft' means under development; 'archived' means retired from active use but retained for historical records. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: course_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the course by its primary purpose within Ngo's workforce development framework. 'mandatory_compliance' covers PSEA, CHS, safeguarding, and security courses required by donors and regulators; 'technical_skills' covers programmatic and operational competencies; 'field_operations' covers WASH, GBV response, and humanitarian response protocols. Serves as the primary CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mandatory_compliance|technical_skills|leadership_development|field_operations|onboarding|health_safety|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; SPHERE Association; Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC); Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: course_url
attributes.description: Direct URL link to the course in the hosting LMS or external platform. Enables staff to access the course directly from HR portals, intranet pages, and automated assignment notifications.

attributes.name: cpe_credits
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Professional Education (CPE) or Continuing Education Unit (CEU) credits awarded upon successful completion of this course. Used for professional development tracking and external accreditation reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the course record was first created in the Workday HCM Learning system or the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record-keeping requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost_per_learner amount (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Defaults to 'USD' for USAID-funded programs. Required for multi-currency financial reporting under SAP S/4HANA and OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Method by which the course content is delivered to learners. 'e_learning' is self-paced online; 'classroom' is in-person instructor-led; 'blended' combines online and in-person; 'virtual_instructor_led' is live online facilitation; 'on_the_job' is practical field-based learning. Captured in Workday HCM Learning as the course format.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total estimated time in hours required to complete the course, including all modules, assessments, and practical exercises. Used for staff workload planning, compliance tracking, and donor reporting on training investment. Serves as the principal MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: external_accreditation
attributes.description: Name of the external body or standard that accredits or endorses this course (e.g., 'Sphere Association', 'CHS Alliance', 'ACNM', 'PMI', 'UNHCR'). Null if the course is not externally accredited. Used for professional development reporting and donor compliance.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; SPHERE Association; Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: fund_source
attributes.description: Classification of the funding source for this course, aligned to Ngo's fund accounting structure. 'restricted_grant' indicates the course is funded by a specific donor grant with reporting obligations; 'unrestricted' indicates organizational core funding. Used for fund accounting in SAP S/4HANA and donor compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 Not-for-Profit Entities; Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting

attributes.name: has_assessment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course includes a formal assessment, quiz, or competency test that learners must pass to receive credit or certification. Drives pass/fail tracking in Workday HCM and compliance verification for mandatory courses.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course is mandatory for all applicable staff at Ngo. Mandatory courses include PSEA, CHS, security awareness, and safeguarding as required by donors (USAID, DFID/FCDO), the Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance, and Ngo's internal compliance policy. Drives automated assignment and compliance tracking in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; USAID Regulations; DFID Requirements; Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: issues_certificate
attributes.description: Indicates whether successful completion of this course results in the issuance of a formal certificate or credential to the learner. Relevant for professional development tracking, donor reporting, and staff file management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Primary language in which the course content is delivered, expressed as an ISO 639-1 two-letter or ISO 639-2 three-letter language code (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'ar', 'es', 'sw'). Critical for field staff accessibility in multilingual humanitarian operations.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 / ISO 639-2 Language Codes; IATI Standard; Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the course content was last reviewed for accuracy, policy alignment, and relevance by the course owner or subject matter expert. Mandatory compliance courses (PSEA, CHS, safeguarding) must be reviewed at least annually per CHS Alliance and donor requirements.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; SPHERE Association; Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: learning_course_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the course content, learning objectives, and intended outcomes as displayed in the Workday HCM Learning catalog. Helps staff and managers understand the course scope before enrollment.

attributes.name: max_enrollment
attributes.description: Maximum number of learners that can be enrolled in a single offering or session of this course. Applicable primarily to classroom and virtual instructor-led delivery modes. Null for self-paced e-learning with unlimited capacity. Used for session scheduling and waitlist management.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next content review of this course. Drives content governance workflows and ensures mandatory compliance courses remain current with evolving CHS, PSEA, and donor policy requirements.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; USAID Regulations; Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: passing_score
attributes.description: Minimum percentage score (0–100) required for a learner to pass the course assessment and receive completion credit. Applicable only when has_assessment is True. Used for compliance verification and certification issuance in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: prerequisite_course_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of course codes that must be completed before a learner can enroll in this course (e.g., 'PSEA-001,CHS-FOUND-01'). Supports learning pathway design and enrollment eligibility enforcement in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization or internal unit responsible for developing and/or delivering the course (e.g., 'Ngo Internal L&D Team', 'UNHCR Learning', 'Sphere Association', 'RedR', 'Coursera for Nonprofits'). Used for vendor management, cost allocation, and quality assurance.

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the course provider by organizational type. Distinguishes internally developed courses from those sourced from UN agencies, peer INGOs, academic institutions, or commercial vendors. Used for procurement compliance under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 and donor reporting.
attributes.references: Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency at which staff must retake or recertify this course. 'once' applies to foundational onboarding courses; 'annual' applies to PSEA, security, and safeguarding refreshers; 'biennial' applies to CHS and some technical courses. Drives recertification scheduling and compliance deadline tracking in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; SPHERE Association; Workday HCM Learning; USAID Regulations

attributes.name: scorm_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the e-learning course package is compliant with the Sharable Content Object Reference Model (SCORM) standard, enabling interoperability with Workday HCM and other SCORM-compatible LMS platforms. Relevant for e-learning and blended delivery modes.
attributes.references: SCORM Standard (ADL Initiative); Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: sdg_alignment
attributes.description: United Nations Sustainable Development Goal(s) to which this course contributes (e.g., 'SDG 3 Good Health', 'SDG 4 Quality Education', 'SDG 5 Gender Equality'). Used for IATI reporting, donor narrative reporting, and organizational impact measurement aligned to the 2030 Agenda.
attributes.references: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs); IATI Standard; OCHA Reporting

attributes.name: short_description
