attributes.description: Brief summary of the course (maximum 255 characters) used in catalog listings, automated assignment notifications, and mobile LMS displays. Complements the full description for space-constrained interfaces.

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Specific staff employment category for which this course is applicable or required. Distinguishes between national staff, international/expatriate staff, volunteers, and contractors, reflecting Ngo's workforce structure and donor compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all_staff|national_staff|international_staff|expatriate|volunteer|contractor|management — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: subject_area
attributes.description: Thematic subject area or competency domain the course addresses, aligned to Ngo's learning taxonomy (e.g., 'Safeguarding', 'WASH', 'GBV Prevention', 'Financial Stewardship', 'MEL', 'Security Management', 'ICT4D', 'Leadership'). Used for catalog browsing, skills gap analysis, and MEL reporting. Secondary CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC) Learning Standards; SPHERE Association

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated keyword tags associated with the course for search and discovery in the Workday HCM Learning catalog (e.g., 'PSEA,safeguarding,mandatory,field_staff,GBV'). Enhances catalog searchability and supports learning pathway recommendations.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the intended staff population for this course (e.g., 'All Staff', 'Field Officers', 'Senior Management', 'Finance Staff', 'Community Health Workers', 'Expatriate Staff'). Used for automated assignment rules in Workday HCM and workforce capability planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full human-readable title of the learning course as displayed in the Workday HCM Learning catalog and staff-facing portals (e.g., 'Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Foundations', 'Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Awareness'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the course record was most recently modified in the Workday HCM Learning system or the Databricks Silver Layer. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958; Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: version_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current version of the course content is effective and available for enrollment. Used to determine whether staff completions on prior versions remain valid for compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; USAID Regulations

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the course content (e.g., '1.0', '2.3', '3.0.1'). Tracks content revisions to ensure staff complete the most current version, particularly for mandatory compliance courses subject to policy updates (PSEA, CHS, safeguarding).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Staff leave request and approval record capturing leave type (annual, sick, maternity/paternity, R&R, compassionate, TOIL), requested start date, end date, number of days, approval status, approver, and actual dates taken. Tracks leave balances and entitlements per staff member and supports field rotation and R&R scheduling for humanitarian staff.

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each leave request record in the Workday HCM system. Serves as the primary key for the leave_request data product.

attributes.name: approver_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or HR officer responsible for approving or rejecting this leave request. Supports RACI role assignments and delegation of authority tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: primary_leave_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM covering national staff, international staff, and expatriate personnel.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Human Capital Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: actual_days_taken
attributes.description: Number of working days actually taken by the staff member. Populated upon return from leave and used to update leave balance entitlements. Supports half-day precision.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the staff member returned from leave. May differ from requested_end_date due to early return, extension, or operational recall.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the staff member commenced their approved leave. May differ from requested_start_date due to operational adjustments or late approvals.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the leave request lifecycle in Workday HCM. Tracks progression from initial submission through managerial review to final decision or cancellation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approver made the final approval or rejection decision on the leave request. Null if the request is still pending or in draft state.

attributes.name: approver_comments
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the approving manager or HR officer when approving, rejecting, or modifying the leave request. Supports audit trail and communication.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the leave request was cancelled or withdrawn, either by the employee or by HR. Null if the request was not cancelled.

attributes.name: carry_forward_days
attributes.description: Number of unused leave days carried forward from the previous leave year that are being applied to this request. Subject to organizational carry-forward policy limits.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The type of employment contract held by the staff member at the time of the leave request. Affects leave entitlement calculations and eligibility for certain leave types such as maternity/paternity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Human Capital Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The organizational cost center code to which the staff member's leave cost is charged. Used for fund accounting, grant financial management, and Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting; Unit4 ERP Project Accounting; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the leave request record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: duty_station_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the staff member's duty station at the time of the leave request. Determines applicable leave policy, public holiday calendar, and R&R eligibility for field staff.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; OCHA Field Operations

attributes.name: emergency_contact_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member has confirmed they can be reached in an emergency during their leave period. Particularly relevant for field staff and humanitarian response contexts.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; OCHA Field Operations

attributes.name: entitlement_days
attributes.description: Total number of days the staff member is entitled to for the applicable leave type in the current leave year, as defined by their contract, grade, and duty station policy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: handover_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member has completed a formal handover of duties and responsibilities before commencing leave. Critical for field operations continuity and program delivery.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: is_retroactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request was submitted after the leave period had already commenced or concluded (retroactive entry). Flags exceptions for HR compliance review and audit.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: is_rnr_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member is eligible for Rest and Recuperation (R&R) leave based on their duty station hardship classification. True for staff posted to hardship or non-family duty stations per OCHA/UNDSS security phase criteria.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Operations; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the leave request record, including status changes, date amendments, or approver updates.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: leave_balance_after
attributes.description: The staff member's remaining leave balance (in days) for the applicable leave type after the leave has been taken and confirmed. Updated upon return from leave.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: leave_balance_before
attributes.description: The staff member's available leave balance (in days) for the applicable leave type at the time the request was submitted. Enables entitlement validation and balance tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: leave_destination_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the staff member will spend their leave. Required for R&R and annual leave for international/expatriate staff for security tracking and travel authorization.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Field Operations; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: leave_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the staff member for the leave request. May contain sensitive personal information (e.g., medical, family). Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; GDPR Article 9; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave being requested. Covers standard humanitarian workforce leave categories: Annual (vacation), Sick, Maternity/Paternity, Rest and Recuperation (R&R) for field staff, Compassionate (bereavement/family emergency), and Time Off In Lieu (TOIL) for overtime compensation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: leave_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year to which this leave request applies (e.g., 2024). Used for annual entitlement tracking, carry-forward calculations, and year-end reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: medical_certificate_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required medical certificate has been received and verified by HR. Relevant for sick leave requests where documentation is mandatory per organizational policy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: medical_certificate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical certificate is required for this leave request based on leave type and duration policy (e.g., sick leave exceeding 3 consecutive days). Drives compliance workflow in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the program or project to which the staff member's time is allocated during the leave period. Supports grant financial management and indirect cost rate (ICR/NICRA) calculations.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Project Accounting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Structured or free-text reason provided by the approver when rejecting a leave request. Required for rejected requests to support employee relations and grievance management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the leave request (e.g., LR-2024-000123). Used in correspondence, approvals, and audit trails.

attributes.name: requested_days
attributes.description: Number of working days requested for the leave period, as submitted by the employee. Supports half-day increments (e.g., 0.5). Excludes weekends and public holidays per the applicable country calendar.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: requested_end_date
attributes.description: The date the staff member has requested their leave to end (inclusive). Combined with requested_start_date to determine the requested duration.

attributes.name: requested_start_date
attributes.description: The date the staff member has requested their leave to begin. Used for scheduling, coverage planning, and field rotation management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: rnr_cycle_days
attributes.description: The number of days between R&R breaks applicable to the staff member's duty station (e.g., 42 days, 56 days, 84 days). Determined by the hardship classification of the duty station.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Operations; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC)

attributes.name: security_clearance_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member's travel to the leave destination has been cleared by the security team. Required for international staff and field personnel traveling to or from high-risk areas.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Operations; UNDSS Security Management; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member's employment category at the time of the leave request. Determines applicable leave policy, entitlement rules, and R&R eligibility. National staff, international staff, and expatriates may have different leave frameworks.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Human Capital Management; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the staff member formally submitted the leave request in Workday HCM. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the transaction lifecycle.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: supporting_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or file path to supporting documentation attached to the leave request (e.g., medical certificate for sick leave, death certificate for compassionate leave). Stored in the document management system.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: toil_hours_accrued
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time Off In Lieu (TOIL) Hours Accrued
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours accrued by the staff member that are being converted to Time Off In Lieu (TOIL). Applicable only for TOIL leave type requests. Supports overtime compensation tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: workday_leave_request_reference
attributes.description: The native leave request identifier from the Workday HCM source system. Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.

products.name: workforce_staff_assignment
products.description: Record of a staff members assignment to a specific program, project, grant, or field operation, capturing assignment type (primary, secondary, surge deployment, TDY/temporary duty), percentage of time allocated, funding source (grant code), duty station, start date, end date, and RACI role (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed). Enables time-based payroll cost allocation to grants, supports donor-compliant effort reporting, and tracks RACI role assignments across programs for accountability matrices.

attributes.name: workforce_staff_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each staff assignment record in Workday HCM. Serves as the primary key for the staff_assignment data product.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant funding this assignment. Used for donor-compliant effort reporting and payroll cost allocation to the correct funding source per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Unit4 ERP — Grant Financial Management

attributes.name: country_office_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic duty station or field office where the staff member is deployed for this assignment. Supports field operations tracking and hardship/hazard pay calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Location; OCHA Field Operations Standards

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the humanitarian or development program to which the staff member is assigned. Enables program-level workforce planning and MEL accountability mapping.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Program Management

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Staff assignments to programs, projects, or grants should reference the organizational unit for proper cost allocation, reporting hierarchy, and matrix management visibility. While staff_assignment ha

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational position or job profile associated with this assignment in Workday HCM. Determines the role title, grade, and compensation band applicable to the assignment.

attributes.name: primary_workforce_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member record in the workforce master data. Links the assignment to the individual employee or contractor being assigned.

attributes.name: project_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific project or sub-component within a program to which the staff member is assigned. Supports project-level cost allocation and effort reporting.

attributes.name: tertiary_workforce_approved_by_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (typically HR manager or program director) who approved this assignment in Workday HCM. Supports authorization audit trails and accountability documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Approval Workflow; Internal Audit Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff assignment was formally approved through the Workday HCM business process workflow. Marks the transition from 'draft' to 'active' status and establishes the authorization audit trail.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Business Process Approval; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: assignment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this staff assignment, used in donor reports, effort certification forms, and cross-system references (e.g., ASN-2024-WASH-001). Sourced from Workday HCM assignment reference number.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Assignment Reference; IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or operational notes related to this staff assignment. May include information on acting capacity, special donor conditions, or field-specific requirements not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the staff assignment record. 'draft' indicates pending approval; 'active' indicates currently deployed; 'on_hold' indicates temporarily suspended; 'completed' indicates successfully concluded; 'cancelled' indicates terminated before completion.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Business Process Status; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the staff assignment. 'primary' indicates the main assignment; 'secondary' indicates a concurrent partial assignment; 'surge_deployment' indicates emergency response deployment; 'tdy' (Temporary Duty) indicates short-term field deployment; 'secondment' indicates inter-agency placement; 'consultant' indicates contracted technical assistance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Assignment Category; OCHA Surge Capacity Framework

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The type of employment contract governing this assignment. Determines applicable labor law protections, benefits eligibility, and termination procedures. 'fixed_term' indicates a time-bound contract; 'open_ended' indicates indefinite employment; 'short_term' indicates assignments under 6 months.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Contract Type; ILO Labour Standards; Local Labour Law Compliance

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The organizational cost center code in the Chart of Accounts (CoA) to which this assignment's payroll costs are allocated. Supports fund accounting, Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting, and indirect cost rate (ICR/NICRA) calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Chart of Accounts; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.414 (Indirect Costs)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this staff assignment record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with record-keeping requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance and IATI transparency standards.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Transparency Standard; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: duty_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the staff member is deployed for this assignment (e.g., 'SSD' for South Sudan, 'HTI' for Haiti). Used for hardship classification, tax treaty application, and OCHA country-level reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Country Operations; IATI Country Code Standard

attributes.name: effort_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment requires periodic effort certification by the staff member or supervisor (True), as mandated for federally-funded grants under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430. Drives the effort certification workflow in the GMS.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430; USAID ADS 591

attributes.name: effort_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of the staff member's total working time allocated to this specific assignment, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 50.00 for 50%). Must sum to 100% across all active assignments for a staff member. Critical for donor-compliant effort reporting and payroll cost allocation to grants per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430 (Standards for Documentation of Personnel Expenses); USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member's assignment concludes. Nullable for open-ended assignments. Used to determine assignment duration, payroll allocation periods, and grant charge eligibility windows.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Assignment End Date; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430

attributes.name: fte_equivalent
attributes.description: The full-time equivalent value of this assignment, calculated as effort_percent / 100. For example, a 50% assignment equals 0.50 FTE. Used for workforce capacity planning, budget forecasting, and donor reporting on staffing levels.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — FTE; FASB ASC 958 (Not-for-Profit Entities); IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: funding_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the funding source underwriting this assignment. Determines applicable compliance requirements: 'federal_grant' triggers OMB Uniform Guidance; 'bilateral_donor' (e.g., USAID, DFID) triggers donor-specific reporting; 'cost_share' indicates matching contribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: federal_grant|private_grant|bilateral_donor|multilateral_donor|unrestricted_funds|cost_share — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS 303; IATI Standard

attributes.name: grant_code
attributes.description: The donor-assigned grant or award code to which payroll costs for this assignment are charged. Used in the Chart of Accounts (CoA) for fund accounting and donor financial reporting. Aligns with the grant identifier in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Fund Accounting; Unit4 ERP — Grant Financial Management; FASB ASC 958-605; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: hardship_level
attributes.description: The UN/ICSC hardship classification level for the duty station of this assignment (A=normal; B=some hardship; C=hardship; D=extreme hardship; E=unaccompanied). Determines hardship allowance entitlements and R&R (Rest and Recuperation) schedules for international and expatriate staff.
attributes.references: UN International Civil Service Commission (ICSC) Hardship Classification; OCHA Field Security Standards

attributes.name: is_cost_shared
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payroll costs for this assignment are shared across multiple grants or funding sources (True). When True, the effort_percent and grant_code fields define the primary allocation, and supplementary cost-share records exist for the remaining allocation.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.306 (Cost Sharing); USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: is_field_deployment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment involves deployment to a field or humanitarian response location (True) as opposed to a headquarters or regional office posting (False). Used to trigger field-specific HR policies, security protocols, and allowance calculations.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Operations Framework; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: is_surge_deployment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment is classified as a surge deployment in response to an acute humanitarian emergency (True). Surge deployments trigger expedited onboarding, emergency per diem rates, and OCHA SitRep staffing reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Surge Capacity Framework; IASC Emergency Response Protocols

attributes.name: job_grade
attributes.description: The salary grade or band associated with this assignment, as defined in the organization's compensation framework. Used for budget planning, equity analysis, and donor reporting on staffing costs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Compensation Grade; INGO Compensation Benchmarking Standards

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title of the staff member for this specific assignment, as recorded in Workday HCM. May differ from the staff member's base position title if the assignment involves a temporary role upgrade or acting capacity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Job Profile; HRIS Standards

attributes.name: last_effort_certified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent effort certification was completed and approved for this assignment. Used to track compliance with periodic effort reporting requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance and donor agreements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430; USAID ADS 591

attributes.name: raci_role
attributes.description: The RACI role assigned to the staff member for this program or project assignment. 'responsible' indicates the person doing the work; 'accountable' indicates the person ultimately answerable for outcomes; 'consulted' indicates subject matter experts providing input; 'informed' indicates stakeholders kept up to date. Supports accountability matrices and governance documentation.
attributes.references: RACI Framework; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; IASC Accountability Framework

attributes.name: safeguarding_training_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member has completed mandatory safeguarding and protection training prior to or during this assignment (True). Required by CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard and donor compliance frameworks for all field deployments.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; Charity Commission (UK) Safeguarding; IASC PSEA (Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse) Standards

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: The security clearance level required and held by the staff member for this assignment. Relevant for assignments in conflict-affected or high-security environments. 'classified' indicates government-level clearance for assignments with bilateral donors such as USAID or DFID.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Security Framework; USAID Security Requirements; Charity Commission (UK) Safeguarding Standards

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member's employment category for this assignment. Determines applicable HR policies, compensation structures, tax treatment, and donor reporting requirements. 'expatriate' indicates internationally-recruited staff deployed outside home country; 'national_staff' indicates locally-recruited personnel.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker Type; INGO HR Standards; OCHA Humanitarian Personnel Framework

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member's assignment to the program, project, or field operation begins. Used for payroll cost allocation period calculations and effort reporting compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Assignment Effective Date; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430

attributes.name: tdy_purpose
attributes.description: Description of the business purpose for a Temporary Duty (TDY) assignment, such as 'emergency response support', 'capacity building mission', or 'program assessment'. Required for TDY travel authorization and donor reporting. Applicable only when assignment_type = 'tdy'.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Travel Authorization; USAID ADS 522 (Travel); OCHA Field Operations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this staff assignment record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Last Modified Date; Internal Audit Standards; IATI Transparency Standard

attributes.name: workday_assignment_ref
attributes.description: The source system reference identifier for this assignment record in Workday HCM. Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation, audit, and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker Assignment Reference ID

products.name: expat_package
products.description: Expatriate compensation and benefits package record for internationally-recruited staff, capturing hardship allowance tier, housing allowance, education allowance for dependents, home leave entitlement, relocation allowance, medical evacuation coverage level, and applicable INGO salary scale (e.g., UN common system, organizational scale). Distinct from national staff compensation.

attributes.name: expat_package_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the expatriate compensation and benefits package record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.award. Business justification: NGOs track which grant funds expatriate packages (housing, hardship, relocation allowances) for cost allocation and donor reporting on international staff costs. Essential for grant budget management

attributes.name: employment_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employment_contract. Business justification: Expatriate packages are contractual obligations tied to specific employment contracts. The package terms (hardship allowances, home leave entitlements, R&R cycles, housing provisions) are negotiated a

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational position associated with this expatriate package, used to determine applicable salary scale and allowance tiers.

attributes.name: primary_expat_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internationally-recruited staff member to whom this expatriate package applies. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the expatriate package was formally approved by the authorized approver. Used for compliance documentation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Business Process; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the expatriate package. 'pending' indicates awaiting review; 'approved' indicates authorized by HR and finance; 'rejected' indicates not approved; 'under_review' indicates additional scrutiny required.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Business Process Framework; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the expatriate's international assignment and this compensation package are scheduled to end. Nullable for open-ended assignments. Drives repatriation planning and benefit cessation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Assignment; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the expatriate's international assignment and this compensation package become effective. Marks the beginning of entitlement to expatriate benefits.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Assignment; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: Annual gross base salary for the expatriate staff member in the package currency, exclusive of allowances and benefits. Used for BvA (Budget versus Actual) reporting and grant financial management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Workday HCM — Compensation

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: GL (General Ledger) cost center code to which the expatriate package costs are charged in the fund accounting system. Enables BvA (Budget versus Actual) reporting and grant financial management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Cost Center; Unit4 ERP — Project Accounting; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this expatriate package record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Audit Trail; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the expatriate package amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Governs all monetary fields in this record.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative) Financial Standards

attributes.name: dependents_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health insurance and applicable benefits under this package extend to the expatriate's eligible dependents (spouse/partner and children) accompanying them to the duty station.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Dependent Coverage; INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: duty_station_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the expatriate is deployed and this package is applicable. Drives hardship tier, cost-of-living adjustments, and applicable allowances.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA (Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs) Duty Station Registry

attributes.name: duty_station_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific duty station or field office location where the expatriate is posted (e.g., Nairobi, Juba, Kabul). Used for operational reporting and SitRep (Situation Report) alignment.
attributes.references: OCHA Duty Station Registry; Workday HCM — Location

attributes.name: education_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Annual monetary value of the education allowance for dependent children of the expatriate, covering school fees and related educational costs. Applicable only when the expatriate has eligible dependents accompanying them to the duty station.
attributes.references: UN ICSC Education Grant; Workday HCM — Dependent Education Allowance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this specific version of the expatriate package is binding and in effect. May differ from assignment_start_date when a package is revised mid-assignment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Compensation Package Effective Dating; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this specific version of the expatriate package ceases to be in effect. Nullable for the current active version. Supports bi-temporal tracking of package changes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Compensation Package Effective Dating; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: employer_pension_contribution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of base salary contributed by the organization to the expatriate's pension or retirement savings scheme. Used for total compensation costing and grant budget allocation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Retirement Plan; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement)

attributes.name: grant_code
attributes.description: Code of the grant or funding source against which this expatriate package cost is allocated. Supports donor reporting, IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative) compliance, and grant financial management.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP — Grant Management; IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: hardship_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Annual monetary value of the hardship allowance payable to the expatriate, calculated based on the hardship_allowance_tier and base salary. Compensates staff for difficult living and working conditions at the duty station.
attributes.references: UN ICSC Hardship Allowance Framework; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: hardship_allowance_tier
attributes.description: UN/ICSC-aligned hardship classification tier for the duty station, ranging from H (headquarters/no hardship) through A–E (increasing hardship levels). Determines the hardship allowance percentage applied to base salary.
attributes.references: UN ICSC (International Civil Service Commission) Hardship Classification; OCHA (Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs) Duty Station Classification

attributes.name: health_insurance_plan
attributes.description: Name or code of the international health insurance plan covering the expatriate and eligible dependents, typically provided through a group scheme (e.g., Cigna Global, Aetna International, BUPA International).
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Benefit Plan; INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: home_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the expatriate's home country, used for home leave travel entitlement, tax equalization, and repatriation planning.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Workday HCM — Worker Profile; UN ICSC Home Leave Policy

attributes.name: home_leave_cycle_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of the home leave cycle, i.e., how frequently the expatriate is entitled to take home leave (e.g., every 12 or 24 months). Determines the frequency of home leave travel entitlement.
attributes.references: UN ICSC Home Leave Policy; Workday HCM — Leave Plan

attributes.name: home_leave_entitlement_days
attributes.description: Number of paid home leave days the expatriate is entitled to per leave cycle, allowing return to their home country for rest and family contact. Distinct from annual leave and R&R (Rest and Recuperation) leave.
attributes.references: UN ICSC Home Leave Entitlement; Workday HCM — Leave Plan; INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: housing_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Annual monetary value of the housing allowance provided to the expatriate to cover accommodation costs at the duty station. May be paid directly or as a cash allowance depending on organizational policy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Allowance Plan; INGO HR Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: housing_provision_type
attributes.description: Method by which housing is provided to the expatriate: 'cash_allowance' means a monetary payment; 'org_provided' means the organization arranges and pays for accommodation directly; 'shared_accommodation' means staff share organization-managed housing; 'not_applicable' for cases where housing is not part of the package.
attributes.references: INGO HR Standards; Workday HCM — Benefit Plan

attributes.name: icr_rate_pct
attributes.description: The ICR (Indirect Cost Rate) or F&A (Facilities and Administration) rate applied to this expatriate package for grant cost recovery purposes, as defined in the organization's NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement) with the US government or equivalent donor agreement.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement); USAID (United States Agency for International Development) Cost Principles

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this expatriate package record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, bi-temporal analysis, and compliance auditing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Audit Trail; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: max_eligible_dependents
attributes.description: Maximum number of dependent children eligible for the education allowance under this package, as defined by organizational policy and applicable salary scale rules.
attributes.references: UN ICSC Education Grant Rules; Workday HCM — Dependent Management

attributes.name: medevac_coverage_level
attributes.description: Level of medical evacuation coverage included in the expatriate package. 'basic' covers emergency evacuation to nearest adequate facility; 'standard' includes regional evacuation; 'enhanced' includes international evacuation; 'critical_care' includes full repatriation with specialist care.
attributes.references: SPHERE (Humanitarian Charter and Minimum Standards); CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard); INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: package_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this expatriate package record, used in HR correspondence, payroll systems, and audit documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Compensation Package; NICRA (Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement)

attributes.name: package_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the expatriate package. 'draft' indicates pending approval; 'active' indicates currently in effect; 'suspended' indicates temporarily paused; 'terminated' indicates ended before natural expiry; 'expired' indicates reached end date.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Compensation Package Lifecycle; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Classification of the expatriate package by deployment context. 'standard' applies to normal international postings; 'hardship' applies to high-risk or difficult duty stations; 'emergency' applies to rapid-onset humanitarian response deployments; 'transitional' applies to staff in between postings.
attributes.references: INGO (International Non-Governmental Organization) HR Standards; CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard) Alliance

attributes.name: pension_scheme
attributes.description: Name or code of the pension or retirement savings scheme applicable to the expatriate under this package (e.g., UN Joint Staff Pension Fund, organizational defined contribution plan). Governs employer and employee contribution rates.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Retirement Plan; FASB ASC 958; UN Joint Staff Pension Fund Rules

attributes.name: relocation_allowance_amount
attributes.description: One-time monetary allowance provided to the expatriate to cover costs associated with relocating to the duty station, including shipping of personal effects, travel, and settling-in expenses.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Relocation Plan; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: repatriation_allowance_amount
attributes.description: One-time monetary allowance provided to the expatriate upon end of assignment to cover costs of returning to their home country, including shipping and travel expenses.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Relocation Plan; UN ICSC Repatriation Grant; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: rnr_cycle_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the R&R (Rest and Recuperation) cycle applicable to this package. Defines how frequently the expatriate is entitled to R&R breaks from hardship duty stations. Typically 6, 8, or 12 weeks depending on hardship tier.
attributes.references: UN ICSC R&R Framework; OCHA Duty Station Classification; Workday HCM — Leave Plan

attributes.name: salary_grade
attributes.description: The grade or band within the applicable salary scale assigned to this expatriate position (e.g., P3, G6, Band D). Determines base salary range and step progression.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Compensation Grade; UN Common System Grade Structure

attributes.name: salary_scale
attributes.description: The applicable salary scale framework governing base compensation for this expatriate, e.g., UN Common System, organizational scale, ICSC (International Civil Service Commission) scale, or donor-mandated scale. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: un_common_system|organizational_scale|icsc_scale|ngo_network_scale|donor_mandated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UN Common System Salary Scales; ICSC (International Civil Service Commission); USAID (United States Agency for International Development) Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: salary_step
attributes.description: The step within the salary grade reflecting years of experience and incremental progression (e.g., Step 1, Step 5). Used in conjunction with salary_grade to determine exact base salary.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Compensation Step; UN Common System Step Progression

attributes.name: tax_equalization_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tax equalization policy applies to this expatriate package, ensuring the staff member pays no more or less tax than they would in their home country. Common for internationally-recruited staff on global mobility assignments.
attributes.references: IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; INGO HR Standards; Workday HCM — Tax Equalization

attributes.name: tax_equalization_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the home country used as the reference jurisdiction for tax equalization calculations. Determines the hypothetical tax liability benchmark.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: workday_package_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this expatriate package record in Workday HCM, used for data lineage, reconciliation, and integration with the HRIS (Human Resource Information System).

products.name: disciplinary_case
products.description: Record of a formal disciplinary, grievance, or safeguarding investigation case involving a staff member. Captures case type (misconduct, PSEA/SEA violation, fraud, harassment, bullying, performance), case reference number, complainant type (anonymous, named, self-referral), investigation start and end dates, investigator assignment, investigation outcome, sanctions applied (warning, suspension, termination, referral to authorities), appeal status, and case closure date. Supports CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard) accountability obligations, IASC safeguarding compliance, and mandatory donor incident reporting.
products.reference: Workday HCM Employee Relations / CHS Accountability

attributes.name: disciplinary_case_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the disciplinary, grievance, or safeguarding investigation case record in the Workday HCM and case management system.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; IASC Safeguarding Policy

attributes.name: compliance_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.incident. Business justification: Disciplinary cases are often compliance incidents (fraud, misconduct, safeguarding violations requiring donor/regulatory reporting). Links HR disciplinary process to compliance incident management for

attributes.name: primary_disciplinary_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who is the subject of the disciplinary or safeguarding case. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: tertiary_disciplinary_investigator_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member or external investigator assigned as the lead investigator for the case. May be an internal HR/legal officer or an externally contracted investigator for PSEA/SEA cases.
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subject employee formally lodged an appeal against the investigation outcome or sanction. Null if no appeal was filed.

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appeal was formally resolved and a final determination was communicated to the subject employee. Null if no appeal was filed or appeal is still pending.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any appeal lodged by the subject employee against the investigation outcome or sanction applied. Tracks whether an appeal has been filed, is pending review, or has been resolved.
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5; DFID Safeguarding Standards

attributes.name: authority_referral_date
attributes.description: The date on which the case was formally referred to external law enforcement or regulatory authorities. Null if no referral was made.
attributes.references: Charity Commission (UK) Serious Incident Reporting; IRS 501(c)(3) Governance; IASC Safeguarding Policy

attributes.name: beneficiary_involved
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the alleged incident involved a program beneficiary, Person of Concern (PoC), or Internally Displaced Person (IDP) as a victim or witness. Cases involving beneficiaries trigger heightened safeguarding protocols and mandatory PSEA reporting.
attributes.references: IASC PSEA Policy; CHS Commitment 5; USAID ADS 303; OCHA Safeguarding Framework

attributes.name: case_closed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the disciplinary case was formally closed, including completion of any sanctions, appeals, or referrals. Distinct from investigation_end_date as post-investigation actions may extend the case.
attributes.references: CHS Commitment 5; IASC Safeguarding Policy; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: case_opened_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal disciplinary or safeguarding case was officially opened and registered in the case management system. This is the principal business event date for the case lifecycle.
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5; USAID Mandatory Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: case_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to the case at intake, reflecting urgency of investigation based on severity of allegation, vulnerability of parties involved, and operational risk. Critical priority cases (e.g., PSEA involving beneficiaries) require immediate escalation.
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: case_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference code assigned to the disciplinary case at initiation, used in all correspondence, donor incident reports, and regulatory filings. Format: [ORG_CODE]-DISC-[YEAR]-[SEQUENCE].
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; USAID Mandatory Disclosure Requirements; DFID Safeguarding Standards

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the disciplinary case workflow, from initial opening through investigation, outcome determination, appeal, and final closure.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; IASC Safeguarding Policy; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: case_summary
attributes.description: A concise narrative description of the allegation or complaint, capturing the nature of the incident, parties involved, and context. Restricted to authorized HR, legal, and senior management personnel.
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: case_type
attributes.description: Classification of the disciplinary case by the nature of the alleged violation. PSEA/SEA (Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse) violations are subject to mandatory donor reporting under USAID and DFID requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: misconduct|psea_sea_violation|fraud|harassment|bullying|performance|whistleblower_retaliation|conflict_of_interest|data_breach — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IASC PSEA Policy; CHS Commitment 5; USAID ADS 303; DFID Safeguarding Standards; IRS 501(c)(3)

attributes.name: charity_commission_reported
attributes.business_glossary_term: Charity Commission Serious Incident Reported Flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this case was reported to the Charity Commission (UK) as a Serious Incident, as required for registered UK charities when incidents involve significant harm, financial loss, or reputational risk.
attributes.references: Charity Commission (UK) Serious Incident Reporting; Charities Act 2011 (UK)

attributes.name: chs_commitment_reference
attributes.description: The specific CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard) commitment number(s) relevant to this case, used for CHS verification and accountability reporting. Typically Commitment 5 (Complaints and Feedback) or Commitment 6 (Coordination).
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; CHS Verification Scheme

attributes.name: complainant_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the complaint or allegation was submitted, indicating whether the complainant is anonymous, named, self-referred, a third party, or referred by management. Informs confidentiality protocols and investigation approach.
attributes.references: HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard; CHS Commitment 5; IASC Safeguarding Policy

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: The designated confidentiality classification of this case record, determining access controls and information sharing protocols. PSEA/SEA cases are typically strictly confidential with access limited to named individuals.
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5; GDPR Article 9; Charity Commission (UK)

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The type of employment contract held by the subject employee at the time of the case. Determines applicable disciplinary procedures, notice periods, and legal obligations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this disciplinary case record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: donor_report_reference
attributes.description: The reference number or tracking code assigned by the donor or funding body upon receipt of the mandatory incident report. Used for cross-referencing with grant management and compliance records.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; DFID Safeguarding Standards; CERF Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: donor_report_submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the mandatory donor incident report was submitted to the relevant funding body. Null if no donor report is required or has not yet been submitted. Used to track compliance with donor reporting deadlines.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; DFID Safeguarding Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: duty_station_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the duty station where the subject employee was deployed at the time of the alleged incident. Used for geographic analysis of safeguarding trends and country-level compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; OCHA Safeguarding Framework; IATI Standard

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: The date on which the alleged misconduct, violation, or incident is reported to have occurred. May differ from the case opened date if there was a reporting delay.
attributes.references: IASC PSEA Policy; CHS Commitment 5; Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: investigation_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal investigation was concluded and findings were documented. Used to calculate investigation duration and compliance with timeliness standards.
attributes.references: CHS Commitment 5; IASC Safeguarding Policy; DFID Safeguarding Standards

attributes.name: investigation_findings_summary
attributes.description: A concise narrative summary of the key findings from the investigation, documenting evidence reviewed, witness accounts, and the basis for the investigation outcome determination.
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: investigation_outcome
attributes.description: The formal finding of the investigation indicating whether the allegation was substantiated (proven), unsubstantiated (not proven), inconclusive (insufficient evidence), withdrawn by complainant, or closed with no further action.
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5; USAID ADS 303; DFID Safeguarding Standards

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal investigation commenced, following case registration and initial triage. Used to measure investigation timeliness against CHS and donor-mandated SLA targets.
attributes.references: CHS Commitment 5; IASC Safeguarding Policy; USAID Mandatory Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: irs_form_990_reportable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this disciplinary case involves a matter that must be disclosed on IRS Form 990 (e.g., diversion of assets, fraud, or governance failures) for US-registered 501(c)(3) organizations.
attributes.references: IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; IRS Form 990 Instructions; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: is_external_investigator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the investigation was conducted by an external independent investigator rather than internal HR or legal staff. External investigators are typically required for PSEA/SEA cases or senior staff misconduct.
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5; USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: is_mandatory_donor_report_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Mandatory Donor Incident Report Required Flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this case triggers a mandatory donor incident reporting obligation to a funding body such as USAID (BHA), DFID, CERF, or other institutional donors per grant agreement terms.
attributes.references: USAID ADS 303; DFID Safeguarding Standards; CERF Reporting Requirements; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: is_psea_case
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Case Flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this case involves a Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) or Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA) allegation, triggering mandatory donor incident reporting obligations under USAID, DFID, and OCHA protocols.
attributes.references: IASC PSEA Policy; USAID ADS 303; DFID Safeguarding Standards; OCHA Safeguarding Framework

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this disciplinary case record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: The program or project code associated with the duty station or operational context in which the incident occurred. Used to link disciplinary cases to program accountability and MEL (Monitoring Evaluation and Learning) reporting.
attributes.references: IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Unit4 ERP Project Accounting

attributes.name: referred_to_authorities
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the case was referred to external law enforcement, national authorities, or regulatory bodies (e.g., Charity Commission UK, IRS, local police) as part of the disciplinary outcome.
attributes.references: Charity Commission (UK) Serious Incident Reporting; IRS 501(c)(3) Governance; IASC Safeguarding Policy

attributes.name: sanction_applied
attributes.description: The disciplinary sanction or corrective action applied to the subject employee following a substantiated investigation outcome. Null if outcome is unsubstantiated or inconclusive. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: verbal_warning|written_warning|final_written_warning|suspension|termination|referral_to_authorities|demotion|mandatory_training|no_sanction — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5; USAID Mandatory Disclosure Requirements; IRS 501(c)(3) Governance

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Employment category of the subject employee at the time of the case, distinguishing between international staff, national staff, expatriates, consultants, volunteers, and interns. Affects applicable HR policies and legal jurisdiction.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee suspension ended, either through reinstatement, termination, or case resolution. Null when no suspension was applied.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which a precautionary or punitive suspension of the subject employee commenced, if applicable. Null when no suspension was applied.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; IASC Safeguarding Policy; CHS Commitment 5

attributes.name: workday_case_reference
attributes.description: The source system identifier for this disciplinary case record in Workday HCM, used for data lineage, reconciliation, and integration with the HRIS system of record.

products.name: separation_event
products.description: Record of a staff member's separation from Ngo, capturing separation type (resignation, end of contract, redundancy, termination, retirement, death in service), effective date, notice period served, exit interview completion, final settlement amount, and rehire eligibility. Supports workforce attrition analysis and talent retention tracking.

attributes.name: separation_event_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each staff separation event record in Workday HCM. Primary key for the separation_event data product.

attributes.name: deprovisioned_user_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.user_account. Business justification: Links separation events to deprovisioned user accounts. Security and compliance requirement for audit trails, access control verification, and demonstrating timely account deactivation. Critical for d

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational position being vacated as a result of this separation event, used for workforce planning and backfill tracking.

attributes.name: primary_separation_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who is separating from Ngo. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the separation event was formally approved by the authorized HR approver in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: asset_return_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the departing staff member has returned all Ngo assets (laptop, phone, ID card, vehicle keys, field equipment) prior to or on the effective separation date.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Offboarding Checklist; Ngo Asset Management Policy

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The type of employment contract held by the staff member at the time of separation. Determines applicable notice periods, severance entitlements, and end-of-service benefit calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract Type; ILO Convention No. 158

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The financial cost center code associated with the staff member's position at the time of separation. Used for allocating separation costs (severance, PILON) to the correct budget line in SAP S/4HANA fund accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the separation event record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The organizational department or cost center code to which the staff member was assigned at the time of separation. Used for departmental attrition reporting and budget impact analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization; SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts (CoA)

attributes.name: duty_station_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the duty station where the staff member was deployed at the time of separation. Supports geographic attrition analysis and repatriation cost tracking for international staff.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Country Codes; Workday HCM Location

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the staff member's employment with Ngo ends. Used as the principal business event date for payroll cutoff, benefit termination, access revocation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Last Day of Work; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: exit_interview_conducted_by
attributes.description: Name or role of the HR staff member or manager who conducted the exit interview. Supports accountability tracking for the offboarding process.

attributes.name: exit_interview_date
attributes.description: The date on which the exit interview was conducted with the departing staff member. Null if exit interview was not completed or not required.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Offboarding; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: exit_interview_status
attributes.description: Tracks the completion status of the exit interview process for the departing staff member. Exit interview data feeds talent retention analysis and MEL (Monitoring Evaluation and Learning) workforce indicators.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Offboarding Checklist; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard (Staff Wellbeing)

attributes.name: final_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The total gross monetary amount paid to the staff member as part of the final settlement, including severance pay, payment in lieu of notice (PILON), accrued leave encashment, and end-of-service gratuity. Expressed in the settlement currency.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Final Pay; SAP S/4HANA Payroll; FASB ASC 420; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: grant_code
attributes.description: The grant or funding source code against which the staff member's salary was charged at the time of separation. Required for donor reporting on staff costs and compliance with grant closeout procedures under OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Reporting Standard

attributes.name: is_notice_served_in_full
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member served the full contractually required notice period. False triggers calculation of payment in lieu of notice (PILON) in final settlement.

attributes.name: job_grade
attributes.description: The salary grade or band of the staff member at the time of separation. Used for attrition analysis by grade level and benchmarking against sector compensation standards.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; INGO Compensation Benchmarking

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title held by the staff member at the time of separation. Preserved as a historical snapshot for workforce attrition analysis by role and grade.

attributes.name: knowledge_transfer_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the departing staff member completed the required knowledge transfer and handover activities prior to their last working date. Supports program continuity and field operations risk management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Offboarding Checklist; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the separation event record was most recently modified in the system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change data capture in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: last_working_date
attributes.description: The actual final day the staff member performed work duties at Ngo. May differ from effective_date when garden leave or paid notice is applied.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Last Day of Work

attributes.name: leave_encashment_days
attributes.description: The number of accrued but unused annual leave days encashed as part of the final settlement. Feeds into the leave encashment payment calculation and leave liability reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Balance; Ngo Leave Policy; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: notice_period_days_required
attributes.description: The contractually required notice period in calendar days as stipulated in the staff member's employment contract or Ngo HR policy.
attributes.references: Employment Contract; Ngo HR Policy; ILO Termination of Employment Convention No. 158

attributes.name: notice_period_days_served
attributes.description: The actual number of calendar days of notice served by the separating staff member or Ngo. Used to determine if notice was served in full or if payment in lieu of notice (PILON) applies.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; ILO Termination of Employment Convention No. 158

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member or Ngo formally notified the other party of the intended separation. Used to calculate notice period served and assess contractual compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Date; Employment Contract Standards

attributes.name: original_hire_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member was first hired by Ngo. Preserved as a historical snapshot on the separation record for service length calculations and end-of-service benefit determination.

attributes.name: primary_departure_reason
attributes.description: The staff member's self-reported primary reason for leaving Ngo as captured during the exit interview. Confidential narrative used for talent retention analysis and workforce strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: compensation|career_growth|management|workload|security|relocation|family|health|better_opportunity|end_of_funding|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Exit Survey; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard (Staff Wellbeing)

attributes.name: rehire_eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether the former staff member is eligible for future re-employment at Ngo. Ineligible status is typically set for terminations due to misconduct, safeguarding violations, or fraud. Critical for talent acquisition screening.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Rehire Eligibility; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard (Safeguarding); Ngo HR Policy

attributes.name: rehire_ineligibility_reason
attributes.description: Confidential narrative reason explaining why a former staff member has been flagged as ineligible for rehire. Populated only when rehire_eligibility is 'ineligible' or 'eligible_with_conditions'. Supports safeguarding due diligence.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard (Safeguarding); Ngo HR Policy

attributes.name: repatriation_destination_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country to which the international staff member is being repatriated upon separation. Used for travel cost estimation and logistics planning.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; INGO International Staff Policy

attributes.name: repatriation_entitlement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the separating staff member is entitled to repatriation support (travel, shipment of personal effects) under Ngo's international staff policy. Applicable primarily to expatriate and international staff categories.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; INGO International Staff Policy; UN Common System Conditions of Service

attributes.name: safeguarding_clearance_status
attributes.description: Indicates the safeguarding clearance status of the staff member at the time of separation. Ensures compliance with CHS Core Humanitarian Standard obligations and prevents re-employment of individuals with unresolved safeguarding concerns.
attributes.references: CHS Core Humanitarian Standard (Safeguarding); HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership); Ngo Safeguarding Policy

attributes.name: separation_reason_code
attributes.description: Granular reason code for the separation as configured in Workday HCM (e.g., VOL-BETTER-OPPORTUNITY, VOL-PERSONAL, INV-MISCONDUCT, INV-PERFORMANCE). Supports detailed attrition root-cause analysis and donor/grant reporting on workforce stability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vol_better_opportunity|vol_personal|vol_relocation|inv_misconduct|inv_performance|inv_redundancy|eoc_project_end|eoc_funding_end|retirement_age|death_in_service — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Reason; HRIS Best Practice

attributes.name: separation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the separation business process in Workday HCM. Tracks whether the offboarding process has been initiated, is in progress, approved by HR, completed, or cancelled.

attributes.name: separation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reason for the staff member's departure from Ngo. Drives attrition analytics, legal obligations, and final settlement calculations. Values: resignation, end_of_contract, redundancy, termination, retirement, death_in_service.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Category; FASB ASC 420 (Exit or Disposal Cost Obligations); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the currency in which the final settlement amount is denominated. Supports multi-currency financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: severance_pay_amount
attributes.description: The gross severance pay component of the final settlement, calculated based on years of service and applicable HR policy or statutory requirements. Distinct from PILON and leave encashment components.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Severance; FASB ASC 420; ILO Convention No. 158; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the separating staff member's employment category at the time of separation. Drives differential separation entitlements, repatriation obligations, and attrition reporting by staff tier.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; INGO HR Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: system_access_revoked
