attributes.description: Indicates whether all IT system access (email, ERP, CRM, HRIS, field data systems) has been revoked for the departing staff member. Critical for information security compliance and data protection obligations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Offboarding; GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation); ISO 27001 Access Control

attributes.name: workday_termination_reference
attributes.description: The native business process instance identifier assigned by Workday HCM for the termination event, used for system-of-record traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: years_of_service
attributes.description: Total length of continuous service with Ngo at the time of separation, expressed in years with decimal precision. Used to calculate end-of-service gratuity, severance entitlements, and long-service recognition.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Service Date; ILO Convention No. 158; Employment Contract

products.name: staff_certification
products.description: Record of professional certifications, licenses, and mandatory clearances held by a staff member, including certification name, issuing body, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, and whether the certification is required for the current role (e.g., security clearance, medical fitness certificate, driving license, professional accreditation). Supports field deployment eligibility checks.

attributes.name: staff_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each staff certification record in the Workday HCM system. Primary key for the staff_certification data product.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Certifications fulfill specific compliance obligations (mandatory safeguarding training, professional licenses, donor-required credentials). Enables tracking which obligations are satisfied by which c

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who holds this certification. Links to the workforce staff/employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: attempt_number
attributes.description: The sequential attempt number for this certification, where a staff member may have taken the certification examination or training multiple times. Supports tracking of re-certification attempts.

attributes.name: certification_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code or reference number for the certification type, used for classification and reporting (e.g., 'HEAT', 'PSEA-101', 'CHS-CERT', 'SAFEGUARD-CLR').
attributes.references: Workday HCM Credentials and Licenses Module; IATI Organizational Standards

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the professional certification, license, or mandatory clearance (e.g., 'Hostile Environment and First Aid Training', 'SPHERE Humanitarian Standards Certificate', 'USAID Mandatory Reporting Training', 'Driving License Class B').
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS); Sphere Association

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate or license number assigned by the issuing body. Used for verification and compliance audits. Treated as confidential business data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Credentials and Licenses Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification record. Indicates whether the certification is currently active and valid, expired, suspended by the issuing body, revoked, or pending verification of submitted documents.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Credentials and Licenses Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Category of the certification or clearance. Classifies whether it is a professional accreditation, a mandatory organizational clearance, a statutory license, a medical fitness certificate, a security clearance, or a safeguarding compliance credential. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: professional_accreditation|mandatory_clearance|license|medical_fitness|security_clearance|safeguarding|driving|language_proficiency — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); Workday HCM Credentials Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: The monetary cost incurred by the organization for the staff member to obtain this certification, including training fees, examination fees, and associated costs. Used for budget tracking and donor cost allocation.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958 Not-for-Profit Entities; Unit4 ERP Project Accounting

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The organizational cost center code to which the certification cost is charged. Aligns with the Chart of Accounts (CoA) in SAP S/4HANA or Unit4 ERP for fund accounting and grant cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fund Accounting; Unit4 ERP Project Accounting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the certification cost amount (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Required for multi-currency financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 958 Not-for-Profit Entities; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 Not-for-Profit Entities; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: document_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the physical or digital copy of the certification document was received by the HR department for filing and verification.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Credentials and Licenses Module

attributes.name: document_ref
attributes.description: Reference path, URL, or document management system identifier pointing to the scanned copy or digital file of the certification document stored in the organization's document repository.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Document Storage; IATI Transparency Standards

attributes.name: donor_requirement_ref
attributes.description: Reference code or name of the donor agreement, grant, or compliance framework that mandates this certification (e.g., 'USAID-APS-2023-001', 'BHA-PSEA-MANDATORY'). Populated only when is_donor_required is True.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Award Terms and Conditions; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: duty_station_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the staff member's duty station at the time the certification was obtained or is required. Supports country-specific compliance and field deployment eligibility checks.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Field Operations Standards; IATI Country Codes

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification, license, or clearance expires and is no longer valid. Null if the certification has no expiry (e.g., lifetime accreditation). Critical for field deployment eligibility checks.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Credentials and Licenses Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: grant_code
attributes.description: The grant or award code against which the certification cost is charged, where training is funded by a specific donor grant. Supports donor compliance reporting and BvA (Budget versus Actual) tracking.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID BHA Award Terms; Unit4 ERP Grant Management

attributes.name: is_donor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is mandated by a specific donor or grant agreement as a condition of staff deployment on funded programs (e.g., USAID BHA mandatory training requirements, DFID safeguarding certifications).
attributes.references: USAID BHA Compliance Requirements; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; DFID Smart Rules

attributes.name: is_field_deployment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is specifically required for field deployment eligibility (e.g., HEAT training, medical fitness certificate, security clearance). Drives automated deployment eligibility checks in field operations.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Safety Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: is_pass
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member passed the certification assessment or examination. True = passed; False = failed or did not meet the required standard.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: is_role_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is a mandatory requirement for the staff member's current position or role. True = required for role; False = voluntary or supplementary. Used in field deployment eligibility checks and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Qualifications; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification, license, or clearance was officially issued or awarded by the issuing body.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Credentials and Licenses Module

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization, authority, or institution that issued the certification or license (e.g., 'USAID Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance', 'Sphere Association', 'National Medical Council', 'DVLA', 'CHS Alliance').
attributes.references: IATI Organizational Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance (CHS)

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country in which the certification was issued. Relevant for statutory licenses and country-specific clearances.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this certification record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and Silver Layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 Not-for-Profit Entities; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for HR officers to record additional context, exceptions, waiver justifications, or operational notes related to this certification record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Credentials and Licenses Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: reminder_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent automated renewal reminder notification was sent to the staff member and/or their line manager via the HRIS or notification system.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Credentials and Licenses Module

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the staff member must initiate or complete the renewal process to maintain continuous validity of the certification. May precede the expiry date to allow processing lead time.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Credentials and Licenses Module; CHS Alliance Compliance Standards

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the certification renewal process. Tracks whether renewal is not yet due, currently in progress, submitted for review, successfully renewed, lapsed due to non-renewal, or formally waived.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Credentials and Licenses Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: score_or_grade
attributes.description: The score, grade, or result achieved by the staff member in the certification examination or assessment (e.g., 'Pass', 'Distinction', '87%', 'Competent'). Null if the certification is pass/fail without a graded result.

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member's employment category at the time of certification. Relevant for determining applicable certification requirements and compliance obligations by staff type.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Classification; OCHA Humanitarian Workforce Standards; IATI Organizational Standards

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member completed the training course or examination that led to the award of this certification. May differ from the official issue date.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; LMS (Learning Management System) Standards

attributes.name: training_delivery_mode
attributes.description: The modality through which the training leading to this certification was delivered. Supports ICT4D (Information and Communication Technology for Development) analytics and LMS reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; ICT4D (Information and Communication Technology for Development) Standards

attributes.name: training_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours of training completed to obtain this certification. Used for workforce learning and development reporting and donor compliance reporting on staff capacity building.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: training_location_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the training was conducted. Relevant for field-based and in-country training programs.

attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; LMS (Learning Management System) Standards

attributes.name: verification_date

attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); Workday HCM Credentials Module

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the organization's verification of the certification's authenticity with the issuing body. Unverified = document received but not yet checked; Verified = confirmed authentic; Verification_failed = could not be confirmed; Not_required = verification waived per policy.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standards; Charity Commission UK

attributes.name: verified_by

attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: workday_credential_reference

products.name: timesheet
products.description: Time tracking record for staff members capturing hours worked per day, project/grant allocation of time, overtime, and approval status. Essential for donor-compliant cost allocation where multiple grants fund a single position, and for tracking field staff working hours in hardship locations with TOIL (Time Off In Lieu) accrual. Supports BvA reporting and audit-ready grant charging.

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the timesheet record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who approved this timesheet. Typically the employee's direct supervisor or program manager with budget authority.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary grant or funding source to which these hours are charged. Critical for donor-compliant cost allocation and Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Cost Allocation

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the program under which the work was performed. Supports program-level cost tracking and Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL) reporting.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll run in which these hours were processed for payment. Links timesheet to payroll for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: project_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific project or activity within a program to which time is allocated. Enables project-level cost tracking and Results-Based Management (RBM).

attributes.name: timesheet_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who submitted this timesheet. Links to the staff_member product.

attributes.name: activity_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the work activities performed during the reported time. Provides narrative context for audit and program management review.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Time and Effort Documentation

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the timesheet was approved by the authorized approver. Null if not yet approved.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Time and Effort Reporting

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the timesheet was approved. Critical for audit compliance and payroll cutoff determination.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Time and Effort Reporting

attributes.name: approver_comments
attributes.description: Optional comments or notes provided by the approver during the approval process. Used for clarifications, conditions, or audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of employment contract under which the work was performed. Affects eligibility for overtime, TOIL, and other benefits.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial accounting code representing the organizational unit or department responsible for the cost. Used for general ledger posting and budget control.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this timesheet record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: duty_station_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the work was performed. Critical for field operations tracking and hardship allowance calculation.

attributes.name: duty_station_name
attributes.description: Name of the duty station or field office where the work was performed. Used for geographic reporting and field operations management.

attributes.name: effort_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timesheet entry requires formal effort certification per donor requirements. True for US federal grants and other donors requiring periodic effort certification.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Effort Certification

attributes.name: effort_certified_date
attributes.description: The date when the employee formally certified that the reported effort allocation is accurate. Required for compliance with federal grant regulations.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Effort Certification

attributes.name: effort_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of total work effort allocated to this grant or project for the reporting period. Sum of effort_percent across all grants for a given period should equal 100% for cost-shared positions.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Effort Certification

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the labor cost will be posted. Typically represents salary or personnel expense categories.

attributes.name: grant_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the grant to which time is charged. Used for financial reporting and grant management system integration.

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked on the specified work_date. Includes regular hours, overtime, and any other compensable time.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hours are billable to a donor or grant. True for direct program work, false for indirect or administrative activities.

attributes.name: is_cost_shared
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timesheet entry represents a cost-shared position where a single employee's time is funded by multiple grants. True if multiple grants fund this position.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Cost Sharing

attributes.name: is_field_deployment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work was performed during a field deployment or surge assignment. True for field-based work, false for headquarters or remote work.

attributes.name: is_grant_chargeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hours can be charged to a specific grant. True for allowable direct costs, false for unallowable or indirect costs.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Allowable Costs

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this timesheet record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond the standard working hours, eligible for overtime compensation per labor law and employment contract terms.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the time reporting period covered by this timesheet. Must be greater than or equal to period_start_date.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Time and Effort Reporting

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the time reporting period covered by this timesheet. Typically aligned with payroll cycles (weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly).
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Time and Effort Reporting

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the program. Used for cross-system reporting and program performance tracking.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of standard working hours within the employee's normal schedule. Typically up to 8 hours per day or 40 hours per week for full-time staff.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: The date when the timesheet was rejected by the approver. Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver for why the timesheet was rejected. Required when timesheet_status is rejected.

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member for this timesheet entry. Determines applicable labor policies, compensation rules, and donor reporting requirements.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date when the employee submitted the timesheet for approval. Null if timesheet is still in draft status.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the employee submitted the timesheet for approval. Used for audit trail and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: timesheet_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the timesheet, typically formatted as TS-YYYY-NNNN or similar convention.

attributes.name: timesheet_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the timesheet in the approval workflow. Determines whether hours are eligible for payroll processing and grant charging.

attributes.name: toil_hours_accrued
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time Off In Lieu (TOIL) Hours Accrued
attributes.description: Number of hours accrued as Time Off In Lieu for field staff working in hardship locations. Alternative to overtime pay, allowing compensatory time off.
attributes.references: Internal TOIL Policy for Field Staff

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The specific calendar date on which the work hours were performed. Must fall within the period_start_date and period_end_date range.

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of where the work was physically performed. Used for remote work tracking, field allowance eligibility, and operational reporting.

attributes.name: workday_timesheet_reference
attributes.description: External identifier from Workday HCM system for this timesheet record. Used for system reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: amended_timesheet_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on timesheet (amended_timesheet_id)

products.name: campaign_media_outreach
products.description: This association product represents the media relations activity between advocacy campaigns and media contacts. It captures the proactive outreach, engagement tracking, and relationship management that communications teams perform when engaging journalists and media influencers for specific campaigns. Each record links one advocacy campaign to one media contact with attributes that track the engagement lifecycle, response outcomes, and follow-up activities.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit communications operations, media relations teams actively manage which journalists and media contacts to engage for each advocacy campaign. A single campaign requires outreach to multiple media contacts (regional journalists, national outlets, specialized beat reporters), and a single media contact is engaged across multiple campaigns over time. The relationship is operationally managed with tracking of engagement dates, response outcomes, coverage types, and follow-up requirements.

products.name: governance_policy

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the statutory registration expires and requires renewal. Null for registrations with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: foreign_operations_permitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this registration permits the organization to conduct operations or provide services outside the jurisdiction of registration. True if foreign operations are permitted; False if restricted to domestic operations only.

attributes.name: foundation_status
attributes.description: Classification of the organization as a public charity or type of private foundation. Relevant for US 501(c)(3) organizations.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the jurisdiction where the organization is registered (e.g., USA, GBR, KEN).

attributes.name: last_filing_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory filing or report submitted under this registration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this statutory registration record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_filing_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next regulatory filing or report is due to maintain compliance with this registration.

attributes.name: next_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next renewal application or filing must be submitted to maintain active registration status.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or contextual information about this statutory registration.

attributes.name: operating_authority_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this registration grants legal authority to operate programs and services in the jurisdiction. True if operating authority is granted; False if registration is for tax or reporting purposes only.

attributes.name: public_charity_classification
attributes.description: IRS public charity classification under Section 509(a). 509(a)(1) for publicly supported organizations; 509(a)(2) for organizations receiving substantial support from program service revenue; 509(a)(3) for supporting organizations; Private Foundation if not qualifying as public charity; Not Applicable for non-US registrations.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the official registered address on file with the statutory authority.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the official registered address (suite, floor, building name, etc.).

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registered_legal_name
attributes.description: The official legal name of the organization as registered with the statutory authority. This is the name that appears on the determination letter or registration certificate.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the statutory registration was officially granted or approved by the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: registration_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the scanned copy of the official registration certificate, determination letter, or registration document.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number or identifier issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., EIN for US 501(c)(3), Charity Commission registration number).

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the statutory registration. Active indicates valid and in good standing; Pending indicates application submitted but not yet approved; Suspended indicates temporary hold; Revoked indicates permanently cancelled; Expired indicates past validity period; Lapsed indicates not renewed.

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Type of statutory registration. Examples: 501(c)(3) for US tax-exempt status, Charity Commission for UK charities, NGO Registration for country-level registrations, Foreign Agent for FARA compliance, CSO (Civil Society Organization) Registration, INGO (International Non-Governmental Organization) Registration.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the government agency or regulatory body that issued and oversees this registration (e.g., Internal Revenue Service, Charity Commission for England and Wales, Ministry of Social Affairs).

attributes.name: renewal_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the statutory registration must be renewed. Not applicable for registrations that do not require renewal.

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this registration requires periodic renewal. True if renewal is required; False if registration is indefinite or does not require renewal.

attributes.name: reporting_requirement_description
attributes.description: Description of the periodic reporting obligations associated with this registration (e.g., annual Form 990 filing, Charity Commission annual return, quarterly financial reports).

attributes.name: tax_exempt_status
attributes.description: Tax exemption status granted under this registration. Exempt indicates full tax-exempt status; Non-exempt indicates no tax exemption; Conditional indicates exemption with specific conditions; Pending indicates exemption application under review.

products.name: internal_review
products.description: Transactional record of internal compliance reviews, spot checks, and programmatic audits conducted by the compliance or internal audit function. Captures review type (financial spot check, procurement review, programmatic compliance, data protection audit, COI certification review), review scope, country office or program reviewed, review period, lead reviewer, findings count by severity, overall compliance rating, and follow-up actions required. Distinct from external Single Audits — these are internally initiated compliance assurance activities that verify ongoing adherence to policies, donor requirements, and corrective action plan closure.
products.reference: Internal Audit Charter / Donor Compliance Review Framework

attributes.name: internal_review_id
attributes.description: Primary key for internal_review

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the grant or award being reviewed for compliance. Nullable if the review is not grant-specific.

attributes.name: compliance_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.incident. Business justification: Compliance incidents often trigger internal reviews to investigate the incident, determine root cause, and assess impact. One internal review investigates one primary incident; one incident may trigge

attributes.name: country_office_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the country office or field location that is the subject of this compliance review.

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific program or project under review. Nullable if the review is office-wide rather than program-specific.

attributes.name: primary_internal_user_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who created this compliance review record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: reviewed_system_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.system_platform. Business justification: Internal compliance reviews examine specific systems for regulatory compliance, data quality, and control effectiveness. Nonprofits must link reviews to systems for finding attribution, remediation tr

attributes.name: security_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.security_assessment. Business justification: Internal compliance reviews often trigger or reference security assessments for systems handling sensitive data (beneficiary PII, financial data). Nonprofits coordinate these for integrated assurance,

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member or auditor who led the compliance review. Links to workforce or staff master data.

attributes.name: compliance_framework_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific compliance framework, policy, or regulation against which the review was conducted (e.g., OMB 2 CFR 200, CHS, organizational policy number).
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); Internal Policy Framework

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which management must submit a corrective action plan addressing the review findings. Nullable if no corrective action is required.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether corrective action is required as a result of the review findings. True if management must implement remediation actions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance review record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of critical-severity findings identified during the review. Critical findings represent significant control failures or compliance violations requiring immediate action.

attributes.name: donor_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the donor or funding agency was formally notified of the review findings. Nullable if notification is not required.

attributes.name: donor_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the donor or funding agency must be notified of the review findings. True for material findings affecting grant compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Donor Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: external_auditor_coordination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this internal review was coordinated with or informed by external auditor activities (e.g., Single Audit). True if coordination occurred.

attributes.name: follow_up_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a follow-up review is required to verify implementation of corrective actions. True for reviews with significant findings requiring validation.

attributes.name: follow_up_review_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the follow-up review to verify corrective action implementation. Nullable if no follow-up is required.

attributes.name: high_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of high-severity findings identified during the review. High findings represent material weaknesses requiring prompt remediation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance review record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: low_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of low-severity findings identified during the review. Low findings represent minor control gaps or opportunities for improvement.

attributes.name: management_response_received_date
attributes.description: Date when management formally responded to the review findings and submitted their corrective action plan.

attributes.name: medium_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of medium-severity findings identified during the review. Medium findings represent control weaknesses that should be addressed in a reasonable timeframe.

attributes.name: overall_compliance_rating
attributes.description: Summary assessment of the overall compliance posture based on the review findings. Provides an executive-level view of compliance health (satisfactory, needs improvement, unsatisfactory, high risk).

attributes.name: population_size
attributes.description: Total number of transactions, cases, or records in the population from which the sample was drawn. Provides context for sample representativeness.

attributes.name: report_document_url
attributes.description: File path or URL to the stored compliance review report document. Provides access to the full detailed report.

attributes.name: report_issued_date
attributes.description: Date when the final compliance review report was formally issued to management and stakeholders.

attributes.name: review_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance review fieldwork was completed and findings were finalized. Nullable for reviews still in progress.

attributes.name: review_methodology
attributes.description: Primary audit methodology or approach used to conduct the compliance review (risk-based, transaction testing, control testing, analytical review, walkthrough, observation).

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context about the compliance review that do not fit structured fields. May include reviewer commentary or special circumstances.

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the compliance review, typically formatted as prefix-year-sequence (e.g., ICR-2024-00123).

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the operational period being reviewed. Defines the end of the time window under examination.

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the operational period being reviewed. Defines the beginning of the time window under examination (distinct from when the review itself started).

attributes.name: review_scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the scope, objectives, and boundaries of the compliance review. Explains what was included and excluded from the review.

attributes.name: review_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance review fieldwork commenced. Represents the beginning of the review period for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the compliance review (planned, fieldwork in progress, draft report, management response pending, final report issued, closed with follow-up complete).

attributes.name: review_team_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of staff names or identifiers who participated in the review team. Captures the full review team composition.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the internal compliance review activity. Defines the focus area and scope of the review (financial spot check, procurement review, programmatic compliance, data protection audit, conflict of interest certification review, grant compliance review).
attributes.references: Internal Audit Charter; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score assigned to the reviewed entity based on findings severity and control environment. Typically on a scale of 0-100 where higher scores indicate greater risk.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of transactions, cases, or records sampled during the compliance review. Represents the statistical sample used for testing.

attributes.name: total_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of findings across all severity levels identified during the compliance review.

products.name: sanctions_screening
products.description: Master record of sanctions and debarment screening checks performed against OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control), UN Security Council, EU, and other sanctions lists for vendors, partners, staff, and beneficiaries. Captures screening date, subject name, list checked, match result (clear, potential match, confirmed match), resolution action, screener identity, and re-screening frequency. Critical for anti-terrorism certification compliance required by USAID, DFID, and EU donors, and for organizational due diligence under US Executive Orders and UN resolutions.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sanctions screening record. Primary key.

attributes.name: compliance_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_incident. Business justification: When a sanctions screening identifies a non-false-positive match (match_result indicates hit, false_positive_flag = false), it triggers a compliance incident requiring investigation and resolution. Th

attributes.name: donor_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.donor_requirement. Business justification: Sanctions screening (OFAC, debarment lists) is often mandated by specific donor compliance requirements. The sanctions_screening table has donor_requirement_flag, donor_name, and grant_reference_numbe

attributes.name: screening_system_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.system_platform. Business justification: Sanctions screening is performed through dedicated platforms (Dow Jones, World-Check, OFAC screening tools). Nonprofits must document which system performed each screening for audit trail, donor compl

attributes.name: certification_statement
attributes.description: Text of the anti-terrorism certification or compliance statement that this screening supports.
attributes.references: USAID Anti-Terrorism Certification, DFID Partner Due Diligence

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sanctions screening record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: false_positive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a potential match was determined to be a false positive after investigation.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: Legal authority or executive order requiring the sanctions screening (e.g., US Executive Order 13224, UN Security Council Resolution 1267, EU Regulation 2580/2001).
attributes.references: US Executive Orders, UN Security Council Resolutions, EU Sanctions Regulations

attributes.name: match_details
attributes.description: Detailed information about the match, including list entry details, matching criteria, and any aliases or alternate spellings that triggered the match.

attributes.name: match_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the sanctions screening check indicating whether the subject was found on any sanctions list.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Guidelines, USAID Anti-Terrorism Certification

attributes.name: match_score
attributes.description: Numerical confidence score (0-100) indicating the likelihood of a true match when potential matches are identified. Higher scores indicate stronger matches.

attributes.name: next_screening_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the next periodic rescreening is due for this subject.

attributes.name: rescreening_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between required rescreening checks for this subject (e.g., 90, 180, 365).
attributes.references: USAID Anti-Terrorism Certification, Internal Compliance Procedures

attributes.name: rescreening_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic rescreening is required for this subject based on risk profile or donor requirements.
attributes.references: USAID Anti-Terrorism Certification, DFID Due Diligence Framework

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Action taken to resolve a potential or confirmed match (e.g., cleared after review, engagement blocked, escalated to legal, OFAC license requested, alternative vendor sourced).
attributes.references: USAID Anti-Terrorism Certification, OFAC Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the screening result was resolved and a final determination was made.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting the investigation, evidence reviewed, and rationale for the resolution decision.

attributes.name: reviewer_email
attributes.description: Email address of the reviewer who approved the resolution decision.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the senior compliance officer or legal counsel who reviewed and approved the resolution of a potential or confirmed match.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk rating assigned to the subject based on screening results, geographic factors, and business context.
attributes.references: USAID Anti-Terrorism Certification, Internal Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: sanctions_list_checked
attributes.description: Name of the sanctions or debarment list(s) checked during this screening. Pipe-separated list for multiple lists (e.g., OFAC SDN|UN Security Council|EU Sanctions|World Bank Debarment).
attributes.references: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Sanctions List, World Bank Listing of Ineligible Firms and Individuals

attributes.name: screener_email
attributes.description: Email address of the staff member who performed the screening, for audit trail and follow-up purposes.

attributes.name: screener_name
attributes.description: Name of the staff member or compliance officer who performed or initiated the screening.

attributes.name: screening_date
attributes.description: Date when the sanctions screening check was performed.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Guidelines, UN Security Council Sanctions Monitoring

attributes.name: screening_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform the sanctions screening check.
attributes.references: USAID Anti-Terrorism Certification, Internal Compliance Procedures

attributes.name: screening_status
attributes.description: Current status of the sanctions screening record in the compliance workflow.

attributes.name: screening_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the sanctions screening check was initiated, including time zone information.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Guidelines, UN Security Council Sanctions Monitoring

attributes.name: screening_tool
attributes.description: Name of the software tool or service used to perform the screening (e.g., Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, LexisNexis Bridger, manual OFAC search).

attributes.name: subject_address
attributes.description: Known address or location of the subject being screened, used for geographic risk assessment.

attributes.name: subject_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the individual being screened, used for identity matching and disambiguation.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Guidelines, UN Security Council Sanctions Monitoring

attributes.name: subject_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the subject in the source system (e.g., vendor ID, staff ID, beneficiary registration number).

attributes.name: subject_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or organization being screened. May include legal name, aliases, or transliterations.
attributes.references: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, UN Security Council Consolidated List

attributes.name: subject_nationality
attributes.description: Nationality or country of citizenship of the individual or country of registration for organizations. Pipe-separated list for multiple nationalities.

attributes.name: subject_type
attributes.description: Type of entity being screened against sanctions lists.
attributes.references: USAID Anti-Terrorism Certification, DFID Due Diligence Framework

attributes.name: supporting_documentation
attributes.description: References to supporting documents, evidence, or file paths for screening reports, investigation notes, and approval records.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sanctions screening record was last modified.

attributes.name: rescreening_sanctions_screening_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on sanctions_screening (rescreening_sanctions_screening_id)

products.name: misconduct_disclosure
products.description: Transactional record of disclosures made to or received from the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS) or equivalent reference check mechanisms during staff recruitment or partner vetting. Captures disclosure direction (outbound request, inbound response), subject reference, requesting organization, disclosure date, disclosure type (prior misconduct, SEA finding, disciplinary termination), response received flag, and action taken. Supports the humanitarian sector's commitment to preventing perpetrator mobility.

attributes.name: misconduct_disclosure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the misconduct disclosure record. Primary key for the misconduct disclosure entity.

attributes.name: alleged_perpetrator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safeguarding.alleged_perpetrator. Business justification: Misconduct disclosures (Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme) are about specific individuals who are alleged perpetrators. Currently misconduct_disclosure has subject_full_name, subject_identifie

attributes.name: country_office_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the country office or field location that initiated the disclosure request or is processing the response. Used for geographic reporting and accountability.

attributes.name: primary_misconduct_user_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the user who created this disclosure record. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: recruitment_requisition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the recruitment or vetting process that triggered this misconduct disclosure request. Links disclosure to the hiring or partner vetting workflow.

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the staff member who initiated the disclosure request or processed the inbound response. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: subject_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Misconduct disclosure requests must identify position held by subject for role-specific risk assessment (child contact roles, beneficiary-facing positions, supervisory authority). Required for inter-a

attributes.name: action_taken_by_requesting_org
attributes.description: Action taken by the requesting organization based on the disclosure response: candidate rejected (not hired/engaged), candidate accepted with conditions (hired with additional safeguarding measures), additional vetting required, no action (disclosure did not impact decision), or pending review.

attributes.name: beneficiary_facing_role_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the position involves direct contact with beneficiaries, particularly vulnerable populations. True if beneficiary-facing, False if back-office or non-beneficiary-facing role. Critical for safeguarding risk assessment.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS), Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC) PSEA Standards

attributes.name: child_contact_role_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the position involves direct contact with children (individuals under 18 years of age). True if child-contact role, False otherwise. Triggers enhanced child safeguarding vetting requirements.
attributes.references: United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC), Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level for this disclosure record: restricted (highest confidentiality, limited access), confidential (sensitive, controlled access), or internal (organization-wide access). Determines access controls and data retention policies.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS) Standards

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date when the subject provided informed consent for the disclosure. Null if consent was not obtained or not applicable.

attributes.name: consent_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the subject provided informed consent for the disclosure of their information. True if consent obtained, False if consent not obtained or not applicable (e.g., mandatory disclosure per policy).
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 6, Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS) Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this misconduct disclosure record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this disclosure record is scheduled for archival or deletion per organizational data retention policies and legal requirements. Ensures compliance with data protection regulations.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 5, Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of disciplinary action taken by the responding organization in response to the confirmed misconduct (e.g., termination, suspension, written warning, mandatory training). Free-text field to capture organizational response.
attributes.references: Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS) Standards, Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: disclosure_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel through which the disclosure request or response was transmitted: Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS) platform, email, secure portal, phone, in-person, or other.

attributes.name: disclosure_direction
attributes.description: Direction of the disclosure transaction: outbound request (organization requesting information about a candidate), inbound response (organization providing information in response to another organization's request), or bilateral exchange (mutual information sharing).

attributes.name: disclosure_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, or follow-up actions related to the disclosure. May include details about the disclosure process, communication with the responding organization, or internal decision-making rationale.

attributes.name: disclosure_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this disclosure transaction within the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme or equivalent reference check mechanism. Format: MDS-{ORG}-{SEQUENCE}.

attributes.name: disclosure_request_date
attributes.description: Date when the misconduct disclosure request was initiated or received. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: disclosure_response_date
attributes.description: Date when the disclosure response was provided or received. Null if no response has been received or provided yet.

attributes.name: disclosure_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the disclosure transaction: pending (request initiated but not yet processed), in progress (under review), completed (response received or provided), no response (request timed out), declined (organization declined to provide information).

attributes.name: disclosure_type
attributes.description: Category of misconduct being disclosed: prior misconduct (general misconduct history), Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA) finding, disciplinary termination, safeguarding concern, Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) violation, or child safeguarding breach.
attributes.references: Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC) PSEA Standards, Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: employment_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the subject's employment or engagement with the responding organization. Null if currently employed or engagement is ongoing.

attributes.name: employment_period_start_date
